papers.title: Spatial and temporal variability of Honduran benthic communities and reef functionality throughout the fourth global coral bleaching event
papers.authors: Paden, Gianna; Muñiz-Castillo, Aaron Israel; Núñez-Vallecillo, Mayra; Guerrero, Claudia Alejandra; Ortega, Pamela; Brady, Gisselle; Green, Rebecca H.; Molina Mendoza, Fiama Valeska; Rivera, Antonella
papers.abstract: Mass coral bleaching events are intensifying under climate change, yet their ecological consequences remain highly context dependent. We quantified shifts in benthic community structure, coral diversity and reef functionality during the 2023–2025 Fourth Global Mass Coral Bleaching Event (GCBE) in Tela Bay and Roatán, Honduras, two traditionally high-cover reef systems within the Mesoamerican Reef (MAR). Following three years of elevated heat stress (maximum DHW of 18 °C-weeks and 12 °C-weeks) both locations exhibited marked declines up to 60% in live coral cover, accompanied by increases of up to 58% in fleshy macroalgae cover, indicating shifts toward more algal-dominated benthic states. These shifts were accompanied by declines in coral diversity and reef functional index (RFI), suggesting reduced contribution of structurally important coral assemblages to key ecological processes. However, benthic community responses to bleaching were not uniform across sites. Increased multivariate dispersion following the event revealed substantial site-level heterogeneity, particularly in Tela Bay, where some sites retained greater coral cover and higher post-disturbance diversity indices, suggesting localized differences in resistance or early recovery potential. Coral community shifts were also strongly associated with declines in historically abundant taxa such as Agaricia tenuifolia , indicating that prolonged thermal stress can reduce the functional contribution of common and previously persistent coral taxa, not only structurally complex reef-building species. Our results show that even reef locations with high coral cover remain vulnerable to bleaching-driven reorganization of benthic communities and associated functional declines. Nevertheless, strong spatial variability among sites suggests that local environmental conditions and early-bleaching assemblage structure may mediate severity and recovery potential. These findings highlight the need to prioritize site-specific monitoring and management strategies in the MAR that identify and protect reefs with greater persistence potential under accelerating climate stress.
papers.summary_cn: 2023—2025年第四次全球珊瑚白化事件期间，研究量化了洪都拉斯Tela Bay与Roatán两处高珊瑚覆盖度礁区的底栖群落结构、珊瑚多样性与礁体功能性变化。结果显示，两地活珊瑚覆盖度下降达60%、肉质大型藻类覆盖度上升达58%，珊瑚多样性与reef functional index (RFI)同步下降，且群落变化与*Agaricia tenuifolia*等历史优势种的衰退密切相关。白化响应存在显著空间异质性，Tela Bay部分站点保留了较高珊瑚覆盖度与灾后多样性，提示局部环境条件与白化前群落结构可调节受损程度与恢复潜力，强调需在Mesoamerican Reef (MAR)推行站点特异性监测与保护策略。

papers.title: No identified genetic effects of dam construction or releasing hatchery-reared brown trout (Salmo trutta) to a Norwegian wild brown trout population
papers.authors: Taugbøl, Annette; Vøllestad, Leif Asbjørn; Museth, Jon
papers.abstract: In the River Gudbrandsdalslågen, a hydropower dam blocked upstream migration of brown trout in the early 1960s and reduced natural production along a 4.4-km minimum-flow reach. A fishway was constructed in 1966, and annual stocking of 15,000 juvenile trout began in 1973. We evaluated the genetic consequences using 91 neutral SNPs from historic and contemporary scale samples collected from mature trout over a century (1909-2015). Contemporary juveniles from multiple spawning areas in the main river, both upstream and downstream of the dam, and in tributaries were also analyzed to assess population structure and group migratory fish from the historic dataset to geographic origins. Contemporary samples formed three genetically distinct groups corresponding to the lower and upper main river and one tributary. Genetic differentiation increased with geographic distance but was not associated by the hydropower dam. Historic samples clustered with the contemporary lower main-river group. Despite significant isolation by time, differentiation among years was weak. This long-term genetic stability likely reflects a large effective population size, maintained habitat connectivity, and use of local broodstock for stocking.
papers.summary_cn: 在挪威Gudbrandsdalslågen河，水电站大坝自1960年代阻断褐鳟（Salmo trutta）上溯通道并缩减了4.4 km减水河段的自然产量，1966年修建鱼道，1973年起每年放流1.5万尾幼鱼。研究利用1909–2015年历史与当代鳞片样本的91个中性SNP，结合主河坝上坝下及支流多个产卵区当代幼鱼，评估建坝与放流对野生种群的遗传影响。当代样本形成下游主河、上游主河和一条支流三个遗传群，遗传分化随地理距离增加但与大坝无关，历史样本聚入当代下游主河群，年间分化虽显著但很弱。长期的遗传稳定性可能源于较大的有效种群规模、维持的栖息地连通性以及使用本地亲鱼放流。

papers.title: Prey consumption and condition of endangered age‐0 pallid sturgeon Scaphirhynchus albus and co‐located congeners: An assessment of surrogacy
papers.authors: Gosch, Nathan J. C.; Gemeinhardt, Todd R.; Civiello, Anthony P.; Bonneau, Joseph L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The capture of wild age‐0 pallid sturgeon Scaphirhynchus albus was rare historically. However, an unprecedented high number of captures during 2021, coupled with a more typical year in 2020, provided a unique opportunity to address diet‐related knowledge gaps during early life and evaluate surrogacy relationships with abundant congener individuals. We assessed diet and body condition of 55 age‐0 pallid sturgeon and 139 co‐located non‐pallid Scaphirhynchus individuals of similar size. Both pallid and non‐pallid individuals primarily consumed Chironomidae (Diptera), with Lopescladius and Paracladopelma being the most frequently consumed prey genera for both groups. Age‐0 pallid sturgeon also yielded similar body condition as co‐located non‐pallid individuals during both years. Given the unprecedented number of captures, this work is a valuable case study for assessing surrogacy relationships involving an endangered fish in the wild and provides increased confidence in previous studies with more limited captures suggesting a valid surrogate relationship between an abundant congener (shovelnose sturgeon Scaphirhynchus platorynchus ) and rarer age‐0 pallid sturgeon <40‐mm long. These results, coupled with prior research, provide evidence refuting the hypotheses that inadequate prey resources or less efficient prey assimilation are the limiting factor for pallid sturgeon recruitment to age 1.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了濒危 pallid sturgeon（*Scaphirhynchus albus*）0龄个体与同域近缘种的食性与体况，以评估以常见近缘种作为替代种的可行性。2020和2021年共采集55尾 pallid sturgeon 和139尾体型相近的非 pallid *Scaphirhynchus* 个体，两组均以摇蚊科（Chironomidae）为主要饵料，优势属为 *Lopescladius* 和 *Paracladopelma*，且体况无显著差异。结果表明，常见 shovelnose sturgeon（*S. platorynchus*）可作为体长<40 mm 的0龄 pallid sturgeon 的有效替代种，并反驳了饵料资源不足或摄食同化效率低是限制 pallid sturgeon 补充至1龄关键因素的假说。

papers.title: Observation of high proportions of unmated females in kuruma prawn Penaeus japonicus in the Seto Inland Sea: implications for a mate-finding Allee effect
papers.authors: Sato, Taku; Kotani, Nao; Ueta, Yukio; Yoshioka, Takuya; Ando, Daisuke; Kimoto, Sho; Morita, Shogo; Tsutsumi, Kentaro; Yamamoto, Soichiro; Inokuchi, Daiki
papers.abstract: Abstract The abundance of kuruma prawn Penaeus japonicus in Japanese waters has declined markedly since the mid-1990s. Despite this long-term decline, the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, limiting the development of effective stock management strategies. One consequence of reduced population density may be lower encounter rates between mates, potentially suppressing the species’ reproductive rate through a mate-finding Allee effect, in which the probability of mating decreases as population density declines. Yet, this mechanism has received little attention in conventional fisheries management. In this study, we investigated whether a mate-finding Allee effect occurs in P. japonicus populations in the Seto Inland Sea, using market-based sampling. Our results revealed a high proportion of unmated females (> 30%), even among those sampled immediately before or after spawning. As a result of Bayesian generalized linear mixed models fitting for the probability that a female was unmated, interannual variation in population abundance, used as a proxy for individual density, was considered a possible explanation for this high proportion, implicating occurrence of a mate-finding Allee effect. This study provides valuable insights into mate-finding Allee effects in Penaeus japonicus , which may contribute to reduced mating success and the recent population decline, with implications for stock assessment and management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以市场采样调查濑户内海日本对虾（Penaeus japonicus）雌虾的交配状况，检验种群密度下降是否引发 mate-finding Allee effect。结果显示，即使在产卵前后采样的个体中，未交配雌虾比例仍超过30%，且贝叶斯广义线性混合模型表明种群丰度的年际变化可解释这一高比例。研究提示 mate-finding Allee effect 可能降低交配成功率，进而加剧种群衰退，对 stock assessment 与管理具有启示意义。

papers.title: Everyday adaptation in a gilded trap: Risk-taking and resilience in Maine’s lobster fishery
papers.authors: Kilchenmann, Joelle; Burnham, Theresa L. U.; Leslie, Heather M.; Reardon, Kathleen M.; Samhouri, Jameal F.; Stoll, Joshua S.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Flexibility is widely regarded as an enabling factor of adaptive capacity among natural resource users. Yet, as ecological systems around the world become increasingly simplified and social environments reduce diversification options, flexibility is becoming limited. Despite this trend, efforts to study how people adapt within the confines of constrained social–ecological systems have been sparse. Here, we broaden the analysis of resilience through a study of the American lobster fishery in Maine, United States, one of the most valuable fisheries in the world. Drawing on 307,000 observations from 3,515 harvesters over a 13-y period (2010–2022), we used a generalized linear mixed-effects model to analyze how sociodemographic characteristics, economic conditions, and time shape the probability of fishing during poor weather conditions, which we define as high-risk. We find demographic and socioeconomic heterogeneity in risk-taking: Men, mid-career harvesters, and captains of larger businesses were more likely to fish in risky conditions, and both low landings and high catch prices increased risk-taking. Contrary to our prediction, however, we observed an overall decline in risk-taking through time. We argue that harvesters instead relied on everyday adaptation—individual-scale, short- and medium-term adjustments in business strategy that occur within the constraints of the existing social–ecological system—to maintain resilience without increasing risk. Observable shifts in fleet composition, including use of larger vessels and higher-capacity licenses, lend support to this understanding. These results suggest that even in highly constrained social–ecological systems, protected response spaces and comanagement structures can enable often overlooked forms of flexibility.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于美国缅因州美洲螯龙虾渔业2010–2022年间3,515名捕捞者的30.7万条观测数据，采用广义线性混合效应模型，分析社会人口特征、经济状况和时间如何影响恶劣天气下出海捕捞（即高风险行为）的概率。结果显示，男性、职业生涯中期捕捞者及大型企业船长更倾向于冒险作业，低渔获量与高价格亦提升冒险概率，但整体冒险行为随时间下降。作者认为捕捞者通过个体尺度、短中期的“日常适应”策略（如船队结构向大型船舶和高容量许可证转变）在既有社会-生态约束下维持韧性，而非增加风险，表明受保护响应空间与共同管理结构可激发常被忽视的灵活性。

papers.title: Proposals to Reform the Minister’s Power to Promulgate Fisheries- Related Offences in South Africa: Perspectives From Selected Jurisdictions – Part I
papers.authors: Molefhi S Phorego; Hendrik J van As
papers.abstract: The role of Cabinet in the implementation of fisheries legislation and the promulgation of regulations relating to fishery-related offences remains under-studied. This is a global phenomenon and entails instances where the relevant Minister promulgates regulations for the outlawing of fishery-related activities that are not sanctioned by law. However, this approach does not explain why primary legislation, instead of regulations, should not be the mechanism used to combat IUU fishing. By relying on ministerial regulations, instead of treating IUU-related offences as criminal conduct, countries handle such matters in terms of administrative law principles, resulting in lesser penalties for perpetrators. This paper examines the role of the executive authority in the implementation of fisheries legislation and the promulgation of regulations relating to fishery-related offences. Four jurisdictions are selected for comparison, and the conclusions drawn from each jurisdiction are then used as the basis for proposals for legal reform in South Africa in relation to fishery-related crimes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究审视南非内阁在渔业立法实施及渔业相关违法法规颁布中的角色，指出以部长条例而非初级立法处理IUU捕捞违法，导致按行政法原则处置、处罚偏轻。通过比较四个司法辖区的做法，提出南非渔业相关犯罪的法律改革建议。

papers.title: Resolving a 165‐year taxonomic conundrum in African galaxiids (Teleostei: Galaxiidae): Reinstatement of Agalaxis Scott, 1936, revalidation of A. punctifer and A. dubius, and description of a new species
papers.authors: Chakona, Albert; Zarei, Fatah; Skelton, Paul H.; Bragança, Pedro H. N.; Swartz, Ernst R.
papers.abstract: Abstract The Cape galaxias, formerly treated as the single African representative of the family Galaxiidae under the name Galaxias zebratus (Castelnau, 1861), has long masked substantial hidden diversity. We consolidated all available molecular data and generated additional sequences to fill sampling gaps, providing the most comprehensive assessment of historically isolated lineages within this complex to date. Analysis of mitochondrial cyt b and COI sequences identified 15 genetically distinct lineages, most with restricted geographic ranges. Previous phylogenetic studies demonstrated that the African galaxiids are not closely related to Galaxias truttaceus Valenciennes, 1846, the type species of Galaxias , suggesting they may be misclassified. Detailed morphological and osteological examinations identified consistent diagnostic characters separating the Cape galaxiids from Galaxias and other galaxiid genera. Molecular and morphological evidence supports reinstatement of the genus Agalaxis Scott, 1936, for the African galaxiids. We further revalidate Agalaxis punctifer (Castelnau, 1861) and A. dubius (Gilchrist & Thompson, 1917), describe A. peninsulae sp. nov. and designate a neotype for and redescribe A. zebratus s.s. By resolving the application of available names, we establish a taxonomic framework for resolving the remaining undescribed diversity and recognise the Cape galaxiids as a diverse endemic radiation within the Cape Fold Ecoregion.
papers.summary_cn: 整合分子与形态学证据，对非洲Cape galaxiids（原统归为Galaxias zebratus）进行了迄今最全面的分类修订。基于cyt b和COI序列分析识别出15个遗传上独立的lineage，多数分布范围狭窄；形态与骨骼学检查发现其与Galaxias属及其他galaxiid属存在稳定的鉴别特征。据此恢复Agalaxis属（Scott, 1936），重新确认A. punctifer和A. dubius的有效性，描述新种A. peninsulae sp. nov.，并为A. zebratus s.s.指定neotype。该研究为Cape Fold Ecoregion内这一特有raditation的后续分类厘清奠定了基础。

papers.title: Using spatio-temporal models to assist ecosystem-based fisheries management: a New Zealand case study
papers.authors: Grüss, Arnaud; Pinkerton, Matthew H.; McGregor-Tiatia, Vidette
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 基于新西兰案例，探讨利用时空模型辅助基于生态系统的渔业管理（ecosystem-based fisheries management），为数据有限的渔业管理提供空间化评估工具。

papers.title: Social-ecological portfolio effects in ecosystem service provision, the case of commercial Pacific salmon fisheries in Canada
papers.authors: Affinito, Flavio; Fortin, Marie-Josée; Gonzalez, Andrew
papers.abstract: Human societies depend on stable ecosystem services, which are often stabilized by the ecological portfolio effect arising from biodiversity. Yet, whether this ecological stability propagates to the socio-economic dimensions of an ecosystem service is poorly understood. This study provides a social-ecological portfolio analysis of an ecosystem service by examining the provisioning service provided by commercial Pacific salmon ( Oncorhynchus ) fisheries in British Columbia, Canada. We used the Essential Ecosystem Service Variables (EESV) framework to analyze longitudinal monitoring data across multiple ecosystem service dimensions: ecological supply (abundance), use (catch), demand (price), instrumental value (landed value), and anthropogenic contribution (effort). We quantified portfolio strength and synchrony at two scales: a provincial multi-species portfolio (driven by species diversity) and regional species-level portfolio (driven by regional diversity). At the provincial scale, we found that species diversity provided a stabilizing portfolio effect across ecological and socio-economic dimensions. However, the underlying dynamics in species pair synchrony were not uniform. For example, we found high synchronicity in the Chinook–Coho pair for ecological supply , and Coho–Pink for instrumental value . This difference suggests that social and economic processes provide an additional, portfolio buffering effect. At the species-level, regional portfolios varied greatly: Pink was the most stable throughout social-ecological dimensions, whereas Chinook showed a weak, synchronous portfolio in ecological supply , highlighting potential vulnerability. Our findings suggest that, while biodiversity underpins overall social-ecological stability, specific ecological dynamics, such as the synchronicity of Chinook dynamics, may threaten ecosystem service stability. This approach highlights the importance of integrated social-ecological monitoring to identify and manage risk.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省商业太平洋鲑（*Oncorhynchus*）渔业为对象，基于 Essential Ecosystem Service Variables（EESV）框架，从生态供给、利用（catch）、需求（price）、工具价值（landed value）和人为投入（effort）等维度开展社会-生态 portfolio 分析。结果表明，省级多物种层面，物种多样性在生态与社会经济维度均提供了稳定化 portfolio 效应，但物种对间的同步性动态并不一致，如 Chinook–Coho 在生态供给上高度同步、Coho–Pink 在工具价值上高度同步，提示社会经济过程具有额外的缓冲作用。物种层面区域 portfolio 差异显著，Pink 在各维度最为稳定，而 Chinook 在生态供给上呈弱同步 portfolio，存在潜在脆弱性。研究强调，生物多样性虽支撑整体社会-生态稳定性，但特定生态动态（如 Chinook 的同步性）可能威胁生态系统服务稳定性，需通过整合性社会-生态监测识别与管理风险。

papers.title: Site- and landscape-scale estimates of ecological suitability inform desert fish conservation
papers.authors: Friebertshauser, Ryan J; Bestgen, Kevin R
papers.journal: Transactions of the American Fisheries Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Persistence of freshwater fishes native to dryland streams increasingly depends on ecologically informed conservation as environmental and anthropogenic pressures increase. Imperiled Rio Grande Chub Gila pandora and Rio Grande Sucker Pantosteus plebeius require management to slow their declining ­distribution and abundance, but insights into their ecological requirements have been restricted to site-scale inference over limited areas. To expand this understanding and broadly inform conservation efforts, we conducted two assessments of ecological suitability for each species using data collected across their overlapping ranges. The goal of our first assessment was to identify site-scale abiotic and biotic conditions associated with occupancy. Our second assessment sought to explore the importance of landscape-scale covariates to presence and predict probability of presence in unsampled streams. Inference gained from these approaches independently and together enabled us to understand factors that affect the distribution, ecology, and habitat needs of these species, which will improve conservation actions. Methods Fish community surveys, site-level habitat assessments, and remotely sensed landscape scale covariates were measured at 112 sites across the range of Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker in the United States. To better understand site-scale physiochemical conditions and co-occurrences of White Sucker Catostomus commersonii and nonnative trout that are associated with occupancy, we used data from fish community and habitat surveys to fit multispecies occupancy models. We then used presence/absence information from a larger data set and a suite of remotely sensed covariates to develop random forest classification models that identified important landscape-scale predictors of presence. We used these models to predict the probability of presence for each Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker in unsampled streams, and from those predictions we inferred distribution patterns of ecologically suitable streams across our study area. Results Site-scale ecological suitability assessments identified positive relationships between water temperature and occupancy of both Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker. Rio Grande Chub occupancy was also positively associated with the quantity and depth of pools, and Rio Grande Sucker occupancy was negatively related to quantity of riffles. The probability of Rio Grande Chub occupancy was modestly reduced by nonnative trout occupancy, and Rio Grande Sucker occupancy was not associated with any nonnative species. Influenced primarily by modeled mean August stream temperature (NorWeST) and watershed position, defined as upstream drainage area and Strahler order, predictions from random forest models demonstrated higher probabilities of presence in warm, small- to medium-sized streams. While this produced higher proportions of ecologically suitable reaches toward the southern extent of their range in the United States, the greatest linear stream quantity predicted to support presence of both species occurred in north-central New Mexico. Conclusions Our first assessment, which was directed at understanding ecological suitability at the site scale, successfully described abiotic and biotic conditions associated with occupancy by Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker, which is useful to inform habitat restoration, nonnative species management, and the selection of streams and reach conditions that are suitable for repatriation. Our second assessment revealed important landscape-scale predictors of presence and patterns of predicted suitable habitat, information that is required to prioritize conservation regions and select streams for future surveys and repatriation efforts. Together, inference from both assessments more broadly described the ecological needs of Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker and will allow managers to direct conservation actions at multiple scales.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在通过站点和景观两个尺度评估 Rio Grande Chub（Gila pandora）和 Rio Grande Sucker（Pantosteus plebeius）的生态适宜性，以指导其保护管理。作者在美国两物种分布区内112个站点开展鱼类群落调查和栖息地评估，结合多物种 occupancy 模型与随机森林分类模型，分别识别站点尺度环境因子和景观尺度预测变量。结果显示，两种鱼类的 occupancy 均与水温正相关，Rio Grande Chub 还与水塘数量和深度正相关，且受非本地鳟鱼 occupancy 的轻微负面影响；景观尺度上，8月均温（NorWeST）和流域位置是 presence 的主要预测因子，温暖的中小型溪流适宜性更高。研究为栖息地修复、非本地种管理和再引入选址提供了多尺度的科学依据。

papers.title:
Analysis of Multiple
Tire Rubber-Derived Chemicals
in Fish Bile and Plasma: Analytical Method and Field Assessment in
Puget Sound, WA, USA
papers.authors: da Silva, Denis; Gates, Jonelle; Hattaway, Madison; Harding, Louisa; O’Neill, Sandra; Schultz, Irvin
papers.abstract: Abstract Tire rubber-derived chemicals (TRCs) are known to be highly toxic to fish, but understanding of their environmental levels and fate is still limited. This study presents a new method for the analysis of 18 TRCs, including phenylenediamines (TRC-PDs), their quinone derivatives (TRC-Qs), and rubber vulcanizing and curing-related chemicals (TRC-VCRs) in fish bile and plasma samples. We applied this method in bile and plasma samples from English sole collected in urban, near-urban, and nonurban sites in Puget Sound, WA, USA. TRCs were detected in 100% of bile and 96% of plasma samples from English sole collected from all nine sites in Puget Sound. Mean TRC levels in bile samples per site ranged between 0.8 and 18 ng/mL, while plasma levels ranged between 0.22 and 0.63 ng/mL, with total summed reaching up to 31 ng/mL in bile and 1.3 ng/mL in plasma. TRC-PDs were the most abundant group of TRC in both bile and plasma. Higher levels of TRCs in bile suggests this matrix to be more valuable for environmental monitoring, providing more sensitive detection of TRC during low exposures. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first data set reporting environmental levels of 18 TRCs in the bile and plasma of field-caught fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究建立了同时分析鱼胆汁和血浆中18种轮胎橡胶衍生化学品（TRCs，包括phenylenediamines、quinone衍生物及硫化固化相关化学品）的新方法，并应用于美国Puget Sound城市、近郊及非城市站点采集的English sole。所有站点胆汁样本100%检出TRCs，血浆检出率96%，胆汁中TRC-PDs含量最高，胆汁总浓度（最高31 ng/mL）显著高于血浆（最高1.3 ng/mL），表明胆汁是环境监测中更敏感的基质。这是首个报道野外捕获鱼胆汁和血浆中18种TRCs环境水平的数据集。

papers.title: DeformDANet: morphology-aware detection with population estimation for shrimp post-larvae in dense aquaculture imagery
papers.authors: A, Sugunapriya; S, Markkandan
papers.abstract: Introduction Accurate and automated quantification of shrimp post-larvae (PL) in aquaculture hatcheries is critical for stock assessment, production management, and precision aquaculture, yet it remains labor-intensive when performed manually. Existing vision-based monitoring systems struggle with two domain-specific challenges: the biologically deformable morphology of shrimp post-larvae, which flex into irregular C- and S-shaped configurations during swimming, and the high target density in hatchery images, where hundreds of semi-transparent individuals cluster within a single frame, resulting in ambiguous localization and conflicting training signals. Methods To address these limitations, we propose DeformDANet, a dense object detector built upon two novel components. First, a geometry-adaptive Deformable Integrated Spatial Operation (DeformISO) Block aligns receptive fields with the deformable morphology of shrimp post-larvae through deformable feature extraction. Second, a fully vectorized Density-Adaptive Assignment (DAA) strategy replaces conventional fixed neighbourhood target assignment with a per-target radius derived from local k-nearest-neighbour density, thereby adaptively adjusting the positive assignment region and reducing assignment ambiguity in densely populated scenes. Results Extensive experiments on the publicly available PL-Detection benchmark demonstrate that DeformDANet achieves 94.5% mAP@50, 95.8% recall, and a 91.8% F1-score using only 1.38 M parameters and 6.82 GFLOPs, outperforming all compared methods in F1-score, recall, parameter efficiency, and inference speed. Furthermore, the validation-selected threshold configuration improved counting performance, reducing the mean absolute error to 2.75 ± 0.11 larvae per image and increasing the proportion of images with ±20% counting error to 78.87 ± 2.17%. Discussion These results indicate that DeformDANet provides an accurate, robust, and computationally efficient framework for automated vision-based monitoring and population estimation of shrimp post-larvae, supporting intelligent aquaculture management.
papers.summary_cn: 针对对虾仔虾（PL）在育苗场图像中形态易变（C/S形弯曲）且密度高、半透明导致定位模糊的问题，提出形态感知检测器 DeformDANet，其核心为可变形特征提取模块 DeformISO 与基于局部 k 近邻密度的密度自适应标签分配策略 DAA。在 PL-Detection 公开基准上，该模型以仅 1.38 M 参数和 6.82 GFLOPs 达到 94.5% mAP@50、95.8% recall 和 91.8% F1，计数平均绝对误差降至 2.75±0.11 尾/图。结果表明该框架可实现对虾仔虾的高精度、轻量化自动监测与种群估计，服务于精准水产养殖管理。

papers.title: Comparative Study of the Morphological and Meristic Features of African Tiger Fish (Hydrocynus vittatus) from the Congo and Zambezi River Basins
papers.authors: Chilambe, Emman; Pojana, Mebbah; Gondwe, Haggai; Kun, Clara Nyonnohnagbe
papers.journal: East African Journal of Agriculture and Biotechnology
papers.abstract: This study examined the morphological and meristic differences between Hydrocynus vittatus populations from the Chambeshi River in the Congo River Basin and Lake Kariba in the Zambezi River Basin, Zambia. Independent-samples t tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) were used to compare the morphometric and meristic traits. Multiple morphometric and meristic counts were found to be significantly different between the two populations (p < 0.001). Chambeshi specimens had bigger body dimensions than Lake Kariba specimens, with a mean weight and total length of 2.500 ± 0.371 kg and 46.193 ± 1.985 cm, compared to 1.803 ± 0.305 kg and 35.823 ± 1.652 cm, respectively. All the effect size ranges were between 0.556 and 0.887, indicating significant phenotypic differentiation. There was good separation of the populations, as shown in the PCA, with the first 2 components explaining 92.09% of the total variation. LDA yielded 100% classification accuracy for both the original and leave-one-out categories. While the present study did not directly test the underlying drivers, the observed difference may be due to geographic isolation, differential environment, habitat characteristics, prey availability, and fishing pressure. The results of this study lay a foundation for understanding the variation in the H. vittatus population and will guide future integrated morphological/genetic investigations for fisheries management and conservation in Zambia.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了赞比亚刚果河流域Chambeshi河与赞比西河流域Kariba湖的非洲虎鱼（Hydrocynus vittatus）种群的形态与计数特征差异。采用t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验、PCA和LDA分析显示，两种群在多项形态和计数指标上差异显著（p < 0.001），Chambeshi种群体型更大（平均体重2.500 kg、全长46.193 cm，Kariba湖分别为1.803 kg和35.823 cm），效应量为0.556–0.887。PCA前两个主成分解释92.09%的总变异，LDA分类准确率达100%，表明两种群存在显著表型分化，推测与地理隔离、环境差异、饵料可得性及捕捞压力有关。
