papers.title: PREVALENCE, INFECTION INTENSITY, AND ALLERGENIC RISK OF ANISAKIS SPP. IN READY-TO-EAT FISH PRODUCTS
papers.authors: Jazina, K.; Bulashev, A.; Smagulova, A.; Izbasarova, A.; Kirjušina, M.; Lider, L.; Kiyan, V.; Uakhit, R.
papers.abstract: Anisakis spp. are foodborne parasites of major public health concern due to their dual role as infectious agents and potent allergens. This study investigated the prevalence, infection intensity, and allergenic potential of Anisakidae in ready-to-eat fish products available on the Astana market (Kazakhstan). A total of 27 commercial fish product brands representing various species and processing methods were examined using artificial digestion and molecular analysis. Third-stage larvae (L3) of Anisakis were detected in 10 products, including cod liver, pink salmon, tuna, mackerel, smoked herring, lightly salted herring, and smoked mackerel. Infection prevalence ranged from 7.5% to 100%, while mean infection intensity varied markedly, with the highest values observed in smoked and lightly salted herring products. PCR assays targeting the 18S rRNA and COX II genes confirmed the presence of Anisakidae DNA in all parasitologically positive samples. Notably, several products without detectable larvae by artificial digestion tested positive by PCR, indicating the persistence of Anisakis-derived genetic material associated with thermostable allergenic proteins. These findings demonstrate that the absence of visible larvae does not necessarily indicate the absence of allergenic risk and highlight the importance of combining parasitological and molecular methods for comprehensive food safety assessment of ready-to-eat fish products.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳市售即食鱼制品中 Anisakis spp. 的感染率、感染强度及致敏风险，采用人工消化法和分子分析对27个商业鱼制品品牌进行检测。结果显示，10个产品（包括鳕鱼肝、粉红鲑、金枪鱼、鲭鱼、烟熏鲱鱼、轻腌鲱鱼和烟熏鲭鱼）检出 Anisakis 三期幼虫（L3），感染率为7.5%~100%，烟熏和轻腌鲱鱼感染强度最高；PCR 靶向18S rRNA和COX II基因在所有寄生虫学阳性样本中均确认 Anisakidae DNA。值得注意的是，部分人工消化未检出幼虫的产品经PCR检测呈阳性，提示与热稳定致敏蛋白相关的 Anisakis 遗传物质残留，表明无可见幼虫并不等同于无致敏风险，即食鱼制品食品安全评估需结合寄生虫学与分子方法。

papers.title: Fish-Based Oil in Sausage Production Technology: Prospects and Challenges
papers.authors: Glukharev, A. Yu.; Volchenko, V. I.; Grokhovsky, V. A.; Kolotova, D. S.
papers.abstract: Fish oil provides valuable natural compounds, such as omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and fat-soluble vitamins, which are essential for human health. Its use in sausage production as a substitute for animal and poultry fats improves the nutritional and biological value of the fat fraction, thereby expanding the range of functional and therapeutic products. This review examines scientific literature on the use of fish oil to improve the nutritional value and biological efficacy of sausage fats, while also assessing the prospects and impact of the finished products on human health.The review covers scientific publications on the chemical composition of fish oil, the bioactive properties of its components, and its practical application in sausage products, indexed in ScienceDirect, PubMed, Springer Link, and eLIBRARY.RU.Traditional sausage products are often associated with potential health risks due to their high content of saturated fatty acids and cholesterol, which increase the risk of cardiovascular diseases and obesity. Adding fish oil to sausage formulations, alone or with vegetable oils, can reduce the saturated fat content in the finished product by shifting the fatty acid profile toward a higher proportion of unsaturated fats. Fish oil is an effective means of adjusting and improving the fat composition of sausages. However, in some cases, this substitution requires additional measures to stabilize the fat against oxidation, preserve the sensory profile, and maintain the consistency of the finished product.Sausages containing fish oil serve as a dietary substitute for traditional sausage products, as they reduce the risk of cardiovascular diseases and help regulate lipid metabolism.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了鱼油作为动物脂肪替代物在香肠生产中的应用前景与挑战。鱼油富含omega-3多不饱和脂肪酸和脂溶性维生素，添加后可降低产品饱和脂肪酸和胆固醇含量，改善脂肪酸谱，提升香肠的营养与生物学价值。但替代过程中需解决脂肪氧化稳定性、感官品质和质构一致性等问题。含鱼油香肠可作为传统香肠的膳食替代品，有助于降低心血管疾病风险并调节脂质代谢。

papers.title: Bacteriophage Therapy for Aeromonas salmonicida: A Systematic Evaluation of Translational Readiness in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Andriawan, Soni; Schwaiger, Karin; Holzer, Astrid S.; Saleh, Mona
papers.abstract: Aeromonas salmonicida is an important threat to the sustainability of aquaculture production and a major contributor to antimicrobial resistance, which has encouraged bacteriophage therapy. This review evaluated the current evidence base for bacteriophage therapy against A. salmonicida. Literature searches were carried out in Scopus, PubMed, and Web of Science prior to 2 April 2026, according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. After removing 46 duplicate records, a final dataset of 108 unique publications was obtained for analysis. A data extraction form was created to include studies examining bacteriophage activity against A. salmonicida. Information about phage properties‚ experimental conditions‚ treatment outcomes, and study methods was extracted. Study quality and translation potential were evaluated with a qualitative appraisal tool, and a narrative synthesis was chosen due to significant heterogeneity. A total of 22 studies met the inclusion criteria; however, most were conducted in vitro, with few in vivo. Because of heterogeneity in phage–host systems, study designs, and outcomes, systems cannot be compared. Overall‚ bacteriophage therapy is a promising targeted treatment to address A. salmonicida infection. Evidence from these studies suggests more controlled studies‚ phage genome safety assessment‚ evaluation of phage resistance development‚ and field trials are necessary before the adoption of these treatments.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统评估了噬菌体疗法对抗杀鲑气单胞菌（Aeromonas salmonicida）的转化就绪度，按照PRISMA 2020指南检索Scopus、PubMed和Web of Science，从108篇文献中筛选出22项符合标准的研究。结果显示，多数研究为体外实验，体内研究极少，且因噬菌体-宿主系统、实验设计和结局指标的异质性，各系统间难以直接比较。总体而言，噬菌体疗法是应对A. salmonicida感染的潜力靶向手段，但在实际应用前仍需更多受控实验、噬菌体基因组安全性评估、噬菌体抗性演化评价及田间试验。

papers.title: A review of the effectiveness of solutions to achieve the good environmental status of the marine environment
papers.authors: Bigagli, Emanuele; Korpinen, Samuli; Andersen, Jesper H.; Reker, Johnny
papers.abstract: Europe’s seas are at the nexus of a “triple crisis” of biodiversity and habitat loss, climate change, and pollution, increasingly eroding the ecosystems’ resilience and capacity to provide ecosystem services. Although essential, existing European Union policies, especially the Marine Strategy Framework Directive (MSFD), proved insufficient. The objective of the MSFD to achieve Good Environmental Status (GES) in all EU marine waters by 2020 was not reached, due to gaps in GES definition, a lack of consideration of climate change, uneven ambition, insufficient measures, gaps in monitoring and data comparability, and inadequate integration with other key policies. The aim of this study was to review the management measures and solutions to address the pressures and ecosystem features covered by the 11 MSFD GES Descriptors, assessing their reported effectiveness, co-benefits and trade-offs, and implementation constraints. This review identifies a broad range of solutions contributing to GES, including ecological protection, passive and active restoration, nature-based solutions, pressure reduction, spatial protection and planning, sustainable resource management, and pollution prevention and mitigation. Their effectiveness is often context- and scale-dependent. Also, no single measure is sufficient, and outcomes are enhanced when these are integrated into a coherent framework, adapted to local conditions, and supported by long-term monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and coastal/marine spatial planning. Restoration measures should be preceded by effective pressure/stressor reduction, while pressure-reduction solutions can generate cascading benefits across multiple Descriptors, highlighting opportunities to prioritize interventions. While evidence is abundant for some Descriptors (e.g., non-indigenous species, commercial fish and shellfish, biodiversity, eutrophication), important knowledge gaps remain for food webs, seabed integrity, and hydrographic conditions, as well as on cumulative effects and interactions, cross-Descriptor effects, the status of emerging contaminants, the effectiveness of waste management/circular economy and of marine nature-based solutions against GES objectives, and on climate-change-related measures. Overall, achieving GES will require moving beyond isolated measures towards coordinated, adaptive, and ecosystem-scale management to effectively address the “triple crisis”.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估了欧盟MSFD 11项GES Descriptor下各类管理措施与解决方案的有效性、协同效益及实施限制，涵盖生态保护、被动与主动修复、nature-based solutions、压力削减、空间保护与规划、可持续资源管理及污染防控等。研究发现措施有效性高度依赖情境与尺度，单一措施不足以实现GES，需整合为协调框架并结合长期监测、利益相关方参与及海岸/海洋空间规划。压力削减措施可产生跨Descriptor的级联效益，修复措施应以有效削减压力为前提；食物网、海床完整性、水文条件及累积效应等方面仍存在显著知识缺口。

papers.title: Fermented Sargassum-Based Seafood Rice Seasoning: Prototype Development and Mix Design Optimization
papers.authors: Hien, B. T. T.; Diem, P. T.; An, D. V.; Duyen, P. T.; Nguyen, N. V.; Nguyen, Kh. B.
papers.abstract: Direct incorporation of brown-seaweed biomass into foods is limited by its fibrous texture and by the challenge of retaining desirable marine and umami notes without an excessive fishy odor. This study evaluated whether fermented commercial Sargassum spp . biomass could be incorporated into a dry seafood seasoning for rice and whether a constrained mix design could identify a formulation with high preliminary hedonic acceptability.Commercial dried Sargassum spp . biomass was rehydrated for 6 h, washed, pretreated with 1.5% sodium bicarbonate at 90–100°C for 2 h, reduced to 1–2-mm fragments, and fermented with a mixed lactic starter containing Companilactobacillus farciminis and Lactiplantibacillus pentosus . The fermentation involving 2.15% starter culture and 5.0% sugar lasted for 86 h at 30°C. The methods of hot-air, low-temperature, and freeze drying were compared using moisture content and handl- ing attributes. Seven variable ingredients were optimized within predefined ranges in an 18-run constrained mix design comprising 15 unique formulations. The response was the mean overall hedonic score for each run, based on evaluations by 30 assessors on a nine-point scale.The fermented biomass had a pH of 4.56 ± 0.05. The freeze-drying processing at −50 ± 2°C for 40 h yielded material with 4.51 ± 0.20% moisture and a crisp, loose, non-clumped structure. It was selected on the basis of handling properties. The drying routes were not compared by nutrient or volatile retention. The first-order mix model was significant (F = 45.40, p < 0.001, R² = 96.12%, adjusted R² = 94.00%). The selected formulation comprised 30% fermented seaweed biomass, 10% Porphyra/Pyropia -type dried red seaweed, 10% dried tuna, 5% dried shrimp, 25% roasted sesame, 10% mung bean, 5% carrot, 3% sugar, and 2% sodium chloride. The observed acceptability score was 8.30 ± 0.54 versus a predicted score of 8.43. The final product contained 4.64 ± 0.30% moisture, 28.50 ± 1.58% protein, 15.30 ± 0.32% total ash, and 15.00 ± 0.64% lipid on an as-received basis.The sequential combination of fermentation, drying-route selection, and constrained mix optimization demonstrated the feasibility of the tested prototype and identified a formulation for independent confirmation. Because the selected solution lay on several formulation bounds, it represents the most favorable region within the tested domain rather than a universal optimum. The evidence was limited to preliminary hedonic testing and did not establish nutrient retention, shelf-life stability, comprehensive food safety, health effects, or market-level acceptance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以发酵马尾藻（Sargassum spp.）生物质为基料，开发海鲜米饭调味料原型，通过乳酸菌混合发酵、干燥方式比较及约束混料设计优化配方。发酵后pH为4.56，冻干（−50°C、40 h）所得物料水分4.51%且结构酥松，被选为干燥工艺。一阶混料模型显著（R²=96.12%），最优配方含30%发酵海藻、10%紫菜类红藻、10%金枪鱼干、5%虾干、25%焙炒芝麻等，感官接受度实测8.30（预测8.43），产品蛋白质28.50%、灰分15.30%、脂质15.00%。结果仅基于初步感官评价，未验证营养保留、货架期及食品安全性。

papers.title: Phased ecological responses and effectiveness assessment of subtidal oyster reef restoration: a case study from Dashentang, Bohai Bay
papers.authors: Liu, Chang; Deng, Lijing; Huang, Haiyan; Zeng, Rong; Xu, Yan; Ai, Yangyi; Zhang, Jian
papers.abstract: Subtidal oyster reef restoration presents greater challenges for implementation and monitoring than intertidal restoration, and evaluations of relatively large-scale ecological restoration projects remain limited. This study evaluated the restoration project of Dashengtang using monitoring data from five field surveys collected from 2022 to 2026, and evaluated stage-specific ecological changes in oyster populations, aquatic environments, and macrobenthic communities. Oyster abundance generally increased following restoration. By March 2026, mean oyster density on natural and artificial reefs reached 1,830.4 and 286.0 ind. m -2 , respectively. The recruitment density on artificial reefs increased to 204.2 ind. m -2 , although the population remained dominated by small- and medium-sized individuals. Mean macrobenthic density increased to 255.6 ind. m -2 during post-restoration monitoring, and community composition differed significantly among monitoring periods. Water-quality variables showed different stage-specific patterns. Mean suspended particulate matter (SPM) concentration decreased from 19.3 mg L -1 before restoration to 7.28 mg L -1 in March 2026. Dissolved oxygen (DO) returned to levels comparable to pre-restoration conditions. Reactive phosphate remained low during the late post-restoration period, whereas chemical oxygen demand (COD), dissolved inorganic nitrogen (DIN), and chlorophyll-a fluctuated among monitoring periods. The Dashentang case provides insights into the implementation of large-scale subtidal oyster reef restoration under the specific environmental conditions of Bohai Bay. Future work should strengthen long-term continuous monitoring and observation of key ecological processes to further examine the relationship between environmental variability and oyster reef ecological development, evaluate the long-term stability and ecosystem services of artificial reefs, and progressively establish evaluation thresholds for different restoration stages to support adaptive management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2022—2026年五次野外调查监测数据，评估渤海湾大神堂潮下带牡蛎礁修复项目中牡蛎种群、水环境及大型底栖动物群落的阶段性生态响应。修复后牡蛎丰度总体上升，2026年3月自然礁与人工礁平均牡蛎密度分别达1,830.4和286.0 ind. m⁻²，人工礁补充群体密度增至204.2 ind. m⁻²，但种群仍以中小型个体为主；大型底栖动物平均密度升至255.6 ind. m⁻²，群落组成在不同监测期差异显著。悬浮颗粒物（SPM）均值由修复前19.3 mg L⁻¹降至7.28 mg L⁻¹，溶解氧恢复至修复前水平，活性磷酸盐后期维持低位，而COD、DIN和叶绿素a呈波动变化。该案例为渤海湾特定环境条件下大规模潮下带牡蛎礁修复提供了实践参考，未来需加强长期连续监测并建立分阶段评估阈值以支持适应性管理。

papers.title: The atoll gap: area, governance, and the under-recognition of a major coral reef system
papers.authors: Wegmann, Alex; Long, Graham; Abraham, Chloe; Cannon Byington, Cara; DeBrum-Kattil, Dolores; Hawley, Ryan; Hemming, Victoria; Izal, Vaitea; Lelong, Hereiti; McKeon, Sea
papers.abstract: Global assessments project widespread coral reef degradation under continued ocean warming and acidification, underscoring the urgent need to identify and account for the full diversity of coral reef systems within conservation planning. Atolls are dynamic reef-ocean-land systems whose persistence depends on coral reef sediment production, land-sea connectivity, and cross-ecosystem nutrient subsidies. Some atoll reef environments may also support coral assemblages with elevated thermal tolerance which could mean atolls are, and will increasingly be, important local-to-regional coral sources as global and local impacts continue to limit corals. Using a curated dataset of 310 Indo-Pacific atolls and high-resolution global coral reefscape mapping from the Allen Coral Atlas, we show that 309 Indo-Pacific atolls contain 27,211 km 2 of mapped shallow reefscape, representing 41.5% of all Indo-Pacific reef area and 7.8 percent of global mapped shallow reefscape area. This spatial accounting places Indo-Pacific atolls among the world’s major coral reefscape networks by area. We interpret this result alongside literature on atoll ecology, geomorphology, and governance to suggest that atoll-associated reefs merit more explicit consideration in Indo-Pacific coral reef conservation planning, while recognizing that additional comparative evidence on conservation finance, monitoring, protection, and governance would be needed to directly quantify under-recognition.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用310个印度-太平洋atoll数据集与Allen Coral Atlas高分辨率珊瑚礁景观制图，量化了atoll相关浅水礁区面积，发现309个atoll共含27,211 km²浅水礁景，占印度-太平洋礁区总面积的41.5%及全球已制图浅水礁景的7.8%，使其在面积上跻身全球主要珊瑚礁景观网络之列。结合atoll生态学、地貌学与治理文献，作者指出atoll相关珊瑚礁在印度-太平洋珊瑚礁保护规划中应获得更明确的重视，但其被低估的程度仍需通过保护融资、监测、保护与治理等方面的比较证据加以直接量化。

papers.title: Shifts in spawning patterns in three species of reef-building corals in the Mexican Caribbean
papers.authors: Francisco-Ramos, Vanessa; Acosta-González, Gilberto; Banaszak, Anastazia T.
papers.abstract: Most Caribbean reef-building corals reproduce by broadcast spawning numerous egg-and-sperm bundles simultaneously into the water column prior to external fertilization. This is a pivotal bottleneck in the lifecycle of broadcast-spawning organisms because it relies on the synchronization of gamete release to precise species-specific nights and times. However, changes in spawning patterns have been documented in a wide variety of species from different oceans. In recent years we have also detected variations in spawning dates of three reef-building species relative to historical windows, which led us to analyze the Mexican Caribbean spawning database. Our aim was to assess whether a temporal shift in spawning phenology has occurred in Acropora palmata, Diploria labyrinthiformis and Orbicella faveolata and to determine if these reproductive patterns vary along a coastal development gradient. We detected statistically significant shifts in the spawning pattern and loss of synchrony in A. palmata but not in D. labyrinthiformis or O. faveolata over the last 19 years. Acropora palmata colonies located in reefs near urban areas lost spawning synchrony over time, whereas corals located in reefs near low coastal development, such as Punta Allen, based on three spawning nights over seven years, maintained their spawning window. The consequences of the loss in synchrony and shifts in coral spawning patterns in A. palmata are of major concern, particularly because, in combination with the loss in coral cover, they reduce the probability that natural fertilization takes place due to the Allee Effect. Therefore, human-assisted fertilization may be a valuable tool needed to help restore this reef-building species and the coral reef ecosystem.
papers.summary_cn: 基于墨西哥加勒比海19年珊瑚产卵数据库，分析了三种造礁珊瑚（Acropora palmata、Diploria labyrinthiformis和Orbicella faveolata）产卵物候的时间变化及其与海岸开发梯度的关系。结果显示，A. palmata的产卵模式发生显著偏移并丧失同步性，且该现象在靠近城市区域的礁区尤为明显，而D. labyrinthiformis和O. faveolata未检测到显著变化。产卵同步性丧失与珊瑚覆盖率下降叠加，可能因Allee效应降低自然受精概率，提示人工辅助受精或成为该物种及珊瑚礁生态系统恢复的必要手段。

papers.title: First report on the proliferation of the sessile vermetid Dendropoma cf. maximum in Southeast Sulawesi: synergistic impacts of nickel mining sedimentation and destructive fishing on coral reef phase-shifts
papers.authors: Purnama, Muhammad Fajar; Risfandi, Risfandi; Sudarno, Sudarno; Bahtiar, Bahtiar
papers.summary_cn: 首次报道印度尼西亚东南苏拉威西珊瑚礁中固着性蛇螺 Dendropoma cf. maximum 的大量增殖，推测镍矿开采沉积物与破坏性捕捞的协同作用驱动了珊瑚礁相变。

papers.title: A Caribbean bright spot coral reef exceeds thermal limits during the fourth global coral bleaching event
papers.authors: Carolan, Sophie; Baldock, Katherine C. R.; East, Holly; Fitzsimmons, Clare; Johnson, Jamie A.; Suggitt, Andrew J.; Guest, James R.
papers.abstract: Marine heatwaves are increasing in both frequency and intensity, exposing coral reefs to prolonged periods of thermal stress and driving recurrent mass coral bleaching. Nevertheless, coral decline remains heterogeneous, with some reefs maintaining unexpectedly high coral cover despite exposure to thermal and other environmental disturbances. This study analysed benthic community change across Banco Capiro in Tela Bay and the south-side reefs of Utila, Honduras, from 2013 to 2025, spanning the 3rd and 4th Global Coral Bleaching Events. Banco Capiro represents a moderately turbid, Caribbean bright spot for live hard coral cover, whereas Utila represents a more typical contemporary Caribbean reef system. Long-term benthic monitoring data, NOAA Coral Reef Watch thermal stress metrics, Generalised Additive Mixed Models and multivariate community analyses were used to quantify changes in benthic cover and community composition. Banco Capiro experienced repeated annual thermal stress, with Degree Heating Week values reaching 12 °C-weeks or above in 2017, 2019, 2020 and 2021, and nearing 20 °C-weeks in 2023 and 2024. Before 2023, live hard coral cover was high at Banco Capiro, averaging 45 ± 3% (mean ± SE), but declined to 4 ± 1% (mean ± SE) following the 4th Global Coral Bleaching Event. Macroalgal cover increased from 26 ± 4% (mean ± SE) to 44 ± 3% (mean ± SE), while turf algae increased from 6 ± 2% (mean ± SE) to 23 ± 8% (mean ± SE). Utila also experienced further coral loss after 2023, despite entering the event from an already lower-coral state. These findings indicate that previous persistence does not guarantee survival under more extreme disturbance.
papers.summary_cn: 研究分析了洪都拉斯Tela Bay的Banco Capiro（加勒比"亮点"珊瑚礁）与Utila南侧珊瑚礁2013–2025年间的底栖群落变化，跨越第3次和第4次全球珊瑚白化事件，结合长期监测数据、NOAA Coral Reef Watch热胁迫指标、GAMM及多元群落分析。Banco Capiro在2023年前活硬珊瑚覆盖度高达45±3%，尽管多次经历年际热胁迫（Degree Heating Week多次达12°C-weeks以上），但在第4次全球白化事件后骤降至4±1%，大型藻类与丝状藻类显著增加；Utila同样在2023年后进一步丧失珊瑚。结果表明，此前的珊瑚存续并不能保证其在更极端扰动下的存活。

papers.title: Marine habitat use and movement of sympatric anadromous Dolly Varden and Arctic Char in the Canadian Arctic
papers.authors: DePasquale, Simon; Smith, Rosie; Hitkolok, Eric; Dumond, Amanda; Thibault, Hannah; Weinstein, Spencer; Craig, Paul; Loewen, Tracey; Swanson, Heidi
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Inuit subsistence fishers in Kugluktuk, Nunavut, Canada, have noticed changes in the timing and locations of their catches of Arctic Char Salvelinus alpinus and northern form Dolly Varden S. malma malma (collectively referred to by the community as “char”) in the past ∼20 years. In response, an ongoing research program was formed to study char in partnership with the Kugluktuk Hunters and Trappers Organization. The occurrence of sympatric populations of anadromous Arctic Char and Dolly Varden is rare but was recently identified in Coronation Gulf, Nunavut, where char populations were conventionally understood to be composed of only Arctic Char. To date, no studies have compared use of marine habitats between sympatric anadromous Arctic Char and Dolly Varden. Our objective was to identify high-use areas for each species, provide a broad comparison of habitat use (riverine, estuarine, nearshore marine, offshore island marine, and offshore marine) between species, and assess differences between species in minimum total distance traveled as calculated from observed movements between receiver stations. Methods Between 2019 and 2023, we used acoustic telemetry to document the marine movements of sympatric anadromous Arctic Char and northern form Dolly Varden. Using network analysis, we investigated and compared the marine movements of individuals from each species that spent ≥28 d in the marine environment. Results We observed highest use of estuarine and nearshore habitats by both Arctic Char and Dolly Varden. Dolly Varden had significantly larger mean corrected node strength and residency index values at offshore island habitats compared with Arctic Char in 2020, 2021, and 2023. Dolly Varden used the offshore marine environment more than Arctic Char; however, differences were not significant. Median standardized (per hour detected) minimum distances that Arctic Char and Dolly Varden were detected traveling in the marine environment were 107 and 122 m, respectively. Data are provided to enable reanalyses with different marine residency thresholds. Conclusions Our findings indicate that stewardship of estuarine and nearshore marine habitats will benefit anadromous populations of Arctic Char and Dolly Varden near Kugluktuk. While we found that Dolly Varden had higher use of offshore marine habitats than Arctic Char, our results should be interpreted with caution because of low sample sizes and limited offshore receiver coverage. Our study provides a foundation for future research comparing the habitat use and ecology of sympatric anadromous forms of Arctic Char and Dolly Varden, which may support the development of species-specific restoration and stewardship measures.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以加拿大努纳武特Kugluktuk地区同域分布的溯河性北极红点鲑（Arctic Char）与北方式Dolly Varden为对象，利用2019–2023年声学遥测技术结合网络分析，比较两者在海洋生境中的移动与利用模式。结果显示两种鱼均主要利用河口和近岸生境，但Dolly Varden在离岸岛屿生境的节点强度和驻留指数显著高于北极红点鲑，且更频繁利用离岸海洋环境。研究表明河口与近岸海洋生境的保护对两者均有益，但离岸生境利用差异需谨慎解读（样本量小、接收器覆盖有限），为后续同域溯河鱼类的生境利用与生态比较研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Novel ladder-shaped polyether toxin from Karenia selliformis: partial structural characterization and bioactivity
papers.authors: Nakashima, Motoya; Watanabe, Ryuichi; Uchida, Hajime; Suzuki, Shigekatsu; Kawachi, Masanobu; Tsunematsu, Yuta; Tsuge, Yuichiro; Sakai, Ryuichi; Fujita, Masaki J.
papers.summary_cn: 从Karenia selliformis中分离获得一种新型梯状聚醚毒素，并对其进行了部分结构表征及生物活性测试。

papers.title: Larger and more abundant legal-sized targeted fish inside ‘no take’ areas of a subtropical marine park over a 12-year period
papers.authors: Malcolm, Hamish A.; Rees, Matthew J.; Schultz, Arthur L.; Harasti, David; Graham, Kate; Chyriwsky, Sarah; Knott, Nathan A.
papers.abstract: Context Multiple-use marine parks vary spatially in how they are managed, which may influence ecological response over time. Aims We surveyed four key targeted species (snapper, Chrysophrys auratus; pearl perch, Glaucosoma scapulare; venus tuskfish, Choerodon venustus; grey morwong, Nemadactylus douglasi) during winter of 6 years between 2010 and 2023 to examine management influence on abundance and length. Methods Using stereo-baited remote underwater video (BRUVs), we compared relative abundance, occurrence at legal and sublegal sizes, and length in three types of management areas within and adjacent a subtropical marine park (‘no take’; ‘partially protected’; and ‘outside’) over time by using generalised linear mixed models. ‘Partially protected’ and ‘outside’ are fished areas, managed under spatial or fishery management rules (i.e. legal-size limits). Key results Snapper, pearl perch, and venus tuskfish were consistently more abundant and larger in ‘no take’ areas than in fished areas, especially legal-sized or larger individuals (&gt;30 cm). Grey morwong showed a weak response in its abundance among management areas but was larger within the marine park. The abundance of targeted fish also fluctuated among years, indicating complex ecological dynamics. Conclusions Overall, ‘no take’ effects were strong and consistent across the study period. Implications The study has demonstrated the value of long-term monitoring to inform fishing activities and management strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 在亚热带海洋公园内，通过2010—2023年间6个冬季的stereo-BRUVs调查，比较了no take、partially protected和outside三类管理区中四种目标鱼类的相对丰度和体长。结果显示，snapper、pearl perch和venus tuskfish在no take区的丰度和体长持续高于捕捞区，尤其是达到法定尺寸（>30 cm）的个体；grey morwong丰度响应较弱，但在海洋公园内体长更大。研究表明no take区的保护效应在12年间稳定存在，长期监测对渔业管理具有重要价值。

papers.title: From Mechanized Longlines to Smart Fisheries: Integrating Automation, Electronic Monitoring, and Artificial Intelligence
papers.authors: Kwon, Inyeong; Hwang, Bo-Kyu; Lee, Jihoon
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Longline fisheries harvest high-value pelagic and demersal species but remain labor-intensive and require reliable monitoring of catches, bycatch, and fishing effort. This technology-oriented narrative review synthesizes 71 sources on mechanization, automation, electronic monitoring (EM), artificial intelligence (AI), and prospective smart fisheries. Evidence is distinguished by source type, application setting, and operational maturity. Mechanized hauling, baiting, and integrated autoline systems support fishing operations, whereas EM provides records for catch verification and management. Computer vision studies demonstrate catch-event detection, species classification, and selected compliance-monitoring tasks, but reported performance remains specific to the datasets and validation conditions. Commercial availability, experimental performance, and conceptual feasibility are therefore assessed separately. Edge AI, integrated intelligent reporting, digital twins, and generative AI remain emerging or prospective for longline fisheries in the reviewed evidence. The synthesis identifies camera visibility, cross-vessel generalization, rare-species detection, interoperability, and data governance as key constraints. A practical development pathway combines established equipment and EM with externally validated AI, expert review, and feedback to subsequent vessel operations. Increased fishing efficiency alone does not establish sustainability; environmental and management outcomes require separate evaluation.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述以延绳钓渔业为对象，综合71项文献，梳理了机械化起线、自动钓机等装备自动化、electronic monitoring（EM）及artificial intelligence（AI）在捕捞监测中的应用现状与成熟度。研究表明，机械化和EM已较成熟，可用于渔获核验与管理，而计算机视觉在渔获事件检测、种类识别和合规监测中已有验证，但性能受数据集和验证条件限制。edge AI、digital twins等仍处概念或新兴阶段，相机可视性、跨船泛化、稀有物种检测、互操作性和数据治理是主要瓶颈；捕捞效率提升不等于可持续性，环境与管理成效需单独评估。

papers.title: Fish 3D Clustering App (F3DCA): A Non-Supervised Clustering Method with a Machine Learning Autoencoder for Analyzing 3D Trajectories of Three Fish Species
papers.authors: Farhan, Ali; Audira, Gilbert; Luong, Cao Thang; Hung, Chih-Hsin; Ger, Tzong-Rong; Hsiao, Chung-Der
papers.abstract: Fish behaviors are widely studied in various research fields due to their relevance to many aspects, including neurodegenerative processes, since they can impair motor control, complex behavior, habituation, and response to environmental stimuli. 3D locomotion trajectory analysis is one of the assays to analyze complex behaviors in fish. However, while existing 3D tracking software can capture the 3D trajectories of fish, they still rely heavily on manual or semi-automated analysis. Moreover, traditional analysis methods are inadequate for handling the high complexity of raw 3D data (X, Y, Z coordinates), and manual/semi-automated procedures introduce subjective human bias and are highly time-consuming, highlighting the need for a fully automated, unsupervised machine learning method. Here, we aimed to develop an unsupervised clustering method with machine learning to automatically analyze fish behaviors by using fish 3D coordinates. To evaluate the performance of this method, five different datasets, including (1) interspecies fish that consisted of three fish species, which were Danio rerio, Oryzias woworae, and Kryptopterus vitreolus, (2) shoal sex composition, (3) caudal fin amputation effect, (4) habituation time effect, and (5) acute ethanol exposure effect on zebrafish behaviors, were analyzed. The current method utilizes multiple clustering algorithms, including K-Means, BIRCH, Gaussian Mixture Model, and Spectral Clustering, which were then applied to the 3D trajectory data in every dataset. Afterward, the clustering performance was evaluated using the Silhouette Score and Davies–Bouldin Index, followed by the use of deep-learning autoencoders to improve latent feature representation and enhance cluster separation. The clustering outcomes were further compared with predefined experimental groups using ARI and NMI and were qualitatively interpreted alongside conventional behavioral endpoints. External agreement varied among datasets and clustering algorithms. The proposed method can characterize differences in zebrafish 3D locomotor trajectory patterns across experimental conditions, while its separation power may decrease when behavioral differences are subtle or highly overlapping. Furthermore, the present study evaluated the method using multiple behavioral datasets; a similar framework can be extended to zebrafish models of neurodegenerative disease to identify disease-associated alterations in movement patterns and neurobehavioral organization. Finally, a user-friendly software package with easy installation and readable trajectory-analysis outputs was also developed that can be useful in biomedical research.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在开发一种无监督机器学习聚类方法，利用鱼类3D轨迹坐标自动分析行为，以克服传统人工/半自动分析的主观性和低效性。方法整合K-Means、BIRCH、高斯混合模型和谱聚类算法，并引入深度学习autoencoder优化潜在特征表示与聚类分离，在五个数据集（三种鱼种间比较、群体性别组成、尾鳍截断、习惯化时间、急性乙醇暴露）上评估性能。结果表明，该方法能表征不同实验条件下斑马鱼3D运动轨迹模式的差异，但当行为差异细微或高度重叠时分离能力下降。该框架可扩展至神经退行性疾病模型的运动模式与神经行为组织分析，并已开发出用户友好的软件包。

papers.title: An Early Neolithic Burial with a Miniature Fish-Shaped Bait on the Shore of Lake Baikal
papers.authors: Kichigin, D. E.; Kharinsky, A. V.
papers.abstract: We introduce finds from burial 3 at Khuzhir-Nuge-9 in the Olkhon area. Data on the location, above-ground burial structure (oval pavement ~3.5 m in diameter), grave (oval, 37 cm deep pit), funerary rite (inhumation on the right side with flexed legs, head oriented toward the north, burial strewn with ocher), and grave goods are provided. Clusters of tools and separate stone and bone artifacts, found in different parts of the grave, are described. Typical items include a robust bone tool, an end-scraper, microblades, and retouched and unretouched flakes made from jasper, chalcedony, flint, etc. The most expressive find is a miniature bait made from chert and shaped like a fish. The distribution area of stone figurines of fish in the Baikal area is outlined, their dates are provided, and opinions about their function are cited. Experts view these peculiar items as fishing baits. On the basis of the radiocarbon date of the burial and other sites on Lake Baikal shore, we conclude that such baits were used in this area from the Early Neolithic to the Middle Neolithic, i.e., in the 6th and 5th millennia BC.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究报告了贝加尔湖Olkhon地区Khuzhir-Nuge-9遗址第3号墓葬的发掘成果，描述了墓葬结构、葬式及随葬品组合，其中最具代表性的是一件燧石质鱼形微型钓饵。结合放射性碳测年及贝加尔湖沿岸其他遗址资料，作者认为此类鱼形石制品作为钓饵使用的时间跨度为新石器时代早期至中期（公元前6—5千年）。

papers.title: Production of African House Fly (Musca Domestica) Maggots using Decomposed Wastes, Cow Dung and Sawdust as a Sustainable Protein Source for Poultry, Fish and Pig Feeds:
papers.authors: Akol, Benard
papers.abstract: The escalating cost of fishmeal and soybean meal threatens poultry, fish and pig production in Uganda. While poor waste management is affecting fish production in lakes and rivers, human and animal feeds require the same fish. Farmers involved in maggot production, are using black soldier flies. This study evaluated a low-cost maggot production using African house flies that are resistant to the temperature variations. Market waste were collected from Awindiri Market dustbin, crushed and placed in a sealed drum for anaerobic decomposition for 7-18 days. The decomposed matter was exposed to wild African house flies (Musca domestica) for natural oviposition. Egg-laden substrate was transferred to open rearing containers and mixed with cow dung and sawdust to enhance growth. Maggots grew to 0.5 to 1.0 inch within 7-14 days, harvested by sieving, sorting and washing. Average 10 kg of waste substrate yielded between 2-4 kg of fresh maggots. Maggots were fed directly to poultry and pigs, showing high palatability. Excess maggots were preserved in a freezer and thawed at 21-36°C before feeding, ensuring continuous availability. The system is simple, low-cost, environmentally friendly, converting market waste into high-quality protein. It is recommended for adoption by farmers in Uganda.
papers.summary_cn: 为缓解乌干达鱼粉和豆粕价格高企对畜禽及水产养殖的制约，本研究评估了利用非洲家蝇（Musca domestica）进行低成本蝇蛆生产的可行性。将市场废弃物厌氧分解7–18天后暴露于野生家蝇自然产卵，卵基物转入开放容器并与牛粪、锯末混合促进幼虫生长。7–14天内幼虫长至0.5–1.0英寸，平均10 kg废弃基质可产2–4 kg鲜蛆，直接饲喂禽猪适口性良好，多余蝇蛆冷冻保存后解冻饲喂。该系统简单、低成本、环境友好，可将市场废弃物转化为优质蛋白，适合乌干达养殖户推广。

papers.title: Bacterial Taxonomic Profiling of Freshwater Fish Across Hydrographic Basins of Kazakhstan
papers.authors: Kumar, Marat; Kasymbekov, Yermukhammet; Khan, Yelizaveta; Suleimenova, Symbat; Nuralibekov, Sardor; Sabyrzhan, Temirlan; Yessentureyeva, Meruyert; Isbekov, Kuanysh; Assylbekova, Saule; Kirichenko, Olga
papers.abstract: Bacterial taxonomic profiles associated with freshwater fish in Kazakhstan remain poorly characterized. We characterized bacterial sequence profiles from 193 apparently healthy wild freshwater fish representing six families and six major hydrographic basins. Gill, kidney, spleen, and liver tissues were combined into 20 pooled samples, and RNA-derived double-stranded cDNA libraries were analyzed for bacterial taxonomic assignments. Pseudomonadota (51.9%) and Actinomycetota (29.5%) showed the highest mean relative sequence abundances, followed by Bacillota (8.3%), Bacteroidota (4.9%), and Fusobacteriota (2.7%). Alpha diversity did not differ significantly among basins. In separate PERMANOVA models, basin accounted for 33.6% of variation in genus-level profiles but was not significant (R2 = 0.336, p = 0.0555), while fish family accounted for 25.3% (R2 = 0.253, p = 0.5472). In the joint model, basin showed a significant marginal effect after accounting for fish family (R2 = 0.346, p = 0.0338), whereas fish family remained nonsignificant. Seventeen genera met the operational core criteria. Selected potentially health-relevant sequence assignments included Escherichia coli, Salmonella enterica, Aeromonas spp., and Stenotrophomonas maltophilia. These sequence-based detections do not establish organism viability or active infection. Overall, these findings provide baseline information on fish-associated bacterial taxonomic profiles across Kazakhstan’s major freshwater systems.
papers.summary_cn: 为填补哈萨克斯坦淡水鱼细菌分类谱系的研究空白，本研究对来自6个科、6大水文流域的193尾表观健康野生淡水鱼，将鳃、肾、脾、肝组织合并为20个混合样本，通过RNA来源双链cDNA文库进行细菌分类分析。结果显示Pseudomonadota（51.9%）和Actinomycetota（29.5%）平均相对序列丰度最高，α多样性在各流域间无显著差异；联合模型中流域在控制鱼科后呈显著边际效应（R²=0.346，p=0.0338），而鱼科不显著，17个属符合操作性核心标准，并检出Escherichia coli、Salmonella enterica、Aeromonas spp.和Stenotrophomonas maltophilia等潜在健康相关序列。上述序列检测不能确定菌体活性或活动性感染，结果为哈萨克斯坦主要淡水系统的鱼类相关细菌分类谱系提供了基线信息。

papers.title: How safe from Listeria monocytogenes are frozen ready-to-eat fish products, either cooked or smoked, when stored under refrigeration after purchasing?
papers.authors: Tavares, Mayara S.; Paulino, Patrícia G.; Juliano, Daniele S.; Laureano-Melo, Roberto; Santos, Huarrisson A.; Luchese, Rosa H.
papers.abstract: Abstract This research aimed to access the incidence of Listeria sp. and L. monocytogenes in frozen ready-to-eat (RTE) fish products immediately after purchasing, and after refrigerated storage. Out of 72 kani-kama samples, 17 (23,6%) and 16 out of 48 samples (33,3%) of smoked salmon samples, tested positive for Listeria sp. by the traditional culture method, whereas 45,8% and 56.2% were positive by PCR, for kani-kama and smoked salmon samples, respectively. Applying qPCR, 21 samples of kani-kama out of 72 (29.2%) and 23 out of 48 samples of smoked and sliced salmon (47.9%) were positive for L. monocytogenes . Quantification was performed by culture to account only for viable cells, and confirmation was carried out via PCR and qPCR for Listeria sp. and L. monocytogenes , respectively. The average counts of L. monocytogenes did not exceed 2 Log CFU/g, both in kani-kama or smoked salmon. However, 15.3% of individual kani-kama samples and 14,6% of smoked salmon samples showed counts of up to 3.2 Log CFU/g, some even immediately after purchasing. Higher number of positive samples was observed during refrigerated storage compared to the number of samples analysed immediately after purchasing, indicating that refrigeration for a long time can pose an additional health threat. Unlike kani-kama, which is a heat-processed product, a higher background microbiota count was detected in smoked salmon. However, this background microbiota apparently did not influence the growth of Listeria spp.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在调查冷冻即食（RTE）鱼制品（kani-kama与烟熏三文鱼）在购买后即刻及冷藏储存后Listeria sp.和L. monocytogenes的污染情况。采用传统培养法、PCR及qPCR进行定性与定量检测，结果显示两类产品中L. monocytogenes平均菌数均未超过2 Log CFU/g，但部分样品（kani-kama 15.3%、烟熏三文鱼14.6%）高达3.2 Log CFU/g，且冷藏储存后阳性样品数多于购买时，提示长期冷藏可能增加健康风险。烟熏三文鱼背景微生物数量较高，但未明显影响Listeria spp.的生长。

papers.title: Waterborne gill-toxic potency as an effect-based endpoint for monitoring fish-killing harmful algal blooms
papers.authors: Mardones, Jorge I.
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish-killing harmful algal blooms (HABs) continue to inflict severe economic losses on marine aquaculture worldwide, yet monitoring systems designed around microalgal cell counts frequently fail to anticipate acute mortality events. The dominant surveillance paradigm was inherited from shellfish-toxin monitoring, where a filter-feeding bivalve integrates exposure to intracellular phycotoxins and toxin burden in tissue triggers regulatory action. This architecture is structurally non-transferable to fish-killing HABs, since fish are exposed directly through their gills to a dynamic water mass in which the relevant compounds are predominantly extracellular, conditionally produced, and structurally unresolved for most ichthyotoxic taxa. Field evidence from the 2016 Pseudochattonella verruculosa event in Chile and the 2024 non-toxic Prymnesium parvum bloom in the Oder River, both at high cell densities but with contrasting mortality outcomes, confirms that abundance and hazard are not equivalent. This Perspective proposes that operational monitoring should progress toward a tiered effect-based framework centred on waterborne gill-toxic potency, defined as the measurable capacity of a water mass to damage fish-gill tissue under environmentally relevant exposure. The framework combines depth-resolved sampling, standardised gill-cell assays applied to paired water fractions, and effect-directed analysis coupled with non-target high-resolution mass spectrometry for chemical discovery. Its wider contribution is to formally connect fish-killing HAB science with the ecotoxicology of emerging contaminants, closing an epistemic delay recognised institutionally by the IOC-UNESCO Task Team on Fish-Killing Microalgae. Substantial validation is required before the framework can support regulatory decisions, and the priorities for that work are set out here.
papers.summary_cn: 有害藻华（HABs）监测长期沿用贝类毒素监测范式，以微藻细胞计数为核心，但鱼类通过鳃直接暴露于以胞外、条件性产生且结构多未明确的致毒化合物中，丰度与危害并不等同（如2016年智利Pseudochattonella verruculosa事件与2024年奥得河无毒Prymnesium parvum藻华的对比）。本文提出以水体鳃毒性效价（waterborne gill-toxic potency）为核心的分层效应监测框架，整合深度分层采样、标准化鳃细胞assay及效应导向分析与非靶向高分辨质谱的化学发现，旨在将杀鱼HAB研究与新污染物生态毒理学衔接，并明确了该框架投入监管应用前所需的验证重点。

papers.title: A novel ribotype of Margalefidinium polykrikoides, South China Sea ribotype (V), caused the massive fish-killing dinoflagellate bloom off the west coast of Hainan Island, China in 2026
papers.authors: Cen, Jingyi; Sun, Guowei; Zhang, Peili; Qiao, Qi; Xu, Xiaobei; Huang, Wenguo; Han, Taosheng; Gu, Haifeng; Lü, Songhui
papers.summary_cn: 2026年海南岛西海岸发生大规模致鱼类死亡甲藻赤潮，经鉴定其肇事种为多环旋沟藻（Margalefidinium polykrikoides）的一个新核糖体型，命名为南海核糖体型（V）。该发现揭示了中国南海存在此前未记录的高毒性赤潮核糖型，对区域有害藻华监测与渔业灾害预警具有重要意义。

papers.title: Estimating Fish Body Weight from Morphological Features Using Some Data Mining Algorithms
papers.authors: Çelik, Şenol; Yakubu, Abdulmojeed; Makarenko, Alina; Kononenko, Ruslan; Kononenko, Iryna; Getya, Andriy; Matvieiev, Mykhailo; Hryshchenko, Nataliia; Zamaratskaia, Galia
papers.abstract: The objective was to compare the performance of various data mining algorithms in estimating the body weight of fish. The effects of age, farm type and body morphological characteristics on the body weight of the hybrid silver carp (Hypophthalmichthys spp.) were analyzed using some data mining methods. The body weight of the fish was predicted using different morphological measurements taken during its lifetime and after slaughter. Prediction performances of the Chi-Squared Automatic Interaction Detector (CHAID), Classification and Regression Trees (CART), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Random Forest (RF), and Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS) algorithms were compared. The prediction capabilities of the fitted models were assessed using model fit statistics. The MARS algorithm was demonstrated to be the most effective model for characterizing body weight. Body length showed the greatest relative importance among all traits measured during the fish’s lifetime. When the body length of fish exceeds 145 mm, the body weight is expected to reach 173 g. The MARS algorithm is the most effective model for predicting the body weight of fish, based on the experimental data. It provides an excellent alternative to existing data mining techniques.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在比较多种 data mining 算法在估算鱼类体重方面的表现，以 hybrid silver carp 为对象，分析年龄、养殖类型及形态特征对体重的影响。研究采用 CHAID、CART、ANN、RF 和 MARS 等算法，基于鱼体生命周期内及屠宰后的形态测量数据进行体重预测。结果表明 MARS 算法预测效果最佳，体长在所有形态性状中相对重要性最高，当体长超过 145 mm 时体重预计可达 173 g。MARS 算法可作为现有 data mining 技术的有效替代方法用于鱼类体重预测。

papers.title: Reef fish assemblages on Acropora patches in the Colombian Caribbean: resistance to reef degradation
papers.authors: García-Urueña, Rocio; Sierra-Escrigas, Silvia L.; Acero P, Arturo
papers.abstract: Coral reefs are crucial habitats for many fish species because they serve as feeding and shelter sites. However, due to their sensitivity to environmental changes, reef degradation has led to a drastic decline in fish and reef assemblages, which has also been reflected in associated economic activities. The loss of branching corals Acropora palmata and A. cervicornis has reached up to 90% in the Colombian Caribbean, resulting in a reduction in the abundance and diversity of associated fish populations. During two time periods (2011–2012 and 2023–2024) across the Colombian Caribbean, fish associated with Acropora formations were evaluated in relation to patch size and health status of these coral species. The best conserved patches of A. palmata were found in the Tayrona National Natural Park (TNNP) and of A. cervicornis in the reefs of the Urabá Gulf. A total of 113 fish species from 34 families were associated with A. palmata , with the most represented families being Labridae, Haemulidae, Pomacentridae, and Serranidae. Acanthurus coeruleus, A. tractus, Chaetodon ocellatus, Haemulon flavolineatum, Scarus iseri , Sparisoma viride , Thalassoma bifasciatum, Abudefduf saxatilis , Microspathodon chrysurus , Stegastes adustus , and Canthigaster rostrata were the species common to all reef locations. In A. cervicornis formations, 78 species belonging to 25 families were recorded, with Labridae and Pomacentridae as the most abundant. Stegastes planifrons , Cephalopholis cruentata, and Hypoplectrus puella were the species common to all locations. The highest number of fish species was found in the TNNP (85 for A. palmata , 55 for A. cervicornis ). Although the status is critical throughout the Caribbean, further aggravated by the 2023–2024 bleaching event which caused A. palmata formations to practically disappear from two localities, this structural loss has not yet been reflected in the associated ichthyofauna. These results suggest that the fish assemblages linked to Acropora corals in the Colombian Caribbean remain relatively stable; however, it is unclear for how long they will persist.
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估了哥伦比亚加勒比海两处造礁珊瑚 *Acropora palmata* 和 *A. cervicornis* 斑块上的鱼类群落，比较了2011–2012年与2023–2024年两个时期鱼类组成与珊瑚斑块大小及健康状况的关系。结果显示，*A. palmata* 斑块共记录34科113种鱼类，*A. cervicornis* 斑块记录25科78种，Tayrona国家自然公园（TNNP）鱼类种类最多。尽管2023–2024年白化事件导致部分地点 *A. palmata* 斑块几近消失，但关联鱼类群落尚未表现出相应的结构衰退，其长期持续性仍不确定。

papers.title: Hybrid catfish production and water quality in split-pond systems at two fish-basin hydraulic retention times
papers.authors: Luna, Trevor; Roy, Luke A; Kelly, Anita M; Park, Jeonghwan; Brown, Travis W
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To compare production performance and water quality responses of hybrid catfish (female Channel Catfish Ictalurus punctatus × male Blue Catfish I. furcatus) in split-pond systems (SPS) operated at two fish-basin hydraulic retention times (HRT; 2 h versus 4 h) and to present a feed-based circulation coefficient (FCC) linking hourly circulation capacity to late-cycle daily feeding intensity. Methods A 6-month production trial was conducted in six 0.2-ha SPS ponds (20% fish basin, 80% treatment basin) circulated by slow-rotating paddlewheels. Three ponds were operated at a 2-h fish-basin HRT and three at a 4-h HRT. Hybrid catfish were stocked at 30,000 fish/ha and fed a 28% protein floating diet to apparent satiation once daily. Production outcomes were summarized as pond-level means with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Water quality responses were evaluated using linear mixed-effects models with HRT treatment, sampling date, and their interaction as fixed effects and individual ponds as a random intercept. Results Final biomass averaged 16,451 ± 2,081 kg/ha (2-h HRT) and 14,341 ± 3,824 kg/ha (4-h HRT), with confidence intervals overlapping widely across all production metrics. Mean influent–effluent differences for total ammonia nitrogen, nitrite-N, and total nitrogen remained near zero and showed no consistent treatment separation. The FCC values were 6.98 m3·h−1 per (kg·d−1) for the 2-h HRT treatment and 2.01 m3·h−1 per (kg·d−1) for the 4-h HRT treatment. Conclusion Comparable production and water quality outcomes across both HRT treatments indicate that the circulation rates tested were within an adequate operating range for the imposed biological loading. The principal limitation is the small number of replicate ponds, reflected in wide confidence intervals. The FCC provides a consistent practical metric for benchmarking circulation capacity relative to late-cycle feeding intensity in SPS design and operation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了两种鱼池水力停留时间（HRT，2 h vs. 4 h）下 split-pond systems（SPS）中 hybrid catfish（雌性 Channel Catfish × 雄性 Blue Catfish）的生产性能与水质响应，并提出了基于投饵的循环系数（FCC）。6个月养殖试验在6口0.2 ha SPS池塘中进行，放养密度30,000尾/ha，结果表明两种HRT处理的最终生物量（16,451 vs. 14,341 kg/ha）及总氨氮、亚硝酸盐氮、总氮的进出水差异均无一致分离，置信区间大幅重叠。研究表明所测试的循环速率均在适宜运行范围内，但重复池塘数少导致置信区间较宽；FCC为SPS设计中循环能力与后期投饵强度的对标提供了实用指标。

papers.title: Dietary Curd-fermented Rice Bran Improves Growth, Digestibility and Nutrient Utilisation in Labeo gonius (Hamilton, 1822) under Hill Aquaculture Conditions of Meghalaya, India
papers.authors: Debnath, Chandan; Singh, S. Gojendro; Tayung, Tasso; Ghatak, Sandeep; Mahanta, Prasanta
papers.abstract: Background: Rice bran has limited nutritional utility in carp diets owing to high crude fibre and phytic acid content, which fermentation can effectively reduce. The present study evaluated the effect of dietary curd-fermented rice bran (FRB) at graded inclusion levels on growth performance, organ indices, digestibility and muscle composition of Labeo gonius fingerlings under hill aquaculture conditions of Meghalaya. Methods: Three isoproteic (~25% crude protein) and isolipidic diets, T1 (0% FRB, control), T2 (50% FRB) and T3 (100% FRB), were fed to fingerlings (initial mean weight 5.42±0.31 g; 30 fish/tank) over 60 days in a completely randomised design with three replicates. Rice bran was fermented using fresh curd (Lactobacillus spp., 10 % w/w) and baker’s yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae, 3 % w/w) at 25±2°C for 48 hr under near-anaerobic conditions, reducing crude fibre from 12.60% to 9.20% and increasing crude protein from 12.20% to 15.80%, with pH declining from 6.2 to 4.0 confirming active fermentation. Result: T3 recorded the highest SGR (2.45±0.06%/day) and ADC for crude protein (86.1±2.2%), with the lowest FCR (1.98±0.06) and HSI (1.44±0.11%), while muscle crude protein was significantly highest in T3 (61.4±1.1% dw); all growth and digestibility parameters differed significantly (p≤0.05) among treatments, with survival and water quality remaining unaffected across dietary groups. These findings indicate that complete replacement of unfermented rice bran with curd-fermented rice bran improved growth performance, feed conversion efficiency and nutrient digestibility in L. gonius under Meghalaya hill aquaculture conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了凝乳发酵米糠（FRB）在印度梅加拉亚邦山地养殖条件下对 Labeo gonius 鱼种生长、消化率及肌肉组成的影响。米糠经乳酸菌和酿酒酵母发酵48 h后，粗纤维从12.60%降至9.20%，粗蛋白从12.20%升至15.80%。60天投喂试验表明，100% FRB替代组（T3）获得最高 SGR（2.45%/d）和粗蛋白 ADC（86.1%），FCR 最低（1.98），肌肉粗蛋白显著最高（61.4% dw），且存活率与水质不受影响。结果表明，凝乳发酵米糠完全替代未发酵米糠可改善 L. gonius 的生长性能、饲料转化效率和养分消化率。

papers.title: Digital Trend Analysis and Forecasting of Sustainable Hydroponic and Aquaponic Systems: Global and Türkiye-Based Perspectives on Aquaculture Integration (2015–2028)
papers.authors: Olgunoğlu, İlkan Ali; Çokkızgın, Alihan
papers.abstract: Climate change and the depletion of freshwater resources are increasing the global importance of sustainable food production systems, particularly soilless agriculture (hydroponics) and integrated aquaculture-based plant production (aquaponics). This study aims to provide a comparative analysis of public awareness and digital interest trends related to these “green” and “blue” agricultural technologies at both global and national (Türkiye) scales. Relative Search Volume (RSV) data obtained from Google Trends (GT) for the 2015–2026 period were used. Without applying additional transformation, and in order to preserve periodic shocks in information-seeking behavior and natural variance, future projections up to 2028 were generated using the Exponential Smoothing (ETS) algorithm. The findings indicate that digital interest in hydroponic systems has reached a higher and more continuous level both globally and in Türkiye, suggesting greater public visibility and sustained online attention, with peak RSV values reaching 100. Conversely, while interest in aquaponic systems is concentrated in water-stressed regions and island nations globally, it follows a markedly low and flat trajectory (0–5 index) in Türkiye, indicating a prominent digital awareness gap. These findings should be interpreted as indicators of public attention and digital visibility rather than direct evidence of physical adoption or sectoral implementation. Within this scope, the study provides a comparative digital perspective on the online visibility of emerging sustainable production systems and highlights the relevance of interdisciplinary discussion around aquaculture-linked food production in Türkiye.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于Google Trends 2015–2026年相对搜索量数据，采用指数平滑（ETS）算法预测至2028年，比较全球与土耳其范围内水培（hydroponics）和鱼菜共生（aquaponics）系统的数字关注趋势。结果显示，水培系统的数字关注度在全球和土耳其均处于较高且持续的水平（RSV峰值达100），而鱼菜共生关注度虽在全球缺水地区和岛国集中，但在土耳其呈显著低平态势（指数0–5），存在明显的数字认知差距。研究强调上述指标反映的是公众关注度与数字可见性，而非实际采用或产业实施的直接证据。

papers.title: Nanoparticles in shrimp aquaculture: applications in nutrition, disease management, diagnostics and biosafety
papers.authors: Porselvan S.; Saravanan S.; Kaviarasu D.; Selvaraj S.; Sudhan C.; Kumar E., Senthil; Kumar D., Navin; Dhinesh P.
papers.abstract: Nanotechnology has emerged as a promising approach to improve nutrition, health management, disease control and pathogen detection in shrimp aquaculture. This review evaluates nano-enabled applications in penaeid shrimp, with particular emphasis on nutrition and feed utilisation, immunomodulation and antioxidant responses, disease management, biosafety and rapid diagnostics. A critical narrative search of Google Scholar, PubMed, Scopus and Wiley Online Library was conducted up to 31 July 2026, with emphasis on direct in vivo evidence from penaeid shrimp. Nano-minerals, polymeric carriers, nanoencapsulated phytogenic compounds and mechanically reduced nano-enabled biological materials have shown potential to enhance growth, feed utilisation and physiological responses. Metallic and bimetallic nanoparticles have demonstrated antibacterial and antiviral activity, while nanocarriers have facilitated the oral delivery of bioactive compounds, antiviral proteins and nucleic acids. Gold nanoparticle-based platforms have also enabled rapid detection of important shrimp pathogens, particularly white spot syndrome virus. However, the biological performance of nano-enabled formulations varies depending on formulation characteristics, active dose, route of administration and exposure regime, while excessive exposure to certain metallic nanoparticles may result in oxidative disturbance and tissue injury. Most of the available evidence has been generated under controlled experimental conditions, with limited information on long-term residues, environmental fate and farm-scale performance. Nano-enabled technologies represent promising application-specific tools for shrimp aquaculture, but their commercial adoption will depend on reproducible efficacy, reliable delivery, acceptable animal and environmental safety and validation under realistic farming conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估了纳米技术在斑节对虾（penaeid shrimp）养殖中营养、免疫调节、疾病管理、生物安全及快速诊断方面的应用，基于Google Scholar、PubMed等数据库中截至2026年7月的体内证据。纳米矿物质、聚合物载体、纳米包封植物源化合物等可改善生长与饲料利用，金属及双金属纳米颗粒具有抗菌抗病毒活性，金纳米颗粒平台可实现白斑综合征病毒（WSSV）等病原的快速检测。然而，纳米制剂的生物学效果受配方、剂量、给药途径等因素影响，过量暴露于某些金属纳米颗粒可致氧化损伤，且现有证据多来自受控实验，缺乏长期残留、环境归趋及养殖场规模验证数据。

papers.title: Comparative toxicities of leachates from aquaculture plastics and automobile tires in Dunaliella primolecta and Tigriopus japonicus
papers.authors: Ohara, Shizuka; Onduka, Toshimitsu; Fujimura, Taisei; Hirashima, Soichiro; Takeda, Kazuhiko; Koike, Kazuhiko
papers.abstract: Abstract The chemical impacts of synthetic polymer leachates on marine ecosystems are a growing concern. This study evaluated the acute ecotoxicity of leachates from three prevalent materials in Hiroshima Bay: polyethylene (PE) pipes used as aquaculture spacers, expanded polystyrene (EPS) used as floats, and automobile tires from road runoff and ship fenders. We exposed the marine microalga Dunaliella primolecta and the copepod Tigriopus japonicus to these leachates and characterized their chemical profiles using non-target gas chromatography–mass spectrometry screening. The results showed that PE and EPS leachates exerted negligible acute toxicity on both species at the maximum tested concentration (5.4 g/L), suggesting a low ecological risk under currently projected levels. Conversely, tire leachate exhibited significant toxicity, with median effective concentration (EC 50 ) values of 2.7 g/L for D. primolecta and 0.67 g/L for T. japonicus . This fourfold higher sensitivity in the copepod suggests a potential threat to crustacean recruitment. Chemical analysis identified tire-specific constituents, such as aniline, 1,3-benzothiazole, dicyclohexylamine, and N-phenyl- p -benzoquinone imine. These compounds may contribute to toxicity by inducing physiological stress in both primary producers and consumers. Our findings demonstrate that while the tested aquaculture plastics pose lower immediate chemical risks, unweathered tire-derived chemicals represent a significant latent threat to fishery resources in productive coastal ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了广岛湾三种常见材料（水产养殖用聚乙烯管道、发泡聚苯乙烯浮子及汽车轮胎）浸出液对海洋微藻 Dunaliella primolecta 和桡足类 Tigriopus japonicus 的急性毒性，并采用非靶向 GC-MS 进行化学表征。结果显示，PE 和 EPS 浸出液在最高测试浓度（5.4 g/L）下对两种生物均无显著急性毒性，而轮胎浸出液毒性显著，对微藻和桡足类的 EC50 分别为 2.7 g/L 和 0.67 g/L，桡足类敏感性高出约四倍。化学分析鉴定出苯胺、1,3-苯并噻唑等轮胎特有化合物，提示未风化轮胎源化学物质对沿岸渔业资源构成潜在威胁。

papers.title: Occlusion-aware multi-target fish tracking with persistence modeling and unity-based synthetic dataset
papers.authors: Wang, Bingsi; Wei, Xi; Zhang, Bohan; Wang, Jianrui; Chen, Yingyi; Gu, Zhuoer
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对多目标鱼类追踪中的遮挡问题，提出结合持续性建模与基于Unity生成的合成数据集的方法，以提升追踪鲁棒性。

papers.title: Alternative Feed Potential of Goldfish (Carassius auratus) Based Biofloc in the Nutrition of Freshwater Crayfish (Pontastacus leptodactylus) Juveniles
papers.authors: Özdoğan, Hasan Batuhan Emre; Sevgili, Hüseyin; Diken, Gürkan; Bahadır Koca, Seval; Koca, Habil Uğur; Erol, Kamile Gonca
papers.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the potential of goldfish (Carassius auratus)-based biofloc technology (BFT) biomass as an alternative feed source for freshwater crayfish (Pontastacus leptodactylus) juveniles. The experiment was conducted in a closed recirculating system over seven weeks, with four feeding groups and four replicates per group: control (commercial trout feed only), BFT (0.75 mL/L) + commercial feed, low-dose BFT (0.75 mL/L), and high-dose BFT (1.5 mL/L). Growth performance, specific growth rate (SGR), feed intake (FI), feed conversion ratio (FCR), and survival rate were assessed at the end of the trial. The results demonstrated that biofloc biomass alone was insufficient as a nutritional source for juveniles, with groups fed exclusively on biofloc exhibiting high mortality. In contrast, the combined application of biofloc and commercial feed did not adversely affect growth performance or survival rate, suggesting that biofloc may serve as a supplementary dietary additive. Water quality analyses revealed elevated nitrogen compound concentrations in biofloc tanks; however, pH, dissolved oxygen, and temperature remained within acceptable ranges throughout the trial. In conclusion, while biofloc biomass alone proved inadequate as a sole feed source for crustacean juveniles, its use in combination with commercial feed may represent a biologically and economically viable supplementary feeding strategy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了以金鱼（Carassius auratus）为基础的 biofloc 生物絮体作为淡水螯虾（Pontastacus leptodactylus）幼虾替代饲料的潜力，在封闭循环系统中开展为期七周的投喂试验，设置对照组、biofloc+商品饲料组、低剂量及高剂量 biofloc 组。结果表明，单独投喂 biofloc 不足以满足幼虾营养需求，死亡率高；而 biofloc 与商品饲料联用不影响生长性能与存活率，可作为补充性饲料添加剂。水质分析显示 biofloc 组氮化合物浓度升高，但 pH、溶解氧和温度均处于适宜范围。

papers.title: Spatial attention–driven hybrid Vision Transformers for automated classification of crown-of-thorns starfish in coral reef ecosystems
papers.authors: P., Yogasrinithi; P., Manikandan; K., Vasugi
papers.abstract: Coral reefs play the main role in marine ecology, as home and shelter to many aquatic species, and quite importantly, supporting local economies. The danger to coral reefs from coral bleaching is joined by Acanthaster planci invasions that can extensively harm these sensitive colonies. The normal practice has been the manual identification of these starfish by divers and snorkelers. This study proposes an automatic deep learning-based approach to detecting and classifying such species within their natural underwater environments. In its architectural setup, the system fashions advanced types of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) together with Vision Transformer (ViT) models. This study evaluated several pre-trained CNN and transformer models on the marine species dataset, achieving test classification accuracy of 91.80% for MobileNetV3-Small, 94.54% for VGG19, 94.54% for ResNet50, 95.90% for DenseNet121, 97.54% for Swin-Tiny, 97.54% for CrossViT, and 97.81% for FastViT-T8. The proposed Spatial-Attention Swin + FastViT + CrossViT framework achieved an overall test classification accuracy of 99.18%. It will also make the detection process much safer and faster, besides being more dependable in coral reef protection.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对棘冠海星（Acanthaster planci）入侵对珊瑚礁生态系统的破坏，提出了一种基于深度学习的自动化检测与分类方法，融合CNN与Vision Transformer（ViT）模型，并在海洋物种数据集上评估了多种预训练模型。结果显示，MobileNetV3-Small、VGG19、ResNet50、DenseNet121、Swin-Tiny、CrossViT和FastViT-T8的测试分类准确率分别为91.80%至97.81%，而所提出的Spatial-Attention Swin + FastViT + CrossViT框架达到99.18%的整体准确率。该方法可提升珊瑚礁保护中棘冠海星检测的安全性与效率。

papers.title: Multiscale pH fluctuations on a stable algal reef community (SE Sardinia, Tyrrhenian Sea)
papers.authors: Basso, Daniela; Manca Zeichen, Marta; Finoia, Maria Grazia; Babbini, Lorenza; Graziani, Stefano; Bigi, Sabina; Atzori, Fabrizio; Gioberto, Maurizio; Cinti, Maria Francesca; Frau, Francesca
papers.abstract: The Mediterranean Sea is threatened by ocean acidification and warming, in combination with habitat loss, pollution, invasive species, and overexploitation. Assessing local high-frequency pH variability in the context of relevant basin-scale time series data is essential to understand ecosystem vulnerability. We report the results of the Italian national pH monitoring based on the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, and the pH dynamics observed at Capo Carbonara. An experimental station equipped with a pH sensor and CTD probe was deployed at 32 m depth on a sandy bottom bordered by Coralligenous assemblages. Physical and biogeochemical variables were continuously recorded over 345 days and analyzed through additive time series decomposition. The benthic assemblages were surveyed by photographic and destructive sampling in summer and autumn 2016 and spring 2017 on algal reef and sandy bottom, to describe the biological components undergoing and contributing to the pH fluctuations. Seasonal pH variability ranged up to 0.2 units annually and 0.1 units daily, with maxima in January and minima in August, while the range of pH on the basin scale had higher mean values and exceeded local variability. Assemblage changes were driven by algal turf development and the invasive Caulerpa cylindracea . Coralligenous taxa appear stable, despite the substantial natural pH variability, shaped by meteo-marine conditions, water mass circulation, Saharan dust inputs, and benthic biological processes, with primary producers and calcifiers exerting a key influence. The ongoing trend of increasing temperatures and decreasing pH may threaten the Coralligenous ability to cope with the shifting future boundaries of such variability.
papers.summary_cn: 在地中海Capo Carbonara（撒丁岛东南部，第勒尼安海）32 m深处的砂底与珊瑚藻礁（Coralligenous）交界处布设pH传感器和CTD，连续监测345天，并结合2016—2017年多个季节的底栖群落采样，评估局部高频pH波动及其生态效应。结果显示，pH季节变幅达0.2单位、日变幅达0.1单位，1月最高、8月最低，受气象海洋条件、水团交换、撒哈拉沙尘输入及底栖生物过程共同驱动。藻席发育和入侵种Caulerpa cylindracea驱动了群落变化，而珊瑚藻礁类群在显著自然pH波动下仍保持稳定，但持续升温与pH下降可能削弱其应对未来波动边界变化的能力。

papers.title: American Eels consume invasive Sea Lamprey larvae
papers.authors: Stuart, Roe E; Holst, Hannah L; Marcy-Quay, Benjamin; Marsden, J Ellen; Stockwell, Jason D
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Little is known about potential predators of Sea Lamprey Petromyzon marinus in Lake Champlain and the Laurentian Great Lakes. However, such information could provide valuable insights for a wider view of ecosystem-level lamprey control. We hypothesized that American Eels Anguilla rostrata could be major predators of Sea Lamprey larvae. Methods We tested our hypothesis using laboratory experiments and field observations. Specifically, we tested whether (1) eels would consume lamprey in experimental mesocosms, (2) eels would eat lamprey when alternate prey were available in the same mesocosms, and (3) lamprey could be detected in the guts of wild-caught eels using genetic analysis of gut contents. Results Our results indicate that eels can and will consume lamprey under experimental settings even when alternate prey are provided; lamprey were consumed in 26% of lamprey-only trials and 21% of trials where alternate prey were available. Genetic analysis of gut contents collected by gastric lavage from wild-caught eels in areas overlapping larval lamprey habitat identified lamprey DNA in 40% of samples, confirming that eels do consume lamprey in the wild. Conclusions Given the observed prevalence of lamprey consumption by eels, our study suggests strong potential value in conservation efforts for native predatory fishes, such as the imperiled American Eel, as an additional tool for Sea Lamprey management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过室内中宇宙实验与野外胃含物遗传分析，检验美洲鳗（Anguilla rostrata）是否为入侵性海七鳃鳗（Petromyzon marinus）幼体的重要捕食者。结果显示，即使提供替代饵料，鳗鱼仍会捕食七鳃鳗（单一饵料组26%、替代饵料组21%的试验中发生捕食），且野外捕获鳗鱼的胃含物中40%检出七鳃鳗DNA。研究表明，保护美洲鳗等本土捕食性鱼类可作为海七鳃鳗管理的潜在补充手段。

papers.title: Review of reintroduction as a conservation tool for Pacific salmon in western North America
papers.authors: Kock, Tobias J; Couch, Claire E; Keefer, Matthew L; Matala, Andrew P; Baldwin, Casey M; Caudill, Christopher C; Ferguson, John W; Pandit, Shubha N; Frederiksen, Chris R; Newsome, Todd H
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Reintroduction of Pacific salmon Oncorhynchus spp. into historically occupied habitat is a widely used management strategy in western North America. Since the last major review, new information on donor populations, fish passage, dam removal, ecological interactions, monitoring, and cultural and societal considerations has emerged. We conducted a comprehensive review to synthesize these advances and inform best practices. Methods Co-authors representing federal, state, tribal, academic, and private organizations with expertise in Pacific salmon reintroductions convened to synthesize literature, evaluate case studies, and update key findings, lessons, and best practices. We developed a framework to assess program status using biological and cultural benchmarks and analyzed adult abundance trends for 26 reintroduced populations of Chinook Salmon O. tshawytscha, Coho Salmon O. kisutch, Sockeye Salmon O. nerka, and steelhead O. mykiss across 16 reintroduction sites in the Pacific Northwest, USA. Results We reviewed 51 Pacific salmon reintroductions, along with relevant studies providing insights into reintroduction protocols and outcomes. Of the programs that have been implemented to date, 48 (94%) remain active and 27 (53%) have operated for at least 20 years. Tribal involvement has been instrumental in the initiation and advancement of many of these efforts and is focused on restoring cultural, spiritual, and ecological connections to salmon. Most populations (81%) evaluated in a trends analysis exhibited stable or increasing abundance, demonstrating that reintroduction is effective at reestablishing populations in historical habitats. The restoration of anadromy to these habitats has ecological benefits that are commonly recognized, such as restoring marine-derived nutrient transport, providing access to cold water in headwater tributaries, contributing to fisheries, and benefiting other species of concern (e.g., sea lions and orcas Orcinus orca) that rely on salmon for prey. Benefits of reintroduction also include cultural reconnections between salmon and Indigenous Peoples. Salmon are considered “relatives” and are central to the way of life in many Indigenous cultures, but this connection has been lost in places where salmon have been extirpated from their historical ranges. Such losses have resulted in great harm to Indigenous communities, and reintroduction has the potential to begin restoring what has been lost. While we acknowledge the importance of identifying and mitigating the risks associated with reintroduction, we also maintain that there are inherent risks of inaction, such as ongoing harm to communities that rely on Pacific salmon. Conclusions This synthesis updates the existing state of knowledge for Pacific salmon reintroduction. Our review indicates that reintroduction efforts are supporting many stable or increasing populations throughout western North America in addition to restoring culturally important species for Indigenous communities.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了北美西部太平洋鲑（*Oncorhynchus* spp.）再引入（reintroduction）作为保护工具的最新进展，涵盖供体种群、鱼道、拆坝、生态互作、监测及文化社会因素等方面，并基于生物与文化基准构建了项目评估框架。研究分析了美国太平洋西北地区16个再引入站点、26个Chinook Salmon、Coho Salmon、Sockeye Salmon及steelhead种群的成鱼丰度趋势，发现81%的种群呈稳定或增长态势，表明再引入能有效在历史栖息地重建种群。综述强调部落参与对项目启动与推进的关键作用，再引入不仅恢复了海洋源营养输送、冷水栖息地及渔业等生态效益，也重建了原住民与鲑鱼之间的文化联系。

papers.title: Distribution and life-history of spurdog (Squalus acanthias) along the Norwegian coast inferred from a five-year fishery-independent longline survey
papers.authors: Delaval, Aurélien; Andrade, Hector; Nilsen, Tine; Vollen, Tone; Lavezza, Rosario; Larsen, Torfinn E.; Bruvold, Ingrid M.; Berg, Erik; Albert, Ole Thomas
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Northeast Atlantic spurdog ( Squalus acanthias ) has recently shown signs of recovery from overfishing following international conservation measures. As the fishery slowly reopens, ensuring its sustainable long-term trajectory will require an understanding of its contemporary population structure, habitat use, and life-history traits across its distribution range. Here, we used biological data collected during an annual autumn (September–November) longline survey from 2021–2025 along the southwestern coast of Norway to investigate sex, maturity, and age-related distributions and life-history traits of spurdog in the region. Spurdog catches (N = 7,492) included a wide range of life-stages for both sexes, including juveniles and reproductively active adults, across the entire survey area from Rørvik (65°N, 11°E) to the Swedish border (59°N, 11°E). Spurdog catches were consistently higher in shallow waters (< 150 m) in the latitude bands 58–60°N and 61–63°N. Catches were frequently sex- and maturity-biased, often dominated by gravid females or reproductively active males. Survey coverage along the southeastern coast was more limited but also indicated potentially important habitats in the area. Growth and maturity parameters were within the ranges reported in other areas of the stock, and uterine fecundity was positively correlated to maternal size and age. We provide updated information on the fecundity-length relationship, which has historically fluctuated in response to density-dependent effects and fishing pressure. The survey establishes a new reference point for spurdog in a biologically productive region not covered by other surveys and provides a foundation for long-term monitoring of a historically important fishery resource.
papers.summary_cn: 2021–2025年秋季在挪威西南沿海开展无渔业依赖的长线调查，采集7492尾spurdog（Squalus acanthias）生物学数据，分析其性别、成熟度及年龄相关的分布与生活史特征。结果显示该区域涵盖从幼鱼到繁殖活跃成体的广泛生活阶段，渔获在150 m以浅水域及58–60°N、61–63°N纬度带持续较高，且常呈现性别和成熟度偏倚（多由孕雌或繁殖活跃雄鱼主导）。生长与成熟参数处于该种群其他区域报道范围之内，子宫繁殖力与母体体型和年龄正相关，并更新了繁殖力-体长关系。该调查为这一历史上重要渔业资源在生物生产力较高且未被其他调查覆盖的区域建立了新的参考基准和长期监测基础。

papers.title: Using Natural Fibres and Indigenous Knowledge to Develop Alternatives to Plastic Ropes Used in Mussel Aquaculture
papers.authors: Skelton, Bradley M.; Rossieur, Te Ao; MacDonald, Nicola; Tawiri, Katarina; Jeffs, Andrew G.
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Aquaculture relies extensively on plastic materials, creating a need for lower‐plastic alternatives that retain the functional properties required for production. This study combined mātauranga Māori and science to identify natural plant fibres suitable for manufacturing mussel ropes and to evaluate their ability to catch and retain Greenshell mussel ( Perna canaliculus ) spat. Fifteen plant species were screened, with harakeke ( Phormium tenax ), tī kōuka ( Cordyline australis ) and pampas ( Cortaderia selloana ) selected for spat‐catching trials. Spat catch on extracted fibres did not differ among natural and plastic fibres ( F (3,187) = 1.2, p = 0.3), although catches differed strongly among sites and sampling events. Harakeke and tī kōuka were subsequently manufactured into corded ropes. These natural‐fibre ropes caught fewer spat than the larger commercial plastic spat‐catching rope, but both fibre types provided suitable settlement substrate and retained material integrity during deployment, with tī kōuka showing the greatest durability. The results demonstrate that natural plant fibres identified through mātauranga Māori can provide functional alternatives to plastic in mussel spat collection. Further development should focus on mechanised fibre extraction and rope manufacture, optimisation of rope structure and testing durability over longer production periods.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究结合毛利传统知识（mātauranga Māori）与科学方法，筛选适用于贻贝养殖绳制造的天然植物纤维，并评估其采集和附着 Greenshell mussel（Perna canaliculus）稚贝的能力。在筛选的15种植物中，harakeke、tī kōuka 和 pampas 三种纤维的稚贝附着量与塑料纤维无显著差异，但附着量受站点和采样时间影响较大。将 harakeke 和 tī kōuka 制成绳索后，其稚贝采集量低于商业塑料采苗绳，但均能提供适宜的附着基质并保持结构完整性，其中 tī kōuka 耐久性最佳。结果表明，基于毛利传统知识识别的天然植物纤维可作为贻贝采苗中塑料的功能性替代材料，后续需聚焦纤维机械化提取、绳索制造优化及长期耐久性测试。

papers.title: Detecting Trachinotus Blochii with a YOLOv8 Model and Video Dataset: A Deep Learning Approach for Fisheries Monitoring
papers.authors: Nuraini, Rini; Syafei, Wahyul Amien; Jaya, Indra
papers.abstract: This study develops a deep learning-based object detection model using YOLOv8 to detect Bawal Bintang/Star Pomfret fish (Trachinotus Blochii) in real time and with high accuracy from a video dataset captured in a 3x3x3 m3 Floating Net Cage (KJA) off the Karimunjawa coast. The video was taken using an Underwater Camera placed at a position 1.5 meters deep at KJA. This study aims to develop an automated fish monitoring system to detect Star Pomfret fish and improve efficiency and accuracy in fisheries resource management. The YOLOv8s model was retrained for 50 epochs using an annotated fish video dataset, split into 80% for training and 20% for testing and validation, with a frame size of 640x640 pixels. The evaluation results indicate that this model performs well, with a precision of 0.8608, a recall of 0.8575, an F1-score of 0.8592, and a mAP50 of 0.9304. This study demonstrates the potential of applying the YOLOv8 model to an automated fish monitoring system in KJA, which can help improve efficiency and accuracy in managing fishery resources in Karimunjawa and its surroundings.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于YOLOv8构建深度学习目标检测模型，利用水下摄像机在Karimunjawa海域3×3×3 m³浮动网箱（KJA）中采集的视频数据集，实现对卵形鲳鲹（Trachinotus blochii）的实时高精度检测。模型经50个epoch训练（80%训练集、20%测试验证集，帧尺寸640×640），取得precision 0.8608、recall 0.8575、F1-score 0.8592、mAP50 0.9304的检测性能。结果表明YOLOv8可有效应用于网箱养殖鱼类自动监测，有助于提升渔业资源管理的效率与准确性。
