papers.title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Antibacterial Performance of Rice Husk-Derived Silica Nanoparticles for Aquaculture Applications
papers.authors: Suharyadi; Yanuhar, Uun; Widodo, Maheno Sri; Faqih, Abdul Rahem; Suryanto, Heru; Shing, Wong Ling; Rajamani, Ranjithkumar; Machfuda, Defa Rizqi; Lal, Mohammad Tamrin Bin Mohamad; Binoj, Joseph Selvi
papers.abstract: The use of rice husk charcoal as a silica source for the synthesis of nanosilica represents a green approach in the development of sustainable and environmentally friendly nanoparticle composites. This study aims to synthesize silica nanoparticles (SiO2 NPs) from rice husk charcoal and evaluate their toxicity level against Artemia salina and their antibacterial activity against Vibrio harveyi. Nanosilica synthesis was carried out through an acid pretreatment method using hydrochloric acid (HCl). The characterization of the physicochemical properties of SiO2 NPs utilized Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope (FE-SEM) integrated with Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Ultraviolet Visible spectroscopy (UV-Vis), Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR), and X-ray Diffraction (XRD). The characterization results confirmed the formation of SiO2 NPs with a crystallite size of 9.20 ± 6.25 nm and a high level of purity, and antibacterial activity indicated by an inhibition zone of 8.3 ± 0.42 mm (an increase of 38.3% compared to the control). Toxicity evaluation using probit analysis produced an LC50 value of 14,113 mg/L at 24-hour exposure and 521.6 mg/L at 72-hour exposure. These findings indicate that SiO2 NPs from rice husk charcoal are potential antibacterial agents against V. harveyi with low toxicity and can be applied in sustainable disease management in aquaculture systems in the future.
papers.summary_cn: 以稻壳炭为硅源，采用盐酸预处理法合成二氧化硅纳米颗粒（SiO2 NPs），并通过FE-SEM/EDS、UV-Vis、FTIR和XRD表征其理化性质。表征结果显示SiO2 NPs晶粒尺寸为9.20 ± 6.25 nm且纯度较高，对Vibrio harveyi的抑菌圈达8.3 ± 0.42 mm（较对照增加38.3%）。毒性评价表明其对Artemia salina的24 h LC50为14,113 mg/L、72 h LC50为521.6 mg/L，提示该材料低毒且可作为水产养殖中抗V. harveyi的潜在抗菌剂。

papers.title: Sex‐dependent divergence in river use following maturation in Japanese seabass Lateolabrax japonicus revealed by otolith Sr:Ca chronologies
papers.authors: Yamashita, Yoh; Takai, Kazuha; Kuroki, Mari; Shirai, Kotaro; Terashima, Yuki; Kume, Manabu; Togashi, Hiroyuki; Kurita, Yutaka; Wada, Toshihiro; Murakami, Hiroaki
papers.abstract: Abstract Partial migration, in which migratory and resident individuals coexist within a population, is widespread in fishes and contributes to population resilience. However, the role of sex in shaping migratory strategies remains poorly understood. Herein, we examined partial migration in Japanese seabass Lateolabrax japonicus using sex ratios and otolith Sr:Ca chronologies. A total of 1847 individuals were collected from three Japanese regions (Sendai Bay, Tango Bay, Beppu Bay and rivers flowing into these three regions). Additionally, lifetime salinity histories were reconstructed for 206 individuals. Otolith analyses distinguished two contingents: river‐migratory individuals that used river habitats and marine residents that remained in coastal waters throughout life. During their immature stages, both sexes frequently used riverine habitats; however, their migration trajectories diverged following maturation. Most males shifted to marine residency, whereas females continued river migration and exhibited strong fidelity to river systems. Furthermore, riverine habitats were strongly female‐biased, with over 90% of adults being females. These findings provide evidence that sex‐dependent divergence in migratory behaviour emerges at maturation in a marine amphidromous fish, underscoring a mechanism that may contribute to ecological flexibility and population stability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以日本鲈 Lateolabrax japonicus 为对象，结合性比数据与耳石 Sr:Ca 时序，在其部分洄游（partial migration）背景下解析性别对洄游策略的影响。耳石分析将个体划分为河流洄游型与海洋定居型两类，未成熟阶段雌雄均频繁利用河流生境，但性成熟后洄游轨迹出现分化：多数雄性转为海洋定居，雌性则持续进行河流洄游并对河流系统表现出高度忠诚。河流生境成体性比严重偏雌（雌性占比逾90%），表明该海洋双向洄游鱼类在性成熟时发生性别依赖的洄游行为分化，这一机制可能增强其生态适应性与种群稳定性。

papers.title: A double-stranded RNA fish reovirus activates cGAS-STING signaling and evades antiviral immunity through autophagy-mediated degradation
papers.authors: Peng, Zichao; Zhou, Fang; Wang, Xuyang; Li, Yongming; Zhu, Zuoyan; Wang, Yaping; He, Libo
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) reoviruses are primarily sensed by the RIG-I-like receptor (RLRs) signaling pathway. However, whether these viruses can also activate the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway, a central DNA-sensing system, remains poorly understood. Grass carp reovirus (GCRV), a highly virulent aquareovirus in the family Spinareoviridae , is the causative agent of hemorrhagic disease in grass carp, an economically important fish species in China. GCRV serves as an ideal model for investigating host-virus interactions during dsRNA reovirus infection. Methods Using GCRV as a reovirus model, we systematically examined the interaction between GCRV and cGAS-STING signaling pathways and investigated the mechanism underlying cGAS-STING activation. Functional analyses were performed to evaluate the antiviral role of cGAS-STING signaling and the viral immune evasion strategies used to counteract this response. Moreover, the involvement of viral proteins and host selective autophagy factors in immune evasion was further characterized. Results We show that GCRV infection activates both RLRs and cGAS-STING signaling pathways. GCRV infection induced mitochondrial membrane depolarization and cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA, which was sensed by cGAS and triggered activation of the cGAS-STING pathway. Activation of the cGAS-STING pathway restricts GCRV replication, whereas the virus counteracts this antiviral response by inducing degradation of cGAS and STING. Mechanistically, the GCRV nonstructural protein NS26 hijacks the autophagy receptors Tollip and Parkin to promote lysosomal degradation of cGAS and STING via the autophagy-lysosome pathway. Functionally, NS26 enhances viral replication and suppresses host antiviral responses. Conclusions Our findings uncover a previously unrecognized mechanism by which a dsRNA fish reovirus manipulates host selective autophagy to antagonize cGAS-STING-mediated antiviral immunity. These results expand current understanding of cGAS-STING activation during dsRNA fish reovirus infection and highlight a potentially conserved immune evasion strategy shared by both RNA and DNA viruses.
papers.summary_cn: 草鱼呼肠孤病毒（GCRV）感染可同时激活RLRs和cGAS-STING信号通路，后者通过感知线粒体DNA胞质释放发挥抗病毒作用。病毒非结构蛋白NS26劫持自噬受体Tollip和Parkin，经自噬-溶酶体途径降解cGAS和STING，从而逃逸宿主抗病毒免疫。该研究揭示了dsRNA鱼源呼肠孤病毒利用选择性自噬拮抗cGAS-STING免疫的新机制。

papers.title: The beneficial effects of nanoparticles loaded with plant essential oils on growth performance, immunity, health status, and bacterial pathogens in sustainable fish farming: a comprehensive review
papers.authors: Shukry, Mustafa; Elshopakey, Gehad E.; Shosha, Amany M.; Mostafa, Ahmed E. A.; Albokhadaim, Ibrahim; Alhojaily, Samir; Alameen, Ahmed O.; Elbahnaswy, Samia

papers.title: Standardized Ophthalmic Examination Protocol For Fish Developed During Assessment of 274 Eyes in Rockfish (Family Sebastidae)
papers.authors: White, Clara R.; Bliss, Cassandra D.; Miller‐Morgan, Timothy J.; Babbidge, Abigail
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Objective To develop and evaluate a practical, standardized ophthalmic examination protocol for teleost fish using captive rockfish (Family Sebastidae) as a pilot population. Methods One hundred twenty‐seven captive rockfish housed at Hatfield Marine Science Center and 11 newly acquired rockfish at the Oregon Coast Aquarium, representing 9 Sebastes and 1 Sebastolobus species. A total of 138 ophthalmic examinations (274 eyes) were performed. Ophthalmic examinations were conducted concurrently with routine health assessments over an 8‐month period. Examinations included photodocumentation, slit‐lamp biomicroscopy, indirect ophthalmoscopy, rebound tonometry, ocular ultrasonography, pachymetry, corneal diameter measurements, and collection of biometric data (body length and weight). Diagnostic feasibility, reproducibility, and workflow efficiency were evaluated. Statistical analyses assessed relationships between ocular measurements and biometric variables. Results A Standardized Ophthalmic Examination Protocol for Fish (SOEP‐F) was developed that enabled collection of 22 discrete ocular and biometric data points in < 3 min per fish. Certain ultrasonographic measurements (e.g., choroidal thickness) were excluded due to poor reproducibility, whereas pachymetry provided consistent corneal thickness measurements. In juvenile copper rockfish, a strong positive correlation was identified between body length and corneal diameter. Mean IOP values did not differ significantly between eyes, and dorsal corneal quadrant measurements demonstrated the lowest variability. The protocol was integrated into routine physical examinations without increasing anesthetic risk. Conclusions The SOEP‐F provides a practical framework applicable to clinical and research settings in teleost fish. Clinical Relevance Standardized ophthalmic examination protocols in teleost fish may improve diagnostic consistency, facilitate multicenter data sharing, and support the development of species‐specific reference values.
papers.summary_cn: 研究以圈养岩鱼（Sebastidae科，9种Sebastes及1种Sebastolobus）为对象，在8个月内完成138次眼科检查（274只眼），旨在建立适用于硬骨鱼类的标准化眼科检查方案（SOEP-F）。该方案可在3分钟内采集22项眼部及生物计量数据，其中pachymetry测量角膜厚度可重复性良好，而部分超声测量（如脉络膜厚度）因重复性差被剔除；幼年铜岩鱼体长与角膜直径呈强正相关，双眼IOP无显著差异，背侧角膜象限测量变异性最低。SOEP-F可整合入常规体检而不增加麻醉风险，有助于提升诊断一致性、促进多中心数据共享及物种特异性参考值建立。

papers.title: Anthropogenic disturbance drives compositional and structural shifts in cerrado stream fish assemblages
papers.authors: Sulzbacher, Rosalva; Benone, Naraiana Loureiro; Salvador, Gilberto Nepomuceno; Alves, Carlos Bernardo Mascarenhas; Formagio, Paulo Sérgio; Pompeu, Paulo Santos
papers.abstract: Abstract Currently, one of the main threats to freshwater ecosystems is the conversion of natural areas into croplands, pastures, and urban landscapes. Therefore, understanding how fish assemblages respond to gradients of land use related anthropogenic disturbance is essential. This study aimed to assess shifts in species composition and structure across a stream disturbance gradient, and to examine the association of rare and non-native species with each disturbance level. We evaluated 40 tributary streams of the Upper Grande River (Paraná Basin), ranked according to the Integrated Disturbance Index (IDI), which was calculated based on human modifications on multiple scales. Species composition and structure differed between least and most disturbed streams, with no significant differences involving intermediate streams. Rare and native species prevailed in least disturbed sites, whereas tolerant and non-native species were indicators of most disturbed ones. Our findings demonstrate that stream fish assemblages are sensitive to disturbance intensity. Least-disturbed streams may serve as sources for recolonization if impacts are mitigated and connectivity restored, providing baselines for ecological assessments in highly modified landscapes lacking pristine conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估土地利用相关人为干扰梯度下溪流鱼类群落的物种组成与结构变化，并分析稀有物种与外来物种在各干扰等级中的分布特征。以Paraná Basin上游Grande River的40条支流为对象，基于多尺度人类改造构建的综合干扰指数（IDI）进行排序。结果显示，低干扰与高干扰溪流间鱼类组成和结构差异显著，稀有及本地物种集中于低干扰溪流，而耐污种和外来种为高干扰溪流的指示种。低干扰溪流可作为恢复连通性后的再定殖源，为高度改造景观中的生态评估提供基线参照。

papers.title:
Evaluating Kelp
Feedstock for Alginate-Based Materials:
Physicochemical Characterization of Sodium Alginate and Aquaculture
Considerations
papers.authors: Smith, Hayley A.; Graham, Crystal A.; Wheeler, Mikhailey D.; Kozak, Christopher M.; Buckley, Heather L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Cultivated kelps are a scalable marine feedstock for renewable polymers, but regional aquaculture supply chains lack engineering benchmarks for the alginate yield and quality. Here, we apply a lower-hazard citrate-based process to quantify bioplastics-relevant alginate metrics across cultivated northeast Pacific kelps from commercial farms in British Columbia (Canada) and Alaska (USA). Ten blade biomass samples spanning five species were screened. Two samples failed to undergo phase separation after extraction and centrifugation, indicating biomass-dependent extractability as a process risk. For the remaining eight feedstocks, yields ranged from 11.95 to 26.11% (dry weight). Weight-average molar mass (Mw) ranged from 36.6 to 623 kDa, with 7/8 samples exceeding 400 kDa. Uronic acid composition spanned M/G = 0.14–1.38, with variation in G/M block compositions (block fractions and block lengths) relevant to cross-linking. Multivariate analysis resolved dominant gradients linking the uronic acid composition and molar mass distributions. The studied kelps were evaluated in the context of known seasonal, tissue-specific, and environment-driven effects and climate-related stressors that can alter productivity. Collectively, these results provide a regional benchmark for lower hazard alginate production from cultivated kelps and an engineering screening framework to support consistent feedstock selection for scalable manufacturing of alginate-based films, coatings, and related bio-based materials.
papers.summary_cn: 研究以加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚和美国阿拉斯加商业养殖的东北太平洋海带为原料，采用低危害柠檬酸工艺评估其作为藻酸盐生物塑料原料的提取率与品质。10份海带叶片样品（涵盖5个物种）中2份提取后无法相分离，其余8份藻酸盐产率为11.95%–26.11%（干重），重均分子量（Mw）为36.6–623 kDa（7/8超过400 kDa），糖醛酸组成M/G为0.14–1.38。多变量分析揭示了糖醛酸组成与分子量分布的主导梯度，为养殖海带藻酸盐原料的工程化筛选和规模化生产提供了区域基准。

papers.title: Selection of Aeration Systems for Aquaculture Based on Oxygen Transfer Efficiency, Pond Size and Economic Performance
papers.authors: Tandel, Mayur; Nikhil, A. N.; Tandel, Bhavika; Tandel, Mitul; Janbandhu, Shubham; Tembhurne, Meena Charandas
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Aeration is a component of intensive aquaculture because dissolved oxygen influences fish respiration, metabolism, feeding, growth, survival, and water quality. However, selection of an appropriate aerator requires consideration of oxygen-transfer performance, pond volume, energy consumption, capital cost, maintenance, and operating conditions. The present paper reviews and compares aeration systems used in aquaculture, with particular emphasis on standard oxygen transfer rate (SOTR), standard aeration efficiency (SAE), oxygen transfer characteristics, cost, and suitability for different pond sizes. The objective of this review is to identify an efficient aeration system according to pond size, water volume and biomass. Findings indicate substantial variation among paddle-wheel, propeller-aspirator, diffused-air, spiral, cascade, and perforated-tray aerators. Gravity-based cascade and perforated-tray systems offer simple construction and effective oxygen transfer and are particularly relevant to smaller culture systems. Circular stepped cascade and pooled circular stepped cascade aerators have been reported as economical options for ponds below 1,000 m³, while paddle-wheel aerators, particularly 1- and 2-HP units, provide higher oxygen-transfer capacity and water circulation and are more suitable for ponds exceeding 5,000 m³. Perforated-tray and gravity aerators also demonstrate potential where low complexity and energy-efficient operation are desired. Overall, aerator selection should match oxygen demand, pond size, biomass, culture intensity, and economic constraints rather than relying solely on oxygen-transfer efficiency. This approach can improve aeration effectiveness and economic sustainability. From 1984 to 2024, many researchers investigated the development of efficient aeration systems; more than twenty-five articles were reviewed in preparing this article.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述并比较了水产养殖中各类增氧系统，重点分析标准氧转移率（SOTR）、标准增氧效率（SAE）、成本及对不同池塘规模的适用性，旨在依据池塘大小、水体体积和生物量筛选高效增氧方案。结果表明，叶轮式、螺旋桨-射流式、扩散式、螺旋式、跌水式和穿孔盘式增氧机性能差异显著：跌水式和穿孔盘式结构简单、增氧有效，适合小型养殖系统；圆形阶梯跌水及组合式跌水增氧机在1000 m³以下池塘中经济性较好；叶轮式增氧机（尤其1–2 HP机型）氧转移能力和水体循环能力更强，更适合5000 m³以上池塘。增氧机选型应综合匹配氧需求、池塘规模、生物量、养殖强度和经济约束，而非仅依据氧转移效率。

papers.title: Shellfish as Bio-indicators of Petroleum-related Pollution in a Tropical Oil-producing Estuarine Ecosystem of the Niger Delta, Nigeria
papers.authors: Otiasah, Christian Livingstone; Chukwudi, Ohanuna,; Perron, Sampson, Adonis
papers.abstract: Petroleum-producing estuaries of the Niger Delta support shellfish harvesting while receiving complex, spatially variable mixtures of hydrocarbons and other contaminants. Shellfish can integrate biologically accessible exposure, but their interpretation is complicated by differences in habitat, taxonomy, physiology and analytical practice. This critical narrative review evaluates the conditions under which shellfish provide reliable evidence of petroleum-related contamination, biological effects and potential dietary exposure. Search-engine-assisted scholarly retrieval, bibliographic verification and thematic appraisal covered literature published from 2000 to 30 July 2026, with emphasis on regional field investigations and experimentally supported mechanisms. The evidence supports sediment-associated periwinkles and locally verified mangrove oysters as complementary sentinel candidates, rather than interchangeable monitors. Niger Delta studies demonstrate hydrocarbon and metal occurrence, heterogeneous tissue burdens and biological disturbance, but frequently provide weaker evidence for source-specific attribution, causal injury or population-level consequences. Apparent disagreements among seafood risk assessments arise partly from different analyte panels, tissue-weight bases, consumption assumptions, treatment of non-detects and interpretation of screening values. Petroleum hydrocarbon totals, individual biochemical responses and tissue-to-sediment ratios cannot independently establish ecological impairment or consumer safety. Recent molecular and rapid-screening approaches improve investigative capacity, although local calibration and independent validation remain necessary. An integrated monitoring framework is proposed that combines taxonomically verified organisms, paired environmental chemistry, exposure and effect measurements, seasonally matched comparisons, and separately conducted dietary assessments. Its central requirement is to preserve distinctions between contaminant detection, source attribution, biological injury, ecological recovery and human exposure. Immediate priorities are harmonised regional sampling, reproducible analytical quality assurance, experimentally validated biomarker panels and transparent reassessment of published risk calculations. Shellfish are defensible bio-indicators when embedded within this chain of evidence; they are not self-sufficient forensic tools or substitutes for representative food-safety surveillance.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估了尼日尔三角洲产油河口区贝类作为石油污染生物指示物的可靠性，基于2000—2026年文献，重点分析区域野外调查与实验机制证据。研究认为，沉积物相关的滨螺和当地验证的红树林牡蛎可作为互补性sentinel物种，而非可互换的监测工具；现有研究虽能证实烃类和金属暴露及生物扰动，但在污染源归因、因果损伤和种群水平效应方面证据不足。作者提出整合监测框架，强调须区分污染物检出、源归因、生物损伤、生态恢复与人体暴露，并优先推进区域采样标准化、分析质量保证和生物标志物验证。

papers.title: Effects of land-use change on habitat selection and home ranges of fishing-eating birds during winter
papers.authors: Cunningham, Fred L; Wang, Guiming; Godwin, Kristina; Acosta, Jody; King, D Tommy; Burr, Paul; Lott, Clinton; Glover, Jason; Tappa, Jason; Redd, Madeline
papers.abstract: Abstract The Double-crested Cormorant (Nannopterum auritum; hereafter, cormorant) is piscivorous and extensively forages in commercial catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) ponds on the non-breeding grounds in the Mississippi Alluvial Valley (MAV) and the Upper Coastal Plain (UCP) in the Tombigbee and Tennessee River Valleys in Alabama and Mississippi of the United States of America. Large-scale aquaculture is a prominent land use and an important economic activity in the MAV and UCP. However, the area of aquaculture in production has been in decline in the two regions since the mid-2000s. The effects of this decline in land use and land cover (LULC) on the home range size and habitat selection of cormorants during winter are largely unknown. We examined relationships among winter home range size, LULC composition, and habitat selection of cormorants, using satellite and GPS data from 2000 to 2002 (early 2000s), when aquaculture peaked, and from 2019 to 2022 (early 2020s), after the aquacultural declined in the MAV and UCP. Cormorants’ winter home range sizes decreased as catfish ponds, wetlands, and non-aquaculture waterbodies like rivers, lakes, and reservoirs increased. In the MAV, habitat selection for non-aquaculture waterbodies was stronger in the early 2020s than in the early 2000s, corresponding to their decreased winter home ranges in the early 2020s. Our findings indicate that cormorants adjust their habitat use in response to changes in landscape composition while maintaining strong associations with aquatic foraging habitats across spatial scales.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估水产养殖面积下降这一土地利用变化对冬季双冠鸬鹚（Double-crested Cormorant）家域大小与栖息地选择的影响。作者利用2000—2002年（水产养殖高峰期）和2019—2022年（养殖衰退后）的卫星与GPS追踪数据，结合LULC组成，比较了密西西比冲积谷（MAV）和上沿海平原（UCP）两区域鸬鹚的冬季家域与生境选择。结果显示，随着鲶鱼塘、湿地及非养殖水体（河流、湖泊、水库）面积增加，鸬鹚冬季家域缩小；在MAV，2020年代初对非养殖水体的选择强度高于2000年代初，与其家域缩小相对应。研究表明鸬鹚能随景观组成变化调整栖息地利用，但在各空间尺度上始终与水生觅食生境保持紧密关联。

papers.title: From Algorithmic Detection to Adaptive Fisheries Governance: An AI-Enabled Compliance and Ecosystem Feedback Framework for IUU Fishing in the Yellow Sea
papers.authors: Nam, Wanwoo
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly able to infer apparent fishing activity, vessel type, encounters, non-cooperative or otherwise low-visibility vessel presence, and other maritime patterns from Automatic Identification System (AIS), vessel monitoring system (VMS), radar, optical imagery and catch records. Yet better detection does not automatically produce better fisheries management. This article asks under what institutional conditions AI-enabled monitoring can support more effective compliance and the sustainability of shared fish stocks without converting probabilistic signals into automatic enforcement findings. Using the Korea–China Yellow Sea as an institutional case study, the analysis combines recent AI-fisheries literature, international monitoring–control–surveillance guidance, ecosystem-based fisheries scholarship, the Korea–China Fisheries Agreement and verifiable official enforcement and resource-management developments through August 2026. It develops an Adaptive Fisheries Intelligence Loop (AFIL) with five stages: observe, validate, respond, learn and adapt. The model requires human validation of algorithmic signals, provenance labels for shared information, feedback from enforcement outcomes, and a second feedback channel connecting compliance patterns to ecological indicators and management measures. Applied to the Yellow Sea, AFIL supports joint risk vocabularies, interoperable case and vessel histories, targeted patrols, scientific stock assessment and periodic recalibration of both algorithms and management rules. AFIL is an institutionally plausible and testable governance design, not an empirically validated prediction that AI will itself deliver compliance. The article therefore argues that AI should be governed as adaptive decision-support infrastructure rather than as an automated enforcement endpoint.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探讨AI辅助监测在何种制度条件下能有效支持IUU fishing合规与共享渔业资源可持续性，而非将概率性信号直接转化为自动执法结论。以中韩黄海为制度案例，结合AI-渔业文献、MCS国际指南、生态系统渔业研究及中韩渔业协定，构建了包含observe、validate、respond、learn、adapt五阶段的自适应渔业情报循环（AFIL）框架。该框架要求对算法信号进行人工验证、共享信息标注来源、执法结果反馈，并建立合规模式与生态指标及管理措施之间的第二反馈通道，以支持联合风险术语、可互操作的案件与船舶历史、精准巡逻及stock assessment。AFIL被视为一种制度上可行且可检验的治理设计，主张AI应作为自适应决策支持基础设施而非自动化执法终端。

papers.title: Landings and First-Sale Prices of Greek Coastal Fisheries: A Multi-Market Time-Series Analysis (2013–2025)
papers.authors: Klaoudatos, Dimitris; Pafras, Dimitris; Gourtsoulis, Stefanos; Theocharis, Alexandros
papers.abstract: Understanding how landings and prices of commercially important species co-vary through time is relevant to managing Mediterranean coastal fisheries, yet few studies have examined both jointly across multiple species, markets and years in the eastern Mediterranean. We analyzed monthly landings and nominal, undeflated first-sale prices for eight species at twelve Greek fish markets, from 2013 to 2025 (9313 cleaned records), using descriptive, trend, spatial, multivariate and forecasting methods. Landed quantities were three to six times more variable than prices. Gross first-sale value totalled €795 million; landed quantity accounted for at least 95% of the variance in log value in every species, against 2–5% for price, and otter-trawl species supplied 12% of the landed weight but 37% of the value. Trends were modeled with a Tweedie generalized linear mixed model including harmonic seasonality, market random intercepts and first-order autocorrelation. Once serial dependence was absorbed, only two species retained a significant trend: round sardinella increased by 9.6% per year, and big-scale sand smelt declined by 7.2% per year. Same-year landings–price correlations were negative for abundant finfish and pelagics but positive for the two trawl crustaceans. Landings and value were concentrated in three hubs. First-sale market records offer a complementary monitoring tool.
papers.summary_cn: 研究分析了2013—2025年希腊12个鱼市场8个商业鱼种的月度landings与名义first-sale prices（共9313条记录），采用描述性、趋势、空间、多变量及预测方法。结果显示landings的变异性为价格的3—6倍，landings可解释各鱼种log value方差的95%以上，而价格仅占2—5%；otter-trawl鱼种贡献12%的landed weight却占37%的价值。Tweedie广义线性混合模型表明，扣除序列依赖后仅圆小沙丁鱼（年增9.6%）和大鳞沙银鱼（年减7.2%）保留显著趋势，且landings–price相关性在丰富 finfish 和 pelagics 中为负、在两种拖网甲壳类中为正。first-sale市场记录可作为补充监测工具。

papers.title: Development of a STEM-Based E-Module for Water Quality Management in Brackish and Marine Fisheries Agribusiness Learning
papers.authors: Yumitra, Herlina; Rayendra, Rayendra; Darmansyah, Darmansyah; Yeni J, Fetri
papers.abstract: Water Quality Management is an essential competency in Brackish and Marine Fisheries Agribusiness because it requires students to integrate scientific knowledge, technology, quantitative analysis, and problem-solving skills in authentic aquaculture contexts. However, learning activities are still predominantly supported by conventional materials, while the use of digital learning resources remains limited. This study aimed to develop a STEM-based e-module for Water Quality Management and determine its validity, practicality, and effectiveness as a learning resource for vocational high school students. This study employed a Research and Development (R&D) approach using the ADDIE model, consisting of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation. The participants were 15 eleventh-grade students of the Brackish and Marine Fisheries Agribusiness Program and one subject teacher at SMK Negeri 1 Seri Kuala Lobam. Data were collected through expert validation sheets, teacher and student response questionnaires, and pretest–posttest assessments. The results showed that the e-module was highly valid and highly practical, with validation and practicality scores of 93.75% and 98.6%, respectively. Learning outcomes improved from a mean pretest score of 73.0 to 90.0, with an N-Gain of 0.61, categorized as moderate. The t-test indicated a significant difference between pretest and posttest scores (p < 0.05). These findings indicate that the STEM-based e-module is a valid, practical, and effective digital learning resource for Water Quality Management in vocational fisheries education
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于ADDIE模型开发面向咸淡水与海洋渔业农商专业的STEM水质管理电子模块，并通过专家验证、师生问卷及前后测评估其有效性。模块的验证与实践性得分分别为93.75%和98.6%，属高效水平；学生平均成绩由前测73.0提升至后测90.0，N-Gain为0.61（中等），前后测差异显著（p<0.05）。结果表明该电子模块是渔业职业教育中水质管理教学的有效数字化资源。

papers.authors: Peng, Gary; Zhai, Chun; Liu, Xunjia; Harding, Michael W.; Akhavan, Alireza; Peru, Carter; Kim, Yong Min; Fernando, Dilantha; Yu, Fengqun; Hwang, Sheau-Fang

papers.title: Sex-specific hormone signatures in four fish species with divergent reproductive strategies
papers.authors: Pappert, Freya Adele; Roth, Olivia
papers.abstract: Introduction Steroid hormones regulate diverse biological processes, including development, immunity and reproduction. Because biological sex, pregnancy, parental care, and mate competition are closely associated in most established model organisms, it remains unclear whether endocrine differences between males and females are primarily linked to gametic sex or to the reproductive roles performed by each sex. Syngnathid fish, the pipefishes, seadragons, and seahorses, provide a powerful system for disentangling these effects, because males, rather than females, carry the developing embryos. Species further differ in sexual selection and in the extent of paternal investment, ranging from externally attached eggs to incubation with an enclosed brood pouch. Methods This study provides baseline hormonal profiles of key steroid and peptide hormones in three syngnathid species across the unique evolutionary parental care gradient of male pregnancy ( Nerophis ophidion, Syngnathus typhle, Hippocampus abdominalis ). We additionally included the female-pregnant livebearing fish Heterandria formosa as a comparative reference for a conventional separation of reproductive roles. Results Sex-specific endocrine profiles broadly followed sexual selection differentials: species with stronger sexual heteromorphism, i.e., more extreme reproductive roles ( N. ophidion ), exhibiting stronger endocrine sexual heteromorphism. In contrast, species with higher parental care investment ( H. abdominalis, H. formosa ) show reduced endocrine differentiation between the sexes. The intermediate species S. typhle, which combines sex-role reversal with a moderately complex brood pouch, displayed tissue-specific patterns, with hormonal dimorphism retained primarily in the gonads. Discussion By incorporating a cross-species comparative framework with both sex-role reversed and a conventional viviparous species, we can begin to understand which hormonal functions are conserved versus derived, and whether endocrine profiles are primarily aligned with biological sex or reproductive role, such as mate competition and parental care, thereby revealing how endocrine constraints and plasticity contribute to reproductive evolution.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以三种海龙科鱼类（*Nerophis ophidion*、*Syngnathus typhle*、*Hippocampus abdominalis*）及雌性妊娠的胎生鱼类 *Heterandria formosa* 为对象，比较了雄性妊娠梯度下类固醇与肽类激素的性别特异性内分泌谱。结果显示，内分泌性别二态性与性选择差异一致：生殖角色分化越极端的物种（*N. ophidion*）内分泌性别异形性越强，而亲代投资较高的物种（*H. abdominalis*、*H. formosa*）两性内分泌分化减弱；*S. typhle* 则呈现组织特异性模式，激素二态性主要保留于性腺。研究表明内分泌谱更多与生殖角色（如配偶竞争与亲代抚育）而非单纯生物学性别相关联，为理解内分泌约束与可塑性在生殖演化中的作用提供了跨物种比较框架。

papers.title: Hydrographic Predictors of Small Pelagic Fish Acoustic NASC in Jinhae Bay, Korea: A Two-Part Random Forest Model with Spatially Blocked Validation
papers.authors: Yoon, Hyunsuk; Lee, Sara; Park, Geunchang; Lee, Kyounghoon
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Nautical area scattering coefficient (NASC) data from small coastal acoustic surveys are strongly zero-inflated and spatially autocorrelated. We analysed 3324 integration intervals from 19 surveys in Jinhae Bay, Korea: May–September 2023 and March–September 2024–2025. Signals meeting a 38–120 kHz backscattering-strength-difference mask were treated as small pelagic fish and integrated at 38 kHz. Concurrent set-net and eDNA sampling showed a multi-species assemblage. Four predictor sets combining hydrographic, seasonal, spatial and topographic variables were compared using a two-part random forest under nested cross-validation with 1500 m spatial blocks. Zeros comprised 67.39% of observations. Hydrographic models achieved detection AUCs of 0.874–0.882 and positive-intensity log-scale R2 values of 0.325–0.330, versus 0.701 and 0.062 for topography plus month. Drop-column analysis showed that surface salinity carried the unique hydrographic signal and that surface temperature was redundant with salinity and month; topographic variables added nothing once coordinates were included. Survey identity alone reproduced the full-model AUC (0.882 versus 0.885): spatial-block performance largely reflects discrimination between surveys, not local interpolation. Leave-one-survey-out and leave-one-year-out validation fell to 0.503 ± 0.122 and 0.541 ± 0.123. Detection was more predictable than intensity, but the apparent skill is largely between-survey; the model should not predict unobserved occasions or estimate abundance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以韩国镇海湾19次声学调查的3324个积分区间为对象，采用两部分随机森林模型结合1500 m空间分块嵌套交叉验证，评估水文、季节、空间与地形变量对小型中上层鱼类 acoustic NASC 的预测能力。结果显示零值占67.39%，水文模型检测AUC达0.874–0.882，优于地形加月份模型（0.701）；表层盐度承载独特水文信号，表层温度与盐度和月份冗余，地形变量在纳入坐标后无额外贡献。调查身份本身即可复现全模型AUC，leave-one-survey-out与leave-one-year-out验证AUC降至约0.50–0.54，表明模型表观预测能力主要反映调查间差异而非局部插值，不宜用于预测未观测时段或估算丰度。

papers.title: Correction: A miniature, subterranean, blind cobitid loach, Gitchak nakana, new genus and species, is the first groundwater-dwelling fish from Northeast India
papers.authors: Britz, Ralf; Marak, Wimarithy K.; Velentina, Kangjam; Lokeshwor, Yumnam; Raghavan, Rajeev; Pinion, Amanda K.; Rüber, Lukas
papers.summary_cn: 该文为更正说明，涉及印度东北部发现的一种小型地下盲鳅科鱼类新属新种 Gitchak nakana 的命名与分类信息，为当地首次记录的地下水鱼类。

papers.title: Toxicity of triclosan adsorbed in microplastic in fish hepatoma cell line, PLHC-1
papers.authors: Choi, Young-Eun; Park, Jeong-In; Jung, Eunji; Kim, Young Seon; Song, Nan-Seon; Kim, Seung-Kyu; Kim, Youn-Jung

papers.title: Obstructive Sialadenitis Caused by Migrated Fish Bone into the Submandibular Gland
papers.authors: Mohd Suhaimi, Muhamad Faisal Arief; Ghazali, Liyana; Mohamad, Irfan
papers.abstract: Background Fish bones are the most frequent foreign bodies to lodge in the upper digestive tract. They often embed in the pharyngeal mucosa due to their sharp tips and causing pain. Patient typically attempt various home remedies to alleviate the pain or dislodge fish bones, only seeking medical attention if symptoms persisted or lead to complications such as difficulty in swallowing, abscess formation or respiratory distress. The presence of fish bones may be overlooked because of the complex anatomy of the pharynx, potentially allowing secondary infection to develop. Case presentation A 35-year-old with no comorbidities presented with a chief complaint of one-day duration of painful left neck swelling which is progressively increased in size. He had visited ENT department earlier for alleged fish bone ingestion; full examination and laryngoendoscopy done were negative. A neck x-ray revealed no abnormalities. Intervention: CECT neck was conducted to rule out deep neck space infection, with suspicion of migrated foreign body. He then underwent left submandibulectomy and a fish bone was extracted from the left submandibular gland. Outcome: The patient was well at follow up and discharged after the left neck swelling and throat pain were completely resolved. Conclusion The presentation of fish bones impaction varies in respect to the site of lodgement and often overlooked. If they are not removed, it will lead to complications as mentioned earlier. CECT of the neck is a useful imaging modality to assess deep-seated neck infection, provide guidance for further management. In this case, we chose an open approach with left submandibulectomy to remove the fish bone which is located deep in the submandibular gland. Post operatively, the patient showed good outcomes and immediate symptoms relief. Bangladesh Journal of Medical Science Vol. 25 No. 04 October’26 Page: 1354-1357

papers.title: Nutraceutical potential of Terminalia arjuna bark powder in enhancing enzymatic antioxidant defenses and disease resistance in aquaculture: implications for sustainable food safety and quality
papers.authors: Meena, D. K.; Das, B. K.; Sahoo, A. K.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Food Science and Technology
papers.abstract: The indiscriminate use of prophylactic antibiotics in aquaculture poses serious threats to food safety, environmental health, and antimicrobial resistance, necessitating sustainable plant-based alternatives. This study evaluated the nutraceutical potential of Terminalia arjuna bark powder (TABP) as a dietary immunostimulant in Labeo rohita . Bark, leaf, and fruit materials were extracted using seven solvents of increasing polarity and screened for phytochemicals and in vitro antioxidant capacity via TPC, flavonoid, DPPH, ABTS, FRAP, and NO-scavenging assays. Based on superior bioactivity, TABP was incorporated into four iso-nitrogenous (30.36% crude protein) and iso-caloric diets at 0% (control), 0.1%, 1.0%, and 1.5%, which were fed to juvenile L. rohita ( n = 540) for 90 days in a completely randomized design. Growth performance, serum biochemistry, digestive enzyme activities (amylase, protease, lipase), oxidative stress biomarkers (SOD, catalase, GST), acetylcholinesterase activity, and serum hormones (cortisol, T3, T4) were assessed, followed by a bacterial challenge with Aeromonas hydrophila and Edwardsiella tarda and computation of the Integrated Biomarker Response (IBR) index. Bark extracts demonstrated the highest antioxidant potential across all assays. Dietary TABP significantly improved weight gain, feed efficiency, and digestive enzyme activities, while dose-dependently enhancing enzymatic antioxidant defenses, reducing serum cortisol, and elevating thyroid hormone levels. Post-challenge survival was significantly higher in TABP-supplemented groups, with IBR analysis confirming the strongest integrated biological response at 1.5% inclusion due to stress-related biomarker elevation. And also, it is to mention that recommended inclusion range for sustainable green fish production is 1%–1.23% TABP, aligning our current findings with our prior published evidence. The LC-MS fingerprinting identified catechin, ellagic acid, gallic acid, and epigallocatechin as predominant bioactive constituents. These findings demonstrate that dietary TABP effectively enhances antioxidant capacity, mitigates physiological stress, and improves disease resistance in farmed carp, offering a practical strategy to reduce antibiotic dependence and ensure sustainable aquatic food safety and quality.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了榄仁树（Terminalia arjuna）树皮粉（TABP）作为饲料免疫刺激剂在Labeo rohita养殖中的营养保健潜力，以替代预防性抗生素。通过多溶剂提取和体外抗氧化筛选确定树皮提取物活性最强，随后将TABP以0%、0.1%、1.0%和1.5%四个水平添加至等氮等能饲料中，投喂幼鱼90天并进行Aeromonas hydrophila和Edwardsiella tarda攻毒试验。结果表明，TABP显著提高增重、饲料效率和消化酶活性，剂量依赖性地增强酶促抗氧化防御（SOD、catalase、GST），降低血清皮质醇并升高甲状腺激素水平，攻毒后存活率显著提高，IBR分析显示1.5%添加组综合生物学响应最强。LC-MS鉴定出儿茶素、鞣花酸、没食子酸和表没食子儿茶素为主要活性成分，推荐添加范围为1%–1.23%，可作为减少抗生素依赖、保障水产食品安全与质量的可持续策略。

papers.title: Investigation of Flow Structures in an Aquaculture Tank Under Rolling Excitation Using Statistical Analysis and Proper Orthogonal Decomposition
papers.authors: Feng, Xianren; Liu, Taijin; Ni, Weiqiang; Yu, Youbin; Wang, Liang; Yu, Duo; Huang, Wenyun; Zhang, Anbing
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Large-scale offshore aquaculture vessels provide an effective approach for expanding marine aquaculture; however, the complex flow characteristics induced by water circulation systems and vessel motion remain insufficiently understood. In this study, a numerical model based on the volume of fluid (VOF) method and the k-ω SST-DES turbulence model was developed to investigate the vortex flow characteristics. The developed numerical model accurately captured the vortex flow characteristics and free-surface fluctuations in the aquaculture tank, and the dominant coherent structures were identified using Q-criterion-based proper orthogonal decomposition (POD). The results show that the mean vortex structure is mainly concentrated around the central axis, while higher-order POD modes reveal vortex-core oscillation, deformation, and interactions with surrounding flow structures. Furthermore, the effects of roll excitation and its coupling with inlet jet flow were investigated. The results demonstrate that roll motion induces significant periodic fluctuations in the flow field, while the inlet jet flow maintains the stability of the central vortex structure and reduces velocity variations. These findings provide new insights into the hydrodynamic mechanisms governing vortex evolution under combined vessel motion and water circulation and offer a scientific basis for optimizing flow conditions in large-scale offshore aquaculture tanks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对大型海上养殖工船养殖舱内由水循环系统与船体运动共同诱导的复杂流场，采用VOF方法与k-ω SST-DES湍流模型进行数值模拟，并利用基于Q准则的POD方法识别主导相干结构。结果表明，平均涡结构主要集中于中心轴线附近，高阶POD模态揭示了涡核的振荡、变形及其与周围流场的相互作用。横摇激励引起流场显著周期性波动，而进水射流则维持中心涡结构稳定性并降低速度波动，为大型海上养殖舱流场优化提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Abundance, distribution, and origins of hawksbill sea turtles on the nearshore Atlantic reefs of the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
papers.authors: Wood, Lawrence D.; Boyd, Liberty L.; Nolte, Christopher R.; Skinner, Emily; Fanelli, Gianna; Duffy, David J.
papers.abstract: Hawksbill sea turtles (Eretmochelys imbricata) representing multiple regional stocks are known to reside in SE Florida, and play an important functional role in the health of coral reef ecosystems. However, baseline data concerning the abundance and distribution of hawksbills in the Florida Keys are lacking. Between 2015-2024, over 280 hours of in-water snorkeling surveys on the shallow coral reefs (&lt;10 m) in the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary (FKNMS) from Key Largo (25.4276N, 80.1246W) through Key West (24.4463N, 81.9268W) resulted in the hand-capture of 76 hawksbill turtles (mean straight carapace length 39.3 cm (range 19.3 - 63.5 cm). Growth rates among re-captured turtles averaged 6.3 cm yr -1 (range 2.5-10.2 cm yr -1 , n = 12). Among the seventeen distinct Caribbean haplotypes identified via mtDNA, mixed-stock analyses revealed a significant but weakening bias toward representatives of Mexican rookeries coupled with indications of increasing diversity over time. It is apparent the shallow reefs of the FKNMS represent valuable entry points for post oceanic-stage hawksbills establishing themselves in the State’s neritic habitats and should be regarded as critical to sustaining the long-term presence of this highly imperiled species in Florida waters.
papers.summary_cn: 2015—2024年在Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary浅水珊瑚礁（<10 m）开展逾280小时水下目视调查，手工捕获76只hawksbill sea turtles（平均SCL 39.3 cm），重捕个体平均生长率6.3 cm/yr。mtDNA分析鉴定出17种加勒比单倍型，mixed-stock分析显示墨西哥产卵场贡献占优但该优势随时间减弱、多样性上升。结果表明FKNMS浅水礁区是oceanic-stage后幼龟进入近岸neritic栖息地的重要入口，对该濒危物种在佛罗里达水域的长期存续具有关键意义。

papers.title: Decoding Dietary Fat: Molecular Sensing, Brain Integration, and the Biology of Flavor
papers.authors: Abdel-Sater, Khaled Ahmed
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Physiology and Pharmacology
papers.abstract: Background and Aim: Dietary fat perception influences food preference, satiety, and metabolic regulation but remains incompletely understood. This review examines current knowledge regarding receptor-mediated fat sensing, neural integration, adaptive plasticity, and their clinical implications. Methods: Evidence was collected from major biomedical databases through June 2026. Human and experimental studies addressing molecular receptors, psychophysical testing, electrophysiology, neuroimaging, genetics, and metabolic physiology were critically synthesized. Results: CD36 and GPR120 function as principal lipid sensors alongside FFAR1, GPR84, FFAR2, and TGR5. Oral lipid detection is integrated with retronasal olfactory processing, trigeminal signaling, endocrine responses, and cortical reward networks. Fat perception demonstrates remarkable adaptability through receptor regulation, inflammatory remodeling, epigenetic modification, and dietary exposure. Methodological heterogeneity remains a major limitation across psychophysical and molecular investigations. Conclusion: Evidence supports a distributed, adaptive, and metabolically regulated system of dietary fat perception rather than an isolated sensory pathway. Improved methodological standardization and multidisciplinary approaches will accelerate translation into personalized dietary interventions and metabolic therapeutics.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了膳食脂肪感知的分子受体机制、神经整合及适应性可塑性，涉及 CD36、GPR120 等脂质传感器及皮层奖赏网络。脂肪感知并非孤立感觉通路，而是分布式、可适应且受代谢调控的系统，方法学异质性仍是当前研究的主要局限。内容属营养生理与感官生物学范畴，与渔业科学无直接关联。

papers.title: Mitochondrial Genomes of Micropterus cataractae, Micropterus henshalli, and Micropterus punctulatus: Expanded Genetic Resources for Management
papers.authors: Jett, Julianna J.; Raines, Clayton D.; Mazik, Patricia M.; Sammons, Steven M.; Holt, Cynthia F.; Cooper, Morgan B.; Cornman, R. Scott; Iwanowicz, Luke R.
papers.abstract: The shoal bass (SHB; Micropterus cataractae) and the Alabama bass (ALB; Micropterus henshalli) are species of freshwater fish in the Centrarchidae family of the order Centrarchiformes native to many states in the southeastern United States. Shoal bass currently face the threat of introgression with introduced black bass species in their native range. Conversely, Alabama bass have been introduced both intentionally by state resource managers and illegally by anglers outside of their native range throughout the United States, which could cause introgression with largemouth bass (M. nigricans) and other black bass species. In this study, we establish the first reference mitogenomes of ALB, SHB and spotted bass (SPB; M. punctulatus) for mitochondrial phylogenetics and (meta-)barcoding, which will also facilitate further variant detection in this clade by population-level resequencing. Total lengths of the ALB, SHB, and SPB mitogenomes are 16,480 bp (G + C; 47.1%), 16,487 bp (G + C; 46.6%) and 16,486 bp (G + C; 46.7%), respectively. The mitogenomes are consistent with those of other Micropterus spp. in respect of coding region content and organization. Primer sets targeting the 12S rRNA and 16S rRNA genes commonly used in environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding applications were evaluated, and those suitable to discriminate species-level identification of these species were identified. The information presented here can be applied to inform SHB conservation efforts in their native range and the biosurveillance and control of introduced ALB.
papers.summary_cn: 研究报道了浅滩黑鲈（Micropterus cataractae）、阿拉巴马黑鲈（M. henshalli）和斑点黑鲈（M. punctulatus）的首个参考线粒体基因组，长度分别为16,487 bp、16,480 bp和16,486 bp，编码区内容与结构与其他黑鲈属物种一致。研究评估了常用于eDNA宏条形码的12S rRNA和16S rRNA引物组，筛选出可实现这三种鱼种级鉴别的引物。该遗传资源可用于浅滩黑鲈原生境的保护管理，以及外来阿拉巴马黑鲈的生物监测与种群控制。

papers.title: Delay-induced Hopf bifurcation in a coral-macroalgae system under carbon-driven acidification stress
papers.authors: Abraham, Jilu; Tangri, Shreya; Kalra, Preety
papers.abstract: Ocean acidification can reduce coral growth, alter coral-macroalgae interactions, and weaken reef resilience. This study develops a delayed coral-macroalgae-acidification-pressure model describing live coral cover, fleshy macroalgal cover, and a dimensionless effective acidification-pressure index. The model incorporates coral-macroalgae overgrowth, external stress input, natural relaxation, macroalgal-associated attenuation, coral-associated feedback, and a delayed coral response to acidification pressure. We establish positivity and boundedness of solutions, determine biologically feasible equilibria, derive local stability conditions, and analyze the effect of delay on the coexistence state. The analysis identifies a critical delay at which the stable coexistence equilibrium loses stability through a Hopf bifurcation. For the baseline parameter set, the bifurcation is supercritical and generates a local branch of orbitally asymptotically stable periodic orbits. Numerical simulations, sensitivity analysis, and robustness tests support the analytical findings and show how coral stress sensitivity, external forcing, and reef-scale feedbacks influence stability thresholds and coral persistence. These results provide a mechanistic framework for examining how delayed ecological responses to acidification may promote oscillatory reef dynamics.
papers.summary_cn: 研究构建了碳驱动酸化胁迫下含时滞的珊瑚-大型海藻动力学模型，纳入珊瑚对酸化压力的延迟响应，通过稳定性分析与Hopf分岔分析确定了共存平衡态失稳的临界时滞。基线参数下分岔为超临界型，产生轨道渐近稳定的周期振荡。结果表明，酸化响应的时滞可驱动礁区珊瑚-海藻系统出现振荡动态，珊瑚胁迫敏感性与外部强迫共同影响稳定性阈值及珊瑚持续性。

papers.title: Environmental control of morphological color changes in the Bigfin Reef Squid, Sepioteuthis lessoniana
papers.authors: Chang, Annaliese; Kim, Da Eun; Hoffman, Adina; Lajbner, Zdenek; Miller, Jonathan; Alvarado, Sebastian Gaston
papers.abstract: Introduction Phenotypic plasticity enables organisms to adjust their traits in response to environmental conditions, yet studies of animal coloration, particularly in cephalopods, have largely focused on rapid neural control while overlooking slower changes in the cellular substrate underlying color change. Here, we investigated whether morphological color change contributes to phenotypic plasticity in the bigfin reef squid ( Sepioteuthis lessoniana ). Methods Hatchlings were reared for 14 weeks in contrasting dark (black) and light (white) environments. Chromatophore organization was quantified at 4, 9, and 14 weeks post-hatching in dorsal and ventral mantle regions using high-resolution brightfield microscopy and automated image analysis. We examined how age, rearing environment, and body region influenced the number and size of black, yellow, and red chromatophores using weighted linear mixed-effects models. Results Chromatophore organization changed substantially across development and was influenced by both environmental context and body region. Black-reared squid maintained higher numbers of black chromatophores, whereas white-reared squid exhibited fewer but generally larger black chromatophores at later developmental stages, revealing an inverse relationship between chromatophore number and size. Yellow chromatophore number also increased in black-reared squid during later development, while yellow and red chromatophore size showed environment-, age-, and region-specific responses. Dorsoventral differences became increasingly pronounced with age, particularly through a decline in ventral black chromatophores, consistent with the development of countershading. Discussion These findings demonstrate that the cellular substrate underlying cephalopod color change is itself phenotypically plastic and is dynamically remodeled across development in response to sustained visual environments. The apparent tradeoff between chromatophore number and size suggests that different environments can produce distinct pigmentary architectures. We propose that this slower morphological plasticity establishes a changing substrate upon which rapid neural control operates, potentially recalibrating the dynamic range of color change across development. Together, these results expand current frameworks of cephalopod coloration by integrating developmental, environmental, and cellular mechanisms across multiple timescales.
papers.summary_cn: 以 bigfin reef squid（*Sepioteuthis lessoniana*）为对象，将孵化幼体分别置于黑色与白色环境中饲养14周，于4、9、14周定量分析背、腹部外套膜黑色、黄色和红色 chromatophore 的数量与大小，以探究形态性体色变化是否构成表型可塑性。结果显示，chromatophore 组织随发育显著变化，并受环境与体区共同影响：黑色环境组黑色 chromatophore 数量更多，白色环境组后期数量较少但个体更大，呈现数量与大小的权衡；黄色 chromatophore 数量在黑色环境组后期增加，红、黄色 chromatophore 大小则呈环境、年龄和体区特异性响应；背腹差异随年龄增大，腹部黑色 chromatophore 减少，符合 countershading 发育。研究表明，头足类体色变化的细胞基础本身具有表型可塑性，并可在发育中依据持续视觉环境动态重塑，为快速神经调控提供不断变化的基质。

papers.title: Demographics of a coral-associated crab: growth and lifespan in Trapezia septata
papers.authors: Buyanovsky, Alexey I.; Merkin, Vadim A.; Nguyen, Thanh H.; Britayev, Temir A.
papers.abstract: The obligate coral-symbiotic crab Trapezia septata is a key mutualist in Pocillopora coral holobionts, providing essential services such as predator defense and sediment removal. However, fundamental life-history parameters, particularly growth rates and lifespan, remain unquantified, hindering the development of predictive population models for coral reef restoration. This study aims to estimate the growth, lifespan, and population dynamics of T. septata to support ecological restoration planning. From April 2022 to December2024, we monitored T. septata populations within experimental coral nurseries in Nha Trang Bay, Vietnam. A total of 563 crabs were collected from transplanted Pocillopora colonies. Carapace width (CW) was measured to 0.1 mm. Size-frequency distributions were analyzed using a 16-term moving average and separated into size-age groups via the NORMSEP method in FISAT II. Growth was modeled using the Von Bertalanffy growth function (VBGF), with parameters (CW∞=20.5 ± 2.5 mm, k=0.19 ± 0.01) estimated via the ELEFAN I method. Using VBGF, size-age groups were combined into sub-generations. Lifespan was derived from empirical cohort tracking, and longevity was predicted using VBGF. The maximum CW recorded for a sub-generation was 19.8 mm, corresponding to the most likely age of 15 months. This tracking value is close to that estimated using the VBGF (15.4 months). The mean monthly growth increment over the first 9 months post-settlement was 1.8 ± 0.0 mm. Crabs reached a mean carapace width of 3.9 ± 0.3 mm within one month of settlement, after which the growth rate declined with age to 1.2 ± 0.1 mm in the 6–9 months interval. We identified 13 distinct successive sub-generations, with lifespans ranging from 6 to over 15 months. Population dynamics followed a clear sequence: initial low abundance, a pronounced recruitment peak in spring 2023, and subsequent stabilization driven by longer-lived resident individuals. This study provides the first comprehensive estimates of growth and lifespan for T. septata and identifying seasonal recruitment pulses. Our findings underscore the importance of incorporating symbiont population dynamics into coral restoration frameworks. Ensuring the establishment of resident T. septata populations can enhance the resilience of restored corals, and timing outplanting to coincide with natural settlement peaks may improve restoration outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究以越南芽庄湾移植的 Pocillopora 珊瑚为对象，对专性珊瑚共生蟹 Trapezia septata 的种群进行了2022年4月至2024年12月的监测，基于563只个体的甲壳宽（CW）数据，采用 ELEFAN I 与 Von Bertalanffy 生长函数（VBGF）估算生长参数（CW∞=20.5 mm，k=0.19）及寿命。结果显示，最大甲壳宽19.8 mm 对应年龄约15个月，与 VBGF 预测值（15.4个月）接近；定居后前9个月月均生长量为1.8 mm，1个月内可达3.9 mm，此后生长随年龄下降。研究共识别出13个连续亚世代，寿命6至15个月以上，种群动态表现为初期低丰度、2023年春季显著的 recruitment 高峰及随后由长寿命定居个体驱动的稳定。该研究首次量化了 T. septata 的生长与寿命，强调将共生体种群动态纳入珊瑚修复框架，并建议将 outplanting 时间与自然定居高峰匹配以提升修复效果。

papers.title: Demographic consequences of reserve placement under directional larval dispersal in linear coastal systems
papers.authors: Saitou, Marie; Chavarie, Louise; Haugen, Thrond Oddvar
papers.abstract: Marine protected areas (MPAs) are widely implemented to protect or rebuild exploited populations, yet their population-level effectiveness remains variable. One unresolved question is how the spatial placement of no-take zones interacts with larval dispersal directionality, particularly in linear coastal systems where connectivity is often asymmetric. For sedentary species with planktonic larvae, such as European lobster, it remains unclear when reserve placement most strongly affects demographic recovery after exploitation. Here, we use a spatially explicit individual-based model parameterized for European lobster in a generic linear coastal system. We contrast Local, Broad dispersal, and Unidirectional larval dispersal scenarios across alternative MPA layouts with equal total protected area. We show that no-take zones increase abundance and the prevalence of large individuals relative to open areas. However, under Unidirectional dispersal, recovery depends on reserve placement: downstream no-take zones benefit from larval import and local retention, whereas upstream reserves primarily export larvae and show limited local recovery. These results identify dispersal directionality as a key determinant of when spatial configuration matters for MPA effectiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 基于个体模型模拟欧洲龙虾在幼体单向扩散的线性海岸系统中的种群动态，比较不同MPA布局（保护面积相同）对资源恢复的影响。研究发现禁渔区可提升种群丰度和大型个体比例，但单向扩散下恢复效果取决于保护区位置：下游保护区受益于幼体输入与本地滞留，上游保护区则以幼体输出为主、本地恢复有限。结果表明扩散方向性是决定空间布局何时影响MPA成效的关键因素。

papers.title: In situ evidence of tiered adaptations buffering a chemosynthetic clam holobiont against environmental sulfide fluctuations
papers.authors: Lan, Yi; Yan, Guoyong; Wang, Hao; Gao, Kexin; Lin, Yuxuan; Bhardwaj, Tulika; Lian, Chao; Wu, Bing-Zheng; Li, Jiying; Hubert, Casey R. J.
papers.abstract: Deep-sea holobionts adapt to extreme environmental fluctuations, but the molecular mechanisms underlying resilience remain poorly understood. We investigated the vesicomyid clam Archivesica marissinica and its sulfur-oxidizing symbionts during sulfide shortage via in situ transplant experiments at the Haima cold seep. Transplanting clams to sulfide-depleted conditions (moderate at HM-3 and severe at HM-2) revealed distinct response patterns of host-symbiont interaction. Symbionts may mitigate sulfide loss by shifting from sulfide oxidation to thiosulfate oxidation, supported by thiosulfate generated through host sulfide detoxification pathways. Notably, symbiont abundance remained stable under moderate sulfide shortage (HM-3), accompanied by down-regulation of host endosomal maturation and fusion with lysosomes, potentially limiting symbiont turnover. Conversely, severe sulfide shortage (HM-2) was associated with up-regulation of lysosomal pathways and lower symbiont abundance. These results demonstrate tiered molecular adaptations—metabolic flexibility and shifts in symbiont dynamics—enabling holobiont resilience to spatially heterogeneous sulfide availability in deep-sea seeps, supporting ecosystem stability.
papers.summary_cn: 研究通过原位移植实验，探讨深海冷泉 vesicomyid 蛤 *Archivesica marissinica* 及其硫氧化共生体在硫化物匮乏条件下的适应机制。结果显示，共生体可通过从硫化物氧化转向硫代硫酸盐氧化来缓解硫源不足，且宿主解毒途径产生的硫代硫酸盐为此提供支持。中度硫匮乏下共生体丰度稳定，伴随宿主内体成熟与溶酶体融合下调；严重匮乏则激活溶酶体途径并降低共生体丰度。研究表明，代谢灵活性与共生体动态变化构成分层适应策略，支撑 holobiont 应对冷泉硫化物空间异质性，维护生态系统稳定性。

papers.title: Reducing Resource Dependency in Aquaculture through Agricultural Waste-based Feed Innovations
papers.authors: Saidoddin, Syed Hamza Syed; Vaichalkar, Abhinav Ashok; Kambale, Sadananda Namdev; Waghmare, Shyam Datta
papers.journal: Journal of Agriculture and Ecology Research International
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is increasingly important to global food systems, yet its expansion depends on reliable supplies of nutritionally balanced and environmentally responsible feed ingredients. Fishmeal and fish oil remain valuable because of their nutrient density and palatability, but their availability, price volatility, and ecological implications have encouraged research into alternative resources. Agricultural residues and agro-industrial by-products offer opportunities to recover proteins, lipids, carbohydrates, minerals, pigments, and functional compounds while reducing disposal burdens. This comprehensive review examines the suitability of crop residues, fruit and vegetable by-products, oilseed meals, brewery residues, animal manures, aquaculture sludge, and other agro-industrial streams for aquafeed development. It evaluates physicochemical, chemical, enzymatic, and biological processing approaches, including extrusion, hydrolysis, fermentation, insect bioconversion, algal cultivation, and single-cell protein production. The review emphasises that waste-derived ingredients cannot be assessed solely on crude composition: digestible nutrient supply, anti-nutritional factors, contaminants, palatability, process yield, energy demand, water consumption, and supply-chain traceability must be considered together. A systems framework is proposed that links feedstock characterisation, hazard screening, bioprocessing, formulation, feeding trials, life-cycle assessment, and circular nutrient recovery. Evidence from recent reviews indicates promise for fruit by-products, fermented plant proteins, insect meals, brewery residues, and microbial ingredients, while also revealing substantial variation among species and processing conditions. Future research should prioritise standardised testing, techno-economic analysis, transparent life-cycle assessment, regional value-chain design, and regulatory harmonisation. Agricultural waste valorisation is therefore best understood as a context-specific portfolio of technologies rather than a single universal replacement for conventional feed ingredients.
papers.summary_cn: 水产养殖扩张受制于鱼粉、鱼油等传统饲料原料的供应与生态压力，本综述系统评估了作物残渣、果蔬副产物、油籽粕、酿造残渣、畜禽粪便及养殖污泥等农业废弃物作为替代 aquafeed 原料的可行性。文章比较了挤压、水解、发酵、昆虫生物转化、藻类培养及单细胞蛋白生产等加工路径，强调不能仅以粗成分评判废弃物原料，须综合考量可消化营养供给、抗营养因子、污染物、适口性、工艺能耗及供应链可追溯性。作者提出整合原料表征、危害筛查、生物加工、配方、投喂试验与 life-cycle assessment 的系统框架，认为农业废弃物 valorisation 应视为因地制宜的技术组合，而非传统饲料原料的单一通用替代品。

papers.title: Do Males and Females of Colossoma macropomum (Cuvier, 1818) Differ in Hematology and Blood Biochemistry During Sexual Maturation in a Recirculating Aquaculture System?
papers.authors: Santos, Fabio Aremil Costa dos; Júlio, Gustavo Soares da Costa; Souza, André de Sena; Ananias, Imaculada de Morais Carvalho; Silva, Sidney dos Santos; Favero, Gisele Cristina; Pedras, Pedro Paulo Cortezzi; Palheta, Glauber David Almeida; Bazzoli, Nilo; Luz, Ronald Kennedy
papers.abstract: Hematological and blood biochemical parameters are useful tools for monitoring fish physiological status; however, information on their variation between sexes during reproductive development remains limited for Colossoma macropomum. This study evaluated the hematological and blood biochemical profiles of male and female C. macropomum during growth and first sexual maturation under controlled conditions in a recirculating aquaculture system. Fish were sampled at seven ages from 590 to 1080 days after hatching (DAH). Hematocrit, total plasma protein, hemoglobin, leukocytes, erythrocytes, glucose, cholesterol, and triglycerides were evaluated, and reproductive development was assessed through macroscopic and histological examination of the gonads. Age significantly affected hematocrit, leukocytes, erythrocytes, glucose, triglycerides, cholesterol, and total plasma protein, whereas hemoglobin remained unchanged. Sex significantly affected only glucose, with females showing higher concentrations than males across ages. A significant sex × age interaction was detected only for total plasma protein, with higher concentrations in females than males at 1080 DAH. These findings indicate that developmental progression associated with age is a major source of variation in blood profiles, whereas sex-related effects are limited and parameter-specific. The results provide baseline physiological information for monitoring C. macropomum broodstock under controlled conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了封闭循环水养殖系统中 *Colossoma macropomum* 雌雄个体在生长及首次性成熟过程中的血液学和血液生化特征，在孵化后590至1080天间分7个时间点采样，测定血细胞比容、血浆总蛋白、血红蛋白、白细胞、红细胞、葡萄糖、胆固醇和甘油三酯，并通过性腺宏观与组织学检查评估生殖发育。结果显示，年龄显著影响除血红蛋白外的大部分血液指标，性别仅对葡萄糖有显著影响（雌鱼高于雄鱼），性别×年龄交互作用仅见于血浆总蛋白（1080 DAH时雌鱼较高）。研究表明，年龄相关的发育进程是血液指标变异的主要来源，性别效应有限且具有参数特异性，为受控条件下 *C. macropomum* 亲鱼生理监测提供了基础数据。

papers.title: Nursing behaviour in the franciscana dolphin (Pontoporia blainvillei blainvillei) off Ilhabela Archipelago, Brazil: implications for conservation and calf rehabilitation
papers.authors: Lucchini, Karen; Santos, Frank; Cardoso, Julio; Mesquita, Rafael; Ulman, Victoria L.; de Oliveira Luna, Fabia; Bezerra, Bruna
papers.abstract: Abstract Nursing behaviour in the franciscana dolphin ( Pontoporia blainvillei blainvillei ) remains poorly documented in the wild, limiting species-specific information available for conservation and rehabilitation. We report the first behaviourally annotated, drone-based in situ record of apparent nursing in a free-ranging franciscana group off Ilhabela Archipelago, Brazil. A 73-cm calf, corresponding to the 0–3-month age class, maintained a ventrolateral position near the female’s mammary region and displayed repeated mandibular movements consistent with suckling. This observation provides a species-specific behavioural reference for an early nursing stage and may contribute to future conservation and rehabilitation efforts for franciscanas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过无人机首次记录了巴西Ilhabela群岛附近自由生活franciscana dolphin（Pontoporia blainvillei blainvillei）群体的哺乳行为。一头73 cm幼豚（0–3月龄）持续贴近雌豚乳房区腹侧，并反复出现与吮吸一致的下颌运动。该观察为该物种早期哺乳阶段提供了行为学参考，有助于其保护与幼豚康复实践。

papers.title: Exploring the use of radiotelemetry and lifetime otolith 87 Sr / 86 Sr signatures to infer habitat use by dorado Salminus brasiliensis in the La Plata River basin
papers.authors: Lucas, Christine; Crossa, Marcelo; Hahn, Lisiane; Leisen, Mathieu; Duquenoy, Camille; Avigliano, Esteban
papers.abstract: Abstract Radiotelemetry and otolith chemistry are complementary methods for studying fish movement. 87 Sr/ 86 Sr signatures of two radio‐tagged dorado Salminus brasiliensis revealed long‐term presence in the Uruguay River and exposure to lower radiogenic waters potentially associated with the upper basin. Radiotelemetry data showed how variation in water 87 Sr/ 86 Sr can generate variation in otolith signatures without fish movement. Results suggest origins in the upper Uruguay River basin, and no evidence for migration to the Paraná River. These observations demonstrate the potential for integrative approaches to studying lifetime fish movement in South American rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究结合 radiotelemetry 与 otolith 87Sr/86Sr 特征，探讨 La Plata 流域 dorado（Salminus brasiliensis）的栖息地利用与生活史移动。两条无线电标记个体的 otolith 特征显示其长期存在于 Uruguay River，并曾暴露于可能来自上游流域的低放射成因水体。结果表明其可能起源于 upper Uruguay River basin，且无迁移至 Paraná River 的证据，同时说明水体 87Sr/86Sr 变化可在无移动情况下引起 otolith 特征变化。

papers.title: The Influence of Job Satisfaction and Organizational Commitment on Organizational Citizenship Behavior Through Employee Engagement Among Employees of the Maluku Province Marine and Fisheries Agency
papers.authors: Souhoka, Semuel; Chandra, Felix
papers.journal: West Science Social and Humanities Studies
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the influence of job satisfaction and organizational commitment on Organizational Citizenship Behavior (OCB) through Employee Engagement among employees of the Maluku Province Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Service. The study used a quantitative approach with a sample of 60 employees determined through a purposive sampling technique. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) method with the help of SmartPLS. The results showed that job satisfaction had a positive and significant effect on Employee Engagement and OCB. Organizational commitment had a positive and significant effect on Employee Engagement, but did not have a significant direct effect on OCB. Furthermore, Employee Engagement had a positive and significant effect on OCB and was proven to mediate the influence of job satisfaction and organizational commitment on OCB. These findings indicate that Employee Engagement has an important role in encouraging the formation of OCB behavior. Therefore, increasing job satisfaction, strengthening organizational commitment, and creating employee involvement in work need to be a concern in supporting positive behavior and employee contributions outside of formal duties.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以马鲁古省海洋与渔业局60名员工为样本，采用PLS-SEM分析工作满意度与组织承诺通过员工敬业度对组织公民行为（OCB）的影响。结果显示，工作满意度对敬业度和OCB均有显著正向影响，组织承诺显著影响敬业度但对OCB无直接显著效应，敬业度在两者与OCB之间起中介作用。研究提示提升员工敬业度有助于促进渔业行政机构员工的角色外贡献。

papers.title: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF HUMAN-RESOURCE STRATEGIES FOR SUSTAINABLE SMALL-SCALE FISHERIES
papers.authors: Irhamni, Muhammad Ricza; Astuti, Wulan Budi; Maskudi, Maskudi; Fauziah, Asma Zahro; Az-Zahra, Tridya Elliyana
papers.abstract: Small-scale fisheries (SSF) play a crucial role in global food security and livelihoods, but face the threat of marginalization in the Blue Economy paradigm, which is dominated by narratives of industrialization. This systematic review aims to synthesize evidence on human resource (HR) strategies to support the sustainability of SSF within the Blue Economy framework. A systematic review using the PRISMA protocol was conducted on 12 selected studies from the Scopus and Web of Science databases. The review revealed three main findings. First, there is a wide governance gap between the inclusive rhetoric of the Blue Economy and the reality on the ground, which marginalizes SSF communities. Second, effective HR strategies are multidimensional, encompassing women's empowerment (such as the TCMFEP model from Kerala), strengthening Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE)-based institutions, and long-term holistic capacity building. Third, significant methodological challenges and data gaps, including narrow definitions of SSF and data fragmentation, hinder effective research and policy formulation. It is concluded that realizing a just Blue Economy requires a paradigm shift towards inclusive governance, investment in transformative HR strategies, and a commitment to addressing data gaps through a transdisciplinary approach.
papers.summary_cn: 该系统性综述基于PRISMA协议，从Scopus和Web of Science筛选12项研究，旨在梳理蓝经济框架下支持小规模渔业（SSF）可持续性的人力资源策略。研究发现蓝经济的包容性话语与实地治理之间存在显著落差，SSF社区仍被边缘化；有效的人力资源策略具有多维性，涵盖妇女赋权（如Kerala的TCMFEP模式）、社会与团结经济（SSE）制度建设及长期整体能力建设。研究还指出SSF定义狭窄和数据碎片化等方法学挑战制约了研究与政策制定，呼吁转向包容性治理和跨学科路径以实现公正的蓝经济。

papers.authors: Uddin, Mohammed Nasir; Tripti, Syeda Marzia Islam; Akter, Sharmin; Rahman, Saifur; Rahman, Md. Asifur; Mazumder, Joyeeta; Jahan, Israt; Sadaf, Lubaba; Uddin, M. Salim; Donaldson, Joseph L.
papers.journal: Journal of Agricultural Extension and Rural Development
