papers.title: Client’s Perception of Aquaculture Extension Service in a Selected Sub-District of Bangladesh
papers.authors: Hossain, Sabbir; Sadat, Najmus; Chowdhury, Arifur Rahman; Rashid, Md. Mamun-ur-
papers.journal: Journal of the Bangladesh Agricultural University
papers.abstract: Aquaculture extension, a critical pathway for transferring modern technologies and knowledge to rural farmers, is crucial for food security and the economy of Bangladesh. This study examines the perceived quality of public aquaculture extension services in a selected sub-district of Bangladesh. The SERVPERF scale data were collected based on a seven-point Likert type scale from 230 randomly selected fish farmers who resided in the 15 selected villages under Barishal Sadar upazila (sub-district) of Barishal district. The findings indicate that the aquaculture extension service performs satisfactorily in assurance, responsiveness and tangible dimensions, whereas the performance is relatively low in the dimensions of reliability and empathy. The logistic regression findings confirm that among the dimensions of SERVPERF, responsiveness, reliability and empathy significantly influence the client’s overall satisfaction with the aquaculture extension service. The factor analytic results show that among the 20 statements of SERVPERF, nine statements grouped into three factors can be a viable tool for measuring the quality of aquaculture extension service. This study recommends individualized client care, the development of extension skills and the intention of the extension agents to provide need-based prompt service and to arrange extension programs considering the clients convenience. J Bangladesh Agril Univ 24(3): 346–354, 2026
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于SERVPERF量表对孟加拉国Barishal Sadar upazila 230名养殖渔民进行调查，评估公共水产养殖推广服务的感知质量。结果显示，推广服务在保证性、响应性和有形性维度表现令人满意，而可靠性和同理心维度相对较低；logistic回归表明响应性、可靠性和同理心显著影响客户整体满意度。研究建议提供个性化客户服务、提升推广人员技能并安排便利的推广项目。

papers.title: Phytoplankton Dynamics in Contrasting Coastal Embayments of South Australia: Implications for Bivalve Aquaculture
papers.authors: Rahman, Maziidah A.; Henderson, Shaun; van Ruth, Paul D.; Li, Xiaoxu; Li, Yan
papers.abstract: This study investigated seasonal phytoplankton communities in two contrasting oyster-growing embayments, Coffin Bay and Franklin Harbour (Eyre Peninsula, South Australia), to assess how environmental conditions influence food availability across the full phytoplankton size spectrum. In both embayments, nutrient availability was a major driver of phytoplankton dynamics during summer, while seasonal changes in physical conditions coincided with a shift in the phytoplankton community from oligotrophic to mesotrophic assemblages. In Coffin Bay, the community was dominated by picoplankton (<2 µm), accounting for more than 50% of total biomass for over 8 months of the year. In contrast, Franklin Harbour was dominated by larger phytoplankton (>20 µm). Productivity in outer Coffin Bay was primarily supported by inflowing shelf waters, which sustained peak picoeukaryote biomass (44.27 µg C L−1), and was further enhanced by a late-summer upwelling event in the eastern Great Australian Bight. However, productivity in Franklin Harbour was primarily generated internally, with the highest picoeukaryote biomass (68.15 µg C L−1) in the southern end. This study provides new insights into phytoplankton dynamics across the full spectrum in two contrasting embayments. The findings demonstrate how variations across the phytoplankton size spectrum can inform assessments of coastal productivity and carrying capacity, with implications for the sustainable management of bivalve aquaculture in temperate coastal regions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对比了南澳两个牡蛎养殖海湾（Coffin Bay与Franklin Harbour）浮游植物群落的季节动态，旨在评估环境条件如何影响全粒径谱的食物供给。夏季营养盐可利用性是浮游植物动态的主要驱动因子，物理条件的季节变化伴随群落由贫营养型向中营养型转变。Coffin Bay以picoplankton（<2 µm）为主，全年逾8个月占总生物量50%以上，其外侧生产力主要依赖外海陆架水输入及夏末上升流；Franklin Harbour则以较大粒径浮游植物（>20 µm）为主，生产力主要来自湾内自身生成。研究揭示了全粒径谱浮游植物变异对沿岸生产力与 carrying capacity 评估的意义，为温带沿海 bivalve aquaculture 的可持续管理提供依据。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Scientific Innovation and Commercial Adoption of Recirculating Aquaculture Systems: A Brazilian Perspective
papers.authors: Owatari, Marco Shizuo; Castilho-Barros, Leonardo; Martins, Maurício Laterça; Mouriño, José Luiz Pedreira
papers.abstract: If Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) are widely regarded as one of the most promising technologies for sustainable aquaculture, why has their commercial adoption remained relatively limited in countries such as Brazil? Despite the remarkable scientific progress achieved in RAS technology over the past decade, a significant gap remains between experimental advances and their widespread commercial implementation. Most published studies have focused on optimising individual system components, including biofiltration efficiency, water quality management, feeding strategies, functional additives, microbial communities, and fish performance under controlled experimental conditions. Although these studies have substantially advanced our understanding of RAS operation, relatively few have critically evaluated whether the reported technological improvements remain effective, economically viable, or operationally feasible when transferred to commercial production systems. Consequently, many innovations that demonstrate promising biological outcomes at laboratory or pilot scales have yet to be validated under the technical, economic, and logistical constraints faced by commercial aquaculture enterprises. The Brazilian evidence indicates a heterogeneous but increasingly mature scientific landscape. Shrimp production provides relatively strong evidence for intensive RAS, biofloc, low-water-exchange, and integrated systems, whereas marine fish and mollusc production remains more strongly concentrated on experimental and pilot-scale optimisation. The future of RAS will not depend solely on further technological innovation, but on the successful integration of biological performance, engineering efficiency, economic feasibility, and practical scalability into commercially viable production systems.
papers.summary_cn: 尽管RAS被视为可持续水产养殖最具前景的技术之一，但其在巴西等国的商业应用仍然有限。多数研究集中于实验室或中试条件下单个系统组件（如biofiltration、水质管理、投喂策略等）的优化，较少评估这些技术在商业生产系统中的有效性、经济可行性和操作可行性。巴西的证据显示，虾类养殖在intensive RAS、biofloc及低换水系统方面证据较强，而海水鱼类和软体动物仍以实验和中试规模为主。RAS的未来取决于将生物学性能、工程效率、经济可行性与实际可扩展性整合为商业可行的生产系统。

papers.title: Antibiotic Resistance Profile and Microbiological Quality of Bacteria Isolated from Street-vended Smoked Fish Sold in Owo, Ondo State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Bada, O. Sunday; Arijeniwa, O. C.; Babatunde, S. O.
papers.journal: South Asian Journal of Research in Microbiology
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in ready-to-eat foods is an increasing food-safety concern, particularly where food processing and retailing occur under informal conditions. This study evaluated the microbiological quality and antibiotic resistance profiles of bacteria isolated from street-vended smoked fish sold in Owo, Ondo State, Nigeria. Nine smoked fish samples were obtained from three vending locations and analysed using standard microbiological procedures. Bacterial isolates were identified through conventional biochemical methods, while antimicrobial susceptibility was assessed using the Kirby–Bauer disc diffusion method. Total heterotrophic bacterial counts ranged from 0.00 to 7.00 × 10⁶ CFU/g, whereas enteric bacterial counts ranged from 0.00 to 6.00 × 10⁶ CFU/g. Four bacterial genera were identified: Pseudomonas spp., Staphylococcus spp., Proteus spp. and Micrococcus spp. Pseudomonas and Staphylococcus isolates were resistant to all antibiotics tested, whereas Proteus spp. were susceptible to all antibiotics tested. Micrococcus spp. showed resistance to Ampiclox and ciprofloxacin. The findings demonstrate that street-vended smoked fish may contain viable bacterial contaminants after processing and that antimicrobial susceptibility patterns differ among the recovered organisms. The observed variation across markets also indicates that post-processing handling and retail conditions may influence microbiological quality. Improved hygienic handling, routine microbiological surveillance and antimicrobial-resistance monitoring are therefore important for strengthening the safety of smoked fish sold to consumers.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了尼日利亚Owo地区街头售卖熏鱼的微生物质量及分离菌株的抗生素耐药谱，采用标准微生物学方法和Kirby–Bauer纸片扩散法对9份样品进行分析。结果显示总异养菌数达0.00–7.00 × 10⁶ CFU/g，鉴定出Pseudomonas、Staphylococcus、Proteus和Micrococcus四属细菌，其中Pseudomonas和Staphylococcus对全部受试抗生素耐药，而Proteus均敏感。研究表明熏鱼加工后仍可能存在活菌污染，不同售卖点的微生物质量差异提示后期处理与零售条件的关键影响，强调需加强卫生操作与耐药性监测。

papers.title: Digital economy, green innovation, and high-quality development of the marine economy: evidence from China’s coastal regions
papers.authors: Sun, Xin; Xie, Tingyu; Li, Rui
papers.abstract: This study examines the association between the digital economy and high-quality marine economic development using panel data for 11 coastal provincial-level regions in China from 2014 to 2023. Composite indices of digital economy development (DIG) and high-quality marine economic development (MEHD) are constructed, and two-way fixed-effects and panel threshold models are used to examine the overall association and its variation across development conditions. The MEHD index captures selected dimensions of marine economic development and is narrower in scope than a sustainable blue economy. The baseline estimates show a statistically significant positive association between DIG and MEHD under conventional province-clustered inference. Multiple checks also yield positive results, but the association does not reach conventional significance levels after accounting for the small number of regions. Green patent application intensity is measured as the number of green patent applications per CNY 100 billion of regional GDP. The existence of a threshold receives statistical support only at the 10% level. Conditional on the estimated threshold, the DIG coefficients are positive in both regimes, with a larger point estimate in the high-intensity regime. Cross-group tests do not reject coefficient equality across regions, periods, or income groups, whereas the urbanization-group difference is significant under conventional province-clustered inference (p=0.027). With only 11 provincial clusters, the threshold and urbanization findings provide exploratory evidence of conditional differences. The study provides provincial evidence on digitalization and high-quality marine economic development, informing context-sensitive approaches to marine-sector digitalization, green innovation, and regional governance that seek to align economic development with environmental sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2014—2023年中国11个沿海省级面板数据，构建数字经济（DIG）与海洋经济高质量发展（MEHD）综合指数，采用双向固定效应与面板门槛模型检验二者关联。基准估计显示DIG与MEHD显著正相关，绿色专利申请强度在门槛模型下仅获10%水平统计支持，且高门槛区间系数点估计更大。受限于仅11个省级聚类，门槛效应与城镇化分组差异（p=0.027）仅为探索性证据，研究为海洋产业数字化与绿色创新的区域治理提供省级经验参考。

papers.title:
Global Distribution
of Freshwater Paralytic Shellfish
Poisoning Toxins (“Saxitoxins”) 1967–2025: Implications,
Limitations, and Application to Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Smith, Zacharias J.; Arlinghaus, Kandis M.; Hapeman, Cathleen J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Paralytic shellfish poisoning (PSP) toxins (PSPTs) (“Saxitoxins”) are a class of neurotoxins identified globally in freshwater and marine systems but are understudied in freshwater environments. We collected literature reports of PSPTs in natural systems from their first discovery in 1967 until 2025, with the aim of summarizing their occurrence. Freshwater PSPTs were commonly reported (&gt;20% of waterbodies in 14/21 studies), with complex congener profiles including 21 primary congeners. Saxitoxin (STX) represented only 18% of the total, suggesting that methods focused primarily on STX are not adequately protective of environmental health. The most common PSPT producing genera were species of Aphanizomenon, but over 40% of reports could or did not assign a producer to the identified toxins. While there were many analytical methodologies incorporated by localized studies, those investigating multiple waterbodies (&gt;6) tended to use only one analytical method. Our exposure assessment was inhibited by this subset of studies having study-specific limitations, severely restricting the use of these data for risk assessment. Toxicological uncertainty further hampered risk assessment – dose–response data for acute consumption of PSPTs has been generated and assessed, but questions remain about the accuracy of the no-observed-adverse-effect-level. Chronic/sub-chronic PSP toxicity data has been collected in animal models but there are no regulatory guidelines that utilize these for guidance values. The evidence indicates that PSPT production potential is widespread in freshwater environments, but most existing data do not accurately assess environmental concentration. Given these uncertainties, there is significant potential for harm from exposure to freshwater PSPTs.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究系统收集了1967—2025年间全球淡水环境中paralytic shellfish poisoning toxins（PSPTs，saxitoxins）的文献报道，旨在总结其分布特征并评估用于risk assessment的可行性。结果显示淡水PSPTs普遍存在（14/21项研究中超过20%的水体检出），congener组成复杂，包含21种主要congeners，其中saxitoxin（STX）仅占18%，提示仅以STX为靶标的方法不足以保护环境健康；主要产毒属为Aphanizomenon，但超过40%的报道未能确定产毒生物。研究指出，多水体研究多采用单一分析方法，加之毒理学数据（如NOAEL准确性、慢性毒性guidance values缺失）的不确定性，严重限制了现有数据在risk assessment中的应用，淡水PSPTs暴露的潜在危害不容忽视。

papers.title: Integrating Dynamic Ocean Management (DOM) and Real-Time Climate Indices into Harvest Strategies for Fish Stocks
papers.authors: Chukwu, K. O.
papers.journal: African Journal of Environment and Sustainable Development
papers.abstract: Traditional fisheries management often relies on static spatial boundaries and historical averages that fail to account for the rapid, climate-driven fluctuations of the modern ocean. As marine species shift their distributions and productivity levels in response to warming and acidification, the "stationarity" assumption in stock assessments has become a liability. This article explores the integration of Dynamic Ocean Management (DOM)—management that changes in space and time based on near real-time data—and Real-Time Climate Indices (e.g., ENSO, PDO, and local thermal anomalies) into formal Harvest Control Rules (HCRs). We argue that this synthesis provides a "climate-ready" framework capable of mitigating overfishing risks, reducing bycatch, and stabilizing economic yields in an increasingly volatile environment.
papers.summary_cn: 传统渔业管理依赖静态空间边界与历史均值，难以应对气候驱动的海洋快速波动，使 stock assessment 中的平稳性假设成为风险来源。本文探讨将 Dynamic Ocean Management (DOM) 与实时气候指数（如 ENSO、PDO 及局地热异常）纳入正式 Harvest Control Rules (HCRs)，构建“气候就绪”管理框架。该框架有望降低过度捕捞风险、减少兼捕并在环境波动加剧下稳定经济产量。

papers.title: Baseline physiological data and enzymatic valorization of fishery waste for female <i>Odontesthes argentinensis</i> nutrition
papers.authors: Rodriguez, Yamila E.; Del Valle, Juana C.; Friedman, Ivana S.; Laitano, María Victoria; Liébana, Clara; Zanazzi, Aldo N.; Fernández-Gimenez, Analia V.
papers.abstract: This study investigated the energy storage patterns in wild female Odontesthes argentinensis collected during autumn in the coastal waters of Mar del Plata (Argentina) to assess their suitability as breeders and explored innovative enzyme-based feeding strategies to improve food quality, nutrient utilization, and nutritional management of breeders in this species. Biochemical analyses showed that the liver was the primary storage organ for lipids and proteins, while the fatty acid profiles were consistent with a capital breeding strategy associated with seasonal reproduction. However, because this study was based on a single seasonal sampling and lacked ovarian stage classification, gonadosomatic or hepatosomatic indices, and a temporal series, these findings should be interpreted as preliminary evidence and should not be taken as sufficient to definitively classify the reproductive strategy. To improve the nutritional value of soybean meal, enzymatic treatment with peptidases from Urophycis brasiliensis under acidic conditions (pH 2) reduced antinutritional compounds while preserving bioactive molecules, thereby enhancing protein quality. In addition, in vitro combination of exogenous peptidase extracts from fisheries waste with digestive enzymes of O. argentinensis increased proteolytic activity, suggesting synergistic interactions that warrant testing in future feeding trials. Together, these findings provide physiological and nutritional insights that can contribute to the development of feeding strategies for O. argentinensis females. Furthermore, the use of fishery waste as sources of digestive enzymes represents a promising biotechnological approach to improve feed digestibility while promoting more sustainable aquaculture practices. Nevertheless, further studies assessing digestibility, fish performance, extraction yields, safety, economic feasibility, and environmental impacts are needed to substantiate these potential benefits.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以阿根廷马德普拉塔近岸秋季采集的野生雌性Odontesthes argentinensis为对象，分析其能量储存模式以评估其作为亲鱼的适宜性，并探索基于酶制剂的饲料改良策略。生化分析表明肝脏是该物种脂质和蛋白质的主要储存器官，脂肪酸谱与季节性繁殖相关的capital breeding策略一致，但受限于单季采样及缺乏性腺指数等数据，上述结论仅为初步证据。利用Urophycis brasiliensis来源的肽酶在酸性条件（pH 2）下处理豆粕可降低抗营养因子并保留生物活性分子，且其与O. argentinensis消化酶的体外组合表现出协同蛋白酶活性增强效应。研究提示渔业废弃物可作为消化酶来源用于提升饲料消化率，但尚需通过消化率、生长性能及经济环境可行性等试验加以验证。

papers.title: Near-term impacts of the 2024 mass coral bleaching event on benthic and fish communities in Okinawa Island, southern Japan
papers.authors: Kimura, Lucas Yutaka; Gomez, Rickdane; Nakamura, Takashi
papers.summary_cn: 2024年大规模珊瑚白化事件对日本冲绳岛南部底栖与鱼类群落的短期影响研究，具体方法、结果及渔业相关结论因摘要缺失无法概述。

papers.title: Algal overgrowth disproportionately undermines fish species richness in coral‐rich reefs
papers.authors: Liu, Shurong; Liu, Min; Zhang, Zhixin; Cao, Ling
papers.abstract: Abstract Algal overgrowth on coral reefs threatens reef fish species richness worldwide, yet the variation in this pressure across gradients of coral cover remains unclear. Using a global dataset spanning 2006–2023, we examined how cover by low‐lying algae and macroalgae modulates the relationship between live hard coral cover and fish species richness. Our results demonstrated that overgrowth of both algal groups attenuated the positive contribution of coral cover to fish species richness, with context‐dependent thresholds: the effects of low‐lying algae were observed when coral cover was below 45%, whereas the effects of macroalgae persisted until 65% coral cover. Notably, within these ranges, the negative impact of algal overgrowth on fish richness was linearly amplified as coral cover increased. Trait analyses showed that the attenuation strength varied among fish species according to their diet and body size. By synthesizing findings on specific coral‐cover thresholds for algal impacts and fish trait‐mediated vulnerabilities, our study provides a strategic basis for algal management designed to prevent rapid declines in fish species richness and protect highly sensitive functional guilds, thereby ensuring the stability of coral reef ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2006—2023年全球数据集，研究探讨了低矮藻类与大型藻类覆盖如何调节活造礁石珊瑚覆盖度与鱼类物种丰富度之间的关系。结果表明，两类藻类过度生长均削弱了珊瑚覆盖度对鱼类丰富度的正向贡献，且存在情境依赖阈值：低矮藻类的影响在珊瑚覆盖度低于45%时显现，大型藻类的影响则持续至65%。在此范围内，藻类过度生长对鱼类丰富度的负面影响随珊瑚覆盖度升高而线性放大，且不同食性与体型的鱼类受削弱程度各异。

papers.title: Examining depredation of reef fish on descender devices across the Gulf of Mexico
papers.authors: Jargowsky, Amanda E; Anderson, Alena Q; McAree, Danielle M; Jargowsky, Matthew B; Collins, Angela B; Streich, Matthew K; Haddad, Nicholas A; Sipos, Michael J; Drymon, J  Marcus
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective We partnered with the charter-for-hire fishing fleet to document depredation rates of fish on ­descender devices across the U.S. Gulf of Mexico and identify the species responsible for depredation. Methods Two types of data were collected: (1) underwater video footage of fish descents on fish descender devices called SeaQualizers and (2) information about fishing sites and fish that were descended. All resulting video footage was then analyzed. Each recorded fish descent was assigned water clarity and vision field scores. The presence and, if applicable, the identity of the predators were logged. The fate of each descended fish was assigned. Results From March 2022 to March 2024, 987 fish descents were successfully recorded off Texas, Louisiana, Alabama, and Florida. Most of the descended fish—representing 20 species in total—were Red Snapper Lutjanus campechanus or Red Grouper Epinephelus morio. Based on all video footage recorded during the study, only three fish on descender devices were depredated, and all three were Red Snapper. Conclusions Our study suggests that depredation, though a significant occurrence among ascending fish (i.e., fish being caught), does not frequently impact reef fish on descender devices. The video footage indicated that depredation of fish returning to depth on descender devices is exceedingly rare. The overall depredation rate of fish on descender devices was 0.3%, and the depredation rate of fish on descender devices at sites where fish were depredated on ascent was 1.3%.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究与美国墨西哥湾 charter-for-hire 船队合作，通过水下视频记录鱼在 descender devices（SeaQualizers）下沉过程中的 depredation 事件，并鉴定捕食者种类。2022年3月至2024年3月在德克萨斯、路易斯安那、阿拉巴马和佛罗里达海域共记录987次鱼类下沉，涉及20个物种，以 Red Snapper 和 Red Grouper 为主。结果显示仅3尾 Red Snapper 在下沉过程中被 depredation，总体 depredation rate 为0.3%，表明 descender devices 释放的礁鱼遭受捕食极为罕见。

papers.title: A survey of the Lake Superior cisco complex using integrated morphological and genetic tools reveals a presumed extinct species, Shortnose Cisco (Coregonus reighardi)
papers.authors: Gorman, Owen T.; Ackiss, Amanda; Pratt, Thomas C; Lyons, Joshua F; Renauer-Bova, Renee E; Siegel, Vinnie; Ropp, Ann J; Kao, Yu-Chun
papers.abstract: Throughout the 19th and 20th centuries, anthropogenic activities resulted in losses of ciscoes in the Laurentian Great Lakes (LGL) and only Lake Superior was left with a relatively intact complex. In 1929, W. Koelz described six cisco species from Lake Superior: Coregonus artedi, C. hoyi, C. kiyi, C. zenithicus, C. reighardi, and C. nigripinnis. Of these, artedi, hoyi and kiyi remain abundant in Lake Superior, zenithicus is considered extirpated throughout the LGL except in Lake Superior, and reighardi and nigripinnis are considered extinct. We present results reaffirming the presence of artedi, hoyi, and kiyi, and the presence of the presumed extinct reighardi. Our analysis did not confirm the presence of zenithicus and nigripinnis. The principal morphological characters that distinguish artedi, hoyi, kiyi, and reighardi reflect habitat and trophic specialization: eye size, gillraker length and gillraker spacing. The discovery of reighardi is expected to stimulate conservation and restoration of rare ciscoes in the LGL, and our integrated morphological and genetic approach can provide insights into the evolution, diversity, and ecology of ciscoes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究综合形态学与遗传学工具，对苏必利尔湖 cisco 复合体（Coregonus spp.）进行调查，旨在厘清各物种的现存状况。结果显示 artedi、hoyi 和 kiyi 依然存在，并重新发现了此前被认为已灭绝的 Shortnose Cisco（C. reighardi），但未确认 zenithicus 和 nigripinnis 的存在。区分 artedi、hoyi、kiyi 与 reighardi 的主要形态特征为眼径、鳃耙长度及鳃耙间距，反映了栖息地与摄食特化差异。reighardi 的重新发现有望推动 Laurentian Great Lakes 稀有 cisco 的保护与恢复。

papers.title: The power of baseline data from fixed sampling sites: a simulation-based power analysis of marine harvest refugia
papers.authors: Gemmell, Olivia Margaret; Francis, Fiona; Nephin, Jessica; Anderson, Sean C.; Lowry, Dayv; Pacunski, Robert E; Dudas, Sarah; Haggarty, Dana R.
papers.abstract: Marine harvest refugia help conserve biodiversity and ecosystems; however, evaluating their effectiveness with adequate statistical power is challenging. Quantifying adequately powered sampling needs can improve data collection methods and study design, precision, and minimize costs. Conventional power equations are not designed for complex ecosystem models and, together with sparse pre-intervention data, have resulted in limited evidence of refugia effectiveness. We conditioned a spatially explicit Gaussian Markov random field model to fish density data from remotely operated vehicles, and compared two sampling schemes using a simulation-based power analysis. We quantified power to detect abundance recovery by comparing Early-Later-Control-Impact and Control-Impact designs with different sampling strategies and effort levels. Results indicate that (1) early samples were highly valuable, especially given initial fish abundance differed substantially from expectations; (2) small sample sizes inflated effect estimates, suggesting that type M (magnitude) errors should be considered; and (3) repeatedly sampling fixed locations—rather than selecting new random sites within or across an expanded sampling domain—improved power up to 35%, reducing the necessary sample size. These findings provide guidance for designing cost-effective monitoring programs that can reliably detect recovery in marine harvest refugia.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过基于模拟的 power analysis，评估 marine harvest refugia 中鱼类丰度恢复的检测效能，比较了 Early-Later-Control-Impact 与 Control-Impact 设计在不同采样策略和努力量下的表现。研究基于 ROV 鱼类密度数据构建空间显式 Gaussian Markov random field 模型，发现早期样本价值极高，小样本量会膨胀效应估计（需关注 type M error），而重复采样固定位点较随机选取新位点可将 power 提升最多 35%，并减少所需样本量。结果为设计经济有效的海洋保护性监测方案提供了指导。

papers.title: Effects of turbulence-inducing baffles on passage performance of brook trout, white sucker, and sea lamprey: implications for conservation and control
papers.authors: Abdelbaky, Mahmoud; Mathew, Dencil; Lacey, R.W. Jay; Goerig, Elsa; Heisey, Aaron; Chénard, Gabriel; Castro-Santos, Theodore
papers.abstract: Invasive sea lamprey (Petromyzon marinus) control in the Great Lakes is ongoing. Installing passive selective passage structures could reduce costs, yet there is a need to evaluate such methods under realistic hydraulic conditions to inform designs. In this study, we evaluated the swimming performance of brook trout (Salvelinus fontinalis), white sucker (Catostomus commersonii), and sea lamprey under manipulated flows and baffle configurations in a 35 m flume lined with substrate preventing attachment. Using accelerated failure time models, we examined ascent distance (Dmax) under two slopes (1% and 3%) and velocities from 0.25–3.0 m s⁻¹. Responses varied by species: white sucker had the greatest Dmax, especially at 1% slope, whereas sea lamprey, despite lacking paired fins/rays, occasionally exceeded white sucker at 3% with small spoiler baffles and bare substrate. Contrary to common perception, brook trout, the only salmonid in this study, performed less well than the other two species. Across species, higher velocities impaired performance, with declines linked to energy dissipation (EDF). Findings show how hydraulic structures shape species-specific passage.
papers.summary_cn: 研究在35 m水槽中设置不同baffle构型与流速（0.25–3.0 m s⁻¹）、坡度（1%和3%），评估brook trout、white sucker与invasive sea lamprey的游泳能力与上溯距离（Dmax），以探讨被动选择性passage结构在sea lamprey控制中的可行性。结果显示white sucker的Dmax最大，sea lamprey在小spoiler baffles和裸底质、3%坡度下偶尔超过white sucker，而brook trout表现最差；流速升高普遍降低上溯性能，且与能量耗散（EDF）相关。研究表明水力结构对物种通行具有特异性影响，可为保护与入侵种控制的设计提供依据。

papers.title: Otolith microchemistry reveals Northern Snakehead recruitment and dispersal patterns in Virginia tributaries of the Potomac River
papers.authors: Kim, Hae H; Odenkirk, John S; Isel, Mike W; Willis, Robert; Nelson, T Reid; Phelps, Quinton E
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Understanding fish movement patterns can provide valuable biological and ecological insights for management, particularly when movement across interjurisdictional boundaries and ecologically significant habitats occur. Otolith microchemistry can elucidate broadscale movement patterns and help define population structure, identify relative stock contribution, and quantify dispersal patterns. We sought to quantify dispersal patterns of Northern Snakehead Channa argus across Potomac River tributaries. Our objectives were to determine movement between, or fidelity across, tributaries, identify potential recruitment sources, and delineate overall population structure. Methods To evaluate Northern Snakehead movement patterns, we assessed Sr:Ca and Ba:Ca ratios in juvenile and adult Northern Snakehead otoliths. Fish were collected across Virginia Potomac River tidal freshwater tributaries from Stafford County, Virginia (approximately 40 mi south of Washington, D.C.), to the Pentagon Basin, Washington, D.C. Linear discriminant function analysis was used to train and develop models. Models were evaluated and used to assign fish to known collection tributaries. Results Overall model accuracy was high (90%) at subbasin watershed (8-digit hydrologic unit) levels, and both elemental ratios appeared to increase downstream. These models were used to assign natal origin using otolith core signatures and revealed movement patterns, suggesting that dispersal rates may be high in certain environments. Natal fidelity was high downstream, and dispersal contributed to upstream populations. Conclusions Northern Snakehead dispersal appears to be high and likely facilitated expansion after ­introduction. Newly established populations may possess the capacity to rapidly colonize and disperse. Broad management and control strategies could target areas with high recruitment and dispersal capabilities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用耳石微化学（Sr:Ca、Ba:Ca比值）结合线性判别函数分析，量化美国波托马克河弗吉尼亚州支流中北方蛇头鱼（*Channa argus*）的扩散模式与种群结构。模型在8位水文单元尺度下判别准确率达90%，耳石核心签名揭示下游出生忠实度高，扩散个体主要补充上游种群。结果表明该物种扩散能力强，可能是其引入后快速扩张的重要机制，建议将管理控制重点放在高补充与高扩散能力的区域。

papers.title: Beyond abundance: ecological and functional relevance of intestinal fungi in the fish gut microbiome
papers.authors: Vargas-Albores, Francisco; Garibay-Valdez, Estefanía; Guirado-Flores, Jesús Salvador Olivier; Martínez-Córdova, Luis Rafael; Méndez-Martínez, Yuniel; Medina-Félix, Diana; Cortés-Jacinto, Edilmar; Martínez-Porchas, Marcel
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish gut microbiome research primarily focuses on bacterial communities, while intestinal fungi are often treated as low-abundance background signals or environmental contaminants. Here, we argue that this asymmetry is no longer justified. Evidence from fish systems demonstrates recurrent gut-associated fungi, context-dependent assembly shaped by the host and environment, and multiple routes by which fungi influence host outcomes despite low read fractions. These include extracellular enzymatic activity, immune modulation, and cross-kingdom ecological interactions. Importantly, low fungal read fractions do not indicate low abundance or activity, as cross-kingdom sequencing comparisons are complicated by technical factors, including differential DNA extraction and host DNA contamination. Integrating fungi into conceptual models of the fish gut microbiome requires moving beyond abundance-based interpretations toward a framework grounded in ecological filtering, functional specialization, and redundancy.
papers.summary_cn: 该文主张鱼类肠道真菌不应因测序丰度低而被视为背景信号或污染物。作者基于鱼类系统中肠道相关真菌的反复出现、宿主与环境共同驱动的群落组装，以及胞外酶活性、免疫调节和跨界生态互作等功能证据，指出低真菌 read fraction 并不代表低丰度或低活性，并受 DNA 提取差异和宿主 DNA 污染等技术因素影响。研究呼吁将真菌纳入鱼类肠道微生物组的概念模型，从丰度导向转向以生态过滤、功能特化和功能冗余为核心的框架。

papers.title: Discovery of Post‐Translationally Modified Epitopes in Autoimmunity: Someone Has to Fish so Everyone Can Eat
papers.authors: Arshad, Sanya; Cameron, Benjamin M.; Joglekar, Alok V.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Post‐translational modifications (PTMs) chemically diversify the ~20,000 genomically encoded proteins into millions of functional variants, and this diversity has profound consequences for T cell‐mediated immune responses. PTM‐reactive T cells have been identified across numerous autoimmune diseases and, in several cases, implicated directly as pathogenic drivers. Mechanistically, PTMs promote autoimmunity through two intertwined routes: by altering peptide–MHC and TCR binding to favor recognition of self‐epitopes, and by generating neoepitopes in peripheral and/or inflamed tissues that are absent from the thymus, allowing PTM‐reactive T cells to escape central tolerance. This cascade is amplified by inflammatory cytokines, upregulated antigen‐processing machinery, disease‐associated HLA alleles, and, in some cases, exogenous triggers such as diet. We use three well‐characterized examples—citrullination in multiple autoimmune disorders, hybrid insulin peptide (HIP) formation in type 1 diabetes, and gluten deamidation in celiac disease—to illustrate how distinct PTM biology, tissue specificity, and genetic encodability shape the antigenic landscape and dictate feasible discovery strategies. We then review four complementary approaches for identifying PTM‐specific T cell responses: mass spectrometry‐based proteomics and immunopeptidomics, computational MHC‐binding prediction, antigen‐directed methods, and high‐throughput T cell receptor (TCR)‐directed library screening methods. For each, we discuss underlying principles, strengths, and limitations, with particular attention to the challenge posed by non‐canonical, PTM‐bearing residues. By comparing citrullination, HIPs, and gluten deamidation across these methodologies, we highlight how biochemical alterations, tissue accessibility, and mouse‐to‐human conservation determine which discovery approach is most tractable. We conclude that while synthetic peptide‐based methods remain the standard for validating known epitopes, emerging high‐throughput, cell‐based platforms are rapidly expanding the accessibility of the PTM antigenic landscape for both known and undiscovered autoimmune epitopes.
papers.summary_cn: 非渔业相关

papers.title: Dactylostomum brayi n. sp. (Trematoda: Opecoelidae) from the Fish Hemibagrus nemurus (Bagridae) in Khun Thale Swamp, Thailand
papers.authors: Kamchoo, Kanda; Ribas, Alexis; Gilardoni, Carmen; Poonlaphdecha, Srisupaph
papers.abstract: During a parasitological survey of freshwater fishes from Khun Thale Swamp, Surat Thani Province, Thailand, a new species of opecoelid trematode, Dactylostomum brayi n. sp., was recovered from the intestine of the Asian redtail catfish Hemibagrus nemurus (Bagridae). Of the 1065 fishes examined, representing 33 species, 27 genera, and 16 families, the parasite was found exclusively in H. nemurus, with a prevalence of 27.27% and a mean intensity of 2.33 worms per infected host, suggesting a high degree of host specificity. The new species differs from all recognised freshwater congeners in the number of ventral sucker papillae, body proportions relative to the oral sucker, and the morphology of the reproductive organs. This represents the second record of Dactylostomum from Thailand, following specimens identified as Dactylostomum sp. by R. A. Bray from the same host and deposited in the Natural History Museum, London, in 1983. The present study also provides the first molecular characterisation (18S, ITS2, and 28S rRNA) for the genus Dactylostomum and reveals a close phylogenetic relationship with Dimerosaccus. These findings contribute to the taxonomy and distribution of Dactylostomum and provide a basis for future systematic and phylogenetic studies of this poorly known genus.
papers.summary_cn: 在泰国Khun Thale沼泽对1065尾淡水鱼（33种、16科）进行寄生虫调查时，从Hemibagrus nemurus肠道中检获并描述了一新种复殖吸虫Dactylostomum brayi n. sp.，其感染率为27.27%、平均感染强度2.33，表现出高度宿主特异性。该新种在腹吸盘乳突数目、体长与口吸盘比例及生殖器官形态上区别于所有已知淡水同属种，为泰国Dactylostomum属的第二次记录。研究首次提供了该属的分子特征（18S、ITS2、28S rRNA），显示其与Dimerosaccus亲缘关系较近。

papers.title: Effects of Replacing Fish Meal and Part of Soybean Meal with Enzymatically Hydrolyzed Soybean Meal on Growth Performance, Diarrhea Incidence, and Intestinal Health in Weaned Piglets
papers.authors: Wang, Nan; Tang, Fu; Nie, Yuyilin; Zhang, Shanyuan; Li, Yuekai; Li, Yong; Li, Xiaolong; Pi, Yu; Li, Xilong; Guo, Jie
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effects of substituting fish meal and part of soybean meal with enzymatically hydrolyzed soybean meal (EHSM) on growth performance, diarrhea incidence, antioxidant and immune status, and intestinal health in weaned piglets. Eighty 25-day-old piglets were distributed into two treatments with 8 replicate pens of 5 piglets each and fed a control diet or an EHSM diet for 42 days, with EHSM completely replacing fish meal and partially replacing soybean meal at inclusion levels of 9% and 4% during the pre-starter and starter phases, respectively. Compared with controls, EHSM increased day-42 body weight, average daily gain during days 28–42 and overall, and decreased feed conversion ratio during days 0–14 (p < 0.05). EHSM also reduced diarrhea incidence during days 0–14 (p = 0.050), decreased jejunal crypt depth, elevated jejunal villus height-to-crypt depth ratio, and increased NQO1 mRNA expression (p < 0.05). Plasma antioxidant and immunoglobulin indices were unaffected. Overall, EHSM improved growth and intestinal health, supporting its use as an alternative protein ingredient in weaned piglet diets. Additional research is warranted to clarify how EHSM influences intestinal function in weaned piglets.
papers.summary_cn: 非渔业相关

papers.title: Identification of Microalgae, Evaluation of Water Purification Efficiency, and Optimization of Large-Scale Production Conditions Based on Recirculating Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Ou, Zekui; Yang, Gan; Luo, Jiancha; Huang, Dan; Gan, Quan; Chen, Shiyu; Lin, Siyi
papers.abstract: Water purification is the most crucial process for recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs), while microalgae exhibit significant potential for nutrient removal from aquaculture wastewater. Four microalgal species with removal capacities for ammonia nitrogen (NH4+-N), nitrite nitrogen (NO2-N) and total phosphorus (TP) were isolated and identified from the land-based RASs, namely, Kirchneriella cornuta HY-1, Desmodesmus abundans HY-1, Coccomyxa sp. HY-1 and Oocystis sp. HY-1. The growth kinetics were characterized through measurements of cell density, chlorophyll content, and dry biomass in the in situ wastewater. Based on zeta potential, the flocculation efficiencies of seven agents were evaluated. Preservation parameters were optimized under nutrient-supplemented conditions with protective agents. Under large-scale culture conditions, over a 7-day period, the highest NH4+-N removal efficiency of 87.20 ± 0.56% was achieved by C. sp. HY-1, the highest NO2-N removal efficiency (85.63 ± 2.56%) was obtained by O. sp. HY-1, and the maximum TP removal efficiency (71.19 ± 3.35%) was exhibited by K. cornuta HY-1. Moreover, the harvest period could be reached after about 14 days of cultivation. FeCl3 was identified as the optimal harvesting flocculant for all four species. Optimal preservation conditions were determined as 25 °C and 31.25 μmol·m−2·s−1 for D. abundans HY-1, C. sp. HY-1, and O. sp. HY-1, and 25 °C and 18.75 μmol·m−2·s−1 for K. cornuta HY-1. This work provides theoretical guidance for large-scale microalgal production and confirms the technical feasibility of microalgae-driven in situ wastewater remediation.
papers.summary_cn: 从陆基RAS中分离鉴定出4株微藻（Kirchneriella cornuta HY-1、Desmodesmus abundans HY-1、Coccomyxa sp. HY-1和Oocystis sp. HY-1），并对其生长动力学、絮凝收获及保存条件进行了评价与优化。大规模培养7天后，C. sp. HY-1对NH4+-N去除率最高（87.20%），O. sp. HY-1对NO2-N去除率最高（85.63%），K. cornuta HY-1对TP去除率最高（71.19%）；FeCl3为4株藻的最优收获絮凝剂。研究证实了微藻驱动RAS养殖废水原位修复的技术可行性，并为规模化微藻生产提供了理论指导。

papers.title: β‐myrcene: A nature‐identical compound for sustainable aquaculture
papers.authors: Hoseini, Seyyed Morteza; Yousefi, Morteza; Abdollahpour, Hamed; Minaz, Mert
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Sustainability is essential for the continued development of aquaculture. A key aspect of sustainable aquaculture involves using natural and organic compounds as alternatives to chemical counterparts. Herbal‐derived compounds have gained significant attention because of their eco‐friendly properties and health benefits. Additionally, nature‐identical compounds have emerged as viable alternatives to natural herbal products because of their stable composition, purity, affordability, and availability. Terpenes, a class of nature‐identical compounds, have been extensively studied in aquaculture research for their antioxidant, immunostimulant, anti‐stress, and antimicrobial properties. While certain terpenes, such as thymol, carvacrol, and menthol, have been the focus of considerable investigation and comprehensive reviews, other terpenes remain underexplored despite their potential benefits. Among them, β‐myrcene is notable for its dual potential as both a feed additive and an anesthetic/sedative, yet no dedicated review has systematically examined the evidence for its use in aquaculture. This review focuses on β‐myrcene and evaluates the current evidence for its potential use in aquaculture, both as a feed additive and as an anesthetic/sedative agent. Moreover, its bioactivity in non‐aquatic organisms, including in vitro assays, is evaluated to propose further potential in aquaculture, following reliable validations. Available studies suggest that β‐myrcene has shown preliminary growth‐promoting, antioxidant, and immunostimulant effects in a limited number of aquaculture studies. However, mechanistic evidence derived from mammalian and in vitro models suggests that β‐myrcene should be evaluated for its antimicrobial activity against fish and shellfish pathogens, as well as its capacity to augment disease resistance and exert anti‐inflammatory effects. This review critically evaluates the knowledge gaps that must be addressed before practical application can be considered.
papers.summary_cn: β-月桂烯（β-myrcene）作为一种天然等同化合物，兼具饲料添加剂和麻醉/镇静剂的潜在双重用途，但其在水产养殖中的应用尚未被系统综述。本文评估了β-月桂烯在水产养殖中作为饲料添加剂和麻醉/镇静剂的现有证据，并参考其在非水生生物中的生物活性以推测进一步应用潜力。现有研究表明β-月桂烯在有限的水产研究中表现出促生长、抗氧化和免疫刺激效果，而哺乳动物及体外模型提示其还应被评估抗鱼类和贝类病原菌活性、增强抗病力及抗炎作用。综述同时指出了实际应用前需填补的知识空白。

papers.authors: Devillebichot, Maëlle; Williamson, Jane E.; Pepperell, Julian G.; Guillemin, Tristan A.
papers.abstract: Abstract The shortfin mako ( Isurus oxyrinchus ) is a fast‐swimming pelagic shark of global ecological and socioeconomic importance, yet it is relatively understudied in temperate eastern Australian waters. This study investigated the trophic ecology of mako sharks using stable isotope analysis (SIA) of nitrogen (δ 15 N), carbon (δ 13 C) and sulphur (δ 34 S). White muscle tissue samples were obtained from captured during game fishing tournaments along the New South Wales coast between 2005 and 2025. Ontogenetic shifts in isotopic composition were observed across individuals. δ 15 N values decreased with increasing body size, while δ 13 C values increased with size, suggesting that larger sharks may feed more frequently on prey of lower trophic positions. In contrast, δ 34 S values indicated mainly pelagic foraging across all size classes. Isotopic niche models revealed partial niche overlaps between size groups, with convergence in larger individuals, indicating shared resource use at maturity. Seasonal effects were weak, potentially reflecting sampling bias and the slow isotopic turnover rate of shark muscle. At the population level, their ecological role appears as a generalist, although individual specialization may occur. These findings demonstrate that ontogenetic variation and spatially variable foraging behaviour should be considered in fisheries management. In particular, the apparent reliance of larger individuals on coastal prey suggests that they may be more vulnerable to recreational fisheries than previously assumed. This study provides the first sulphur‐inclusive stable isotope analysis of I. oxyrinchus and offers a species‐specific trophic perspective for temperate eastern Australia. It highlights the importance of integrating stable isotope data with tagging studies, prey sampling and stomach content analyses to better resolve trophic pathways. Such integrative approaches will support ecosystem‐based fisheries management, help reduce bycatch risks, and strengthen conservation strategies for this endangered species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用氮、碳、硫稳定同位素分析（SIA），探究了澳大利亚东部温带海域尖吻鲭鲨（Isurus oxyrinchus）摄食生态的个体发育与空间变异。结果显示，δ15N随体型增大而下降、δ13C随体型增大而上升，表明大型个体可能更多摄食较低营养级猎物；δ34S则显示各体型组均以远洋摄食为主。同位素生态位模型揭示体型组间存在部分重叠，大型个体生态位趋于收敛，种群层面表现为广食性但可能存在个体特化。研究提示，渔业管理应考虑个体发育变异与空间差异化的摄食行为，大型个体对近岸猎物的依赖可能使其更易受休闲渔业影响。

papers.title: Assessing the Sustainability Performance of Fishing Harbors Under Uncertainty: A Gaussian‐Neutrosophic Framework
papers.authors: As, Yakup; Kara, Karahan; Gül, Sait
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Fishing harbors are increasingly required to meet sustainability expectations associated with the environmental, social, and economic development goals. Accordingly, assessing their sustainability performance has become an important concern for both policymakers, harbor operating organizations, and harbor managers. This study develops a decision support system (DSS) within a neutrosophic environment to evaluate the sustainability performance of small‐scale fishing harbors. For this purpose, a novel SVN‐Gaussian‐Entropy‐MABAC hybrid method is developed. Expert contribution levels are determined using SVNSs, sustainability performance criteria are weighted through a neutrosophic entropy method, and sustainability performance rankings are obtained using a neutrosophic MABAC approach. In addition, two new aggregation operators, namely Single‐Valued Neutrosophic Gaussian Weighted Averaging (SVNGWA) and Single‐Valued Neutrosophic Gaussian Weighted Geometric (SVNGWG) operators, are introduced. The proposed framework is demonstrated through a real‐world case study conducted in Bursa Province, Türkiye. The results indicate that waste management and recycling capacity is the most important sustainability criterion, while Arnavutköy Fishing Harbor achieved the highest sustainability performance score. Comparative robustness analyses using conventional aggregation operators and alternative neutrosophic ranking methods supported the stability of the proposed framework. Finally, the study provides methodological, theoretical, and practical implications for sustainability assessment, neutrosophic decision‐making, and fisheries infrastructure management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对小型渔港可持续性评估中的不确定性问题，构建了基于单值中智（neutrosophic）环境的决策支持系统，提出SVN-Gaussian-Entropy-MABAC混合方法及两种新的聚合算子（SVNGWA、SVNGWG），用于确定专家贡献度、加权可持续性准则并排序渔港表现。以土耳其布尔萨省为案例的实证结果表明，废物管理与回收能力是最重要的可持续性准则，Arnavutköy渔港获得最高可持续性评分，且与传统聚合算子及替代中智排序方法的对比分析验证了该框架的稳健性。

papers.title: Reproductive traits, sex‐specific reproductive investment and gonadal dynamics in a spawning surgeonfish
papers.authors: Aguilar‐Santana, Fernando A.; Schmitter‐Soto, Juan J.; Arellano‐Martinez, Marcial; Avila‐Poveda, Omar Hernando
papers.abstract: Abstract The razor surgeonfish Prionurus laticlavius is a key herbivore in Eastern Pacific reef communities. This study provides a sex‐specific assessment of its reproductive traits, size at maturity and energetic dynamics in the Gulf of California by integrating biometric indicators (adult sex ratio, TL 50 ), somatic indices (hepatosomatic index, HSI; visceral fat index, VFI; gonadosomatic index, GSI) and histological analyses of gonadal development stages (GDS). Monthly sampling over one year revealed a female‐biased adult sex ratio and a larger size at maturity (TL 50 = 35.1 cm) than males (TL 50 = 33.3 cm). Reproductive investment, as measured by GSI, showed a relay‐like asynchronous alternation between sexes. Histologically mature males exhibited the highest GSI values (around 3.4%) from August to October, exceeding those of females. Conversely, from November through July, both sexes remained histologically mature at GSI values below 1%, with females dominating during this period. The relative gonadal expenditure between sexes (RGES: logarithm of the ratio males‐to‐females GSIs) confirmed that each sex contributed differentially to reproduction across the annual cycle, complemented by energetic strategies where females showed higher HSI and VFI than males. Sex‐specific correlations between somatic indices and GSI suggested divergent physiological pathways between sexes. Histological GDS analyses revealed in males two to four stages per month, whereas females exhibited between one to three stages. Melanomacrophages increased during regressing and regenerating stages, with sex‐specific peaks associated with tissue turnover and post‐spawning recovery. Together, these sex‐specific strategies indicated that reproductive investment in P. laticlavius is driven by differences in physiological demands and timing, shaping the annual reproductive dynamics.
papers.summary_cn: 研究整合生物计量指标、体指数（HSI、VFI、GSI）与性腺组织学，评估了东太平洋礁区关键植食性鱼类 Prionurus laticlavius 在加利福尼亚湾的性别特异性繁殖特征、性成熟体长及能量动态。结果显示雌性成体比例偏高且性成熟体长（TL₅₀ = 35.1 cm）大于雄性（33.3 cm），GSI 呈雌雄异步交替的接力式繁殖投入模式。组织学成熟雄性在8–10月 GSI 最高（约3.4%）并超过雌性，而11月至次年7月两性 GSI 均低于1%且以雌性为主；雌性 HSI 与 VFI 高于雄性，性腺发育阶段及黑色素巨噬细胞变化亦呈性别差异，表明其年度繁殖动态由两性生理需求与时序差异共同驱动。

papers.title: A new cryptic species of Rhinogobius (Gobiiformes: Oxudercidae) from northern Taiwan, with remarks on the cryptic diversity within the Rhinogobius similis species complex
papers.authors: Lin, Yen‐Ting; Lin, Yu‐Hsiang; Dai, Yi‐Feng; Wakiya, Ryoshiro; Hsu, Yen‐Ting; Hsu, Hsiang‐Yi; Itakura, Hikaru; Lin, Yu‐I; Han, Yu‐San
papers.abstract: Abstract A new cryptic species of Rhinogobius within the R. similis species complex, Rhinogobius feitsuiensis sp. nov., is described based on 12 specimens collected from the Feitsui Reservoir, northern Taiwan. Although R. feitsuiensis shares the unique transverse cheek papillae pattern typical of the R. similis complex, it differs from the three other species in this complex by having three longitudinal rows of papillae, with three to four transverse rows between the eye and the upper longitudinal row and none between the upper and lower longitudinal rows. Rhinogobius feitsuiensis differs from R. similis by having a shorter second dorsal‐fin base (11.9–14.1% SL vs. 17.4–20.6% SL in topotypic R. similis ) and body depth at pelvic‐fin origin (12.1–14.7% SL vs. 18.3–19.3% SL in topotypic R. similis ). Further, R. feitsuiensis also has more pre‐dorsal ctenoid scales (12–13 vs. 8–12 in topotypic R. similis ). Phylogenetic analysis based on mitochondrial COI gene sequences supports R. feitsuiensis as a well‐defined monophyletic lineage. The recognition of R. feitsuiensis increases the number of nominal species within the R. similis complex to four and unravels the cryptic diversity among the Rhinogobius similis complex in East Asia.
papers.summary_cn: 基于台湾北部翡翠水库12尾标本描述了Rhinogobius similis种复合体内的隐存种Rhinogobius feitsuiensis sp. nov.。该新种具有该复合体特有的横向颊部乳突排列模式，但可通过3列纵向乳突、较短的第三背鳍基长和较浅的体高，以及较多的前背栉鳞数与同属其他种区分。线粒体COI基因系统发育分析支持其为独立的单系谱系，该发现将R. similis复合体的已知种数增至4种，揭示了东亚该复合体内存在的隐存多样性。

papers.title: Antiviral activity of chlorogenic acid against largemouth bass virus ( Micropterus salmoides ) in vitro and in vivo
papers.authors: Huo, Ruixian; Gong, Hannan; Yu, Renjie; Tang, Dekun; Bai, Xiaohui; Yang, Min; Qin, Qiwei; Chen, Yifang; Wei, Shina
papers.abstract: Abstract The largemouth bass ( Micropterus salmoides [Lacepède, 1802]) is a commercially important aquaculture species, but its production is severely threatened by largemouth bass virus (LMBV), necessitating the development of effective antiviral strategies. Chlorogenic acid (CGA), a natural polyphenol compound, exhibits broad biological activities, but its effect on LMBV infection remains unclear. This study evaluated the effects of CGA on LMBV infection using both in vitro and in vivo experiments. Using LMBV‐permissive fathead minnow (FHM) cells as an established in vitro infection model, we found that CGA reduced the transcription and protein expression of the LMBV major capsid protein (MCP). CGA treatment reduced the transcript levels of inflammation‐related genes IL‐1β, IL‐6, IL‐8 and TNF‐α, both pre and post viral infection. CGA increased the expression of antioxidant‐related genes such as Nrf2, SOD, CAT and GPx while decreasing Keap‐1 expression. Western blot analysis further confirmed that CGA suppressed the phosphorylation of JNK, ERK and p38. In vivo, largemouth bass were fed diets supplemented with 0 (NC), 200 (L200), 400 (L400) and 600 (L600) mg/kg CGA for 8 weeks. CGA treatment improved growth performance, decreased hepatic MDA levels and increased antioxidant enzyme activity, including CAT, SOD and GPx. The CGA‐supplemented groups exhibited lower transcript levels of pro‐inflammatory cytokines TNF‐α and IL‐1β, alongside elevated expression of anti‐inflammatory cytokines IL‐10 and TGF‐β, compared to the NC group. CGA supplementation notably elevated the mRNA expression levels of Nrf2, CAT, SOD and GPx while reducing the mRNA expression level of Keap‐1. Dietary CGA supplementation significantly improved survival rates in LMBV‐challenged largemouth bass and inhibited LMBV‐MCP transcription in the liver, spleen and head kidney. In summary, CGA demonstrates notable anti‐LMBV activity in both in vitro and in vivo settings. These effects were accompanied by changes in Mitogen‐Activated Protein Kinase (MAPK)‐associated proteins and inflammatory‐ and antioxidant‐related responses. Therefore, CGA represents a promising candidate for development as a dietary supplement to control LMBV infection.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估绿原酸（CGA）对大口黑鲈病毒（LMBV）感染的抗病毒效果，采用FHM细胞体外模型及饲料添加CGA（0、200、400、600 mg/kg，8周）的体内实验。结果表明，CGA可抑制LMBV主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）的转录与表达，降低炎症因子（IL-1β、IL-6、IL-8、TNF-α）水平，增强抗氧化基因（Nrf2、SOD、CAT、GPx）表达并抑制Keap-1及MAPK通路（JNK、ERK、p38）磷酸化。体内实验显示CGA改善生长性能、增强抗氧化能力、调节炎症反应，并显著提高LMBV攻毒后的存活率，抑制肝、脾、头肾中LMBV-MCP转录。CGA具有开发为抗LMBV饲料添加剂的潜力。

papers.title: The Impact of Fisheries and Aquaculture Production on Carbon Emissions: The Role of Natural Resource Rents
papers.authors: Atılgan, Dilek
papers.abstract: This study investigates the long-run relationships between aquaculture production (AP), fisheries production (FP), natural resource rents (NRR), economic growth, and CO₂ emissions in China, India, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Malaysia over the period 1990–2021. Long-run relationships are examined using the LM bootstrap co-integration test, while the Common Correlated Effects Mean Group (CCEMG) estimator is employed for long-run coefficient estimation. The Augmented Mean Group (AMG) estimator and additional sensitivity analyses are also used to assess the robustness of the findings. The baseline CCEMG results do not reveal statistically significant panel-level effects of AP, FP, NRR, or GDP. However, the Augmented Mean Group (AMG) results indicate that AP is negatively associated with CO₂ emissions, whereas FP and GDP have positive effects, while NRR remains statistically insignificant. Country-specific estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity, with AP reducing CO₂ emissions in China, India, and Malaysia, while GDP increases emissions in India, Thailand, and Malaysia. NRR also exhibits heterogeneous effects, increasing emissions in India while reducing them in Vietnam. Sensitivity analyses further indicate that the estimated effect of FP varies across model specifications, while the main findings are not solely driven by China. Overall, the results highlight the importance of country-specific production structures, resource management practices, and economic conditions in shaping the environmental effects of aquatic food production. The findings support country-specific policies promoting energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable aquatic food systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于1990—2021年中国、印度、印度尼西亚、越南、泰国和马来西亚的面板数据，采用LM bootstrap co-integration检验及CCEMG、AMG估计方法，考察水产养殖产量（AP）、渔业产量（FP）、自然资源租金（NRR）、经济增长与CO₂排放之间的长期关系。基准CCEMG结果未发现AP、FP、NRR或GDP具有显著的组群层面效应，但AMG结果显示AP与CO₂排放负相关，FP和GDP则呈正相关，NRR不显著。国别估计揭示显著异质性：AP在中国、印度和马来西亚降低排放，GDP在印度、泰国和马来西亚增加排放，NRR在印度增加排放但在越南降低排放。研究强调各国生产结构、资源管理实践和经济条件对水生食品生产环境效应的决定性作用，支持制定国别化的能效与环境可持续水产食品体系政策。

papers.title: The Role of Special Fish Habitats in Biodiversity Conservation and Sustainable Fisheries
papers.authors: Cvetković, Aleksa; Veličković, Tijana; Stanković, David; Nikolić, Marijana; Simić, Vladica
papers.abstract: Occupying a mere fraction of the Earth’s land surface, freshwater ecosystems are disproportionately rich in biodiversity and indispensable for human well-being and sustainable development. Nevertheless, these systems are undergoing accelerated biodiversity loss, driven by intensifying anthropogenic pressures that often surpass the impacts observed in terrestrial and marine environments. Protected areas are central to biodiversity conservation, but their effectiveness in freshwater systems is limited by hydrological connectivity and the mismatch between fixed boundaries and dynamic ecological processes. In this study, we assessed the ecological and fisheries performance of Special Fish Habitats (SFHs) in Serbia by comparing 25 SFH and 19 non-SFH localities across the Ibar and Nišava River basins, using field surveys conducted through standardized electrofishing from 2022 to 2025 and fish stock monitoring records covering 2016–2021. Fish production, biodiversity, ecological status, and population sustainability were evaluated through the ES-HIPPOfishing model, complemented by multivariate statistical and machine learning analyses. SFHs showed generally higher productivity and better water quality, but none of the direct comparisons were statistically significant. To our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically evaluate SFHs in Serbia, providing a robust scientific basis for refining freshwater protected area networks and offering actionable insights for biodiversity conservation in pressured river systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以塞尔维亚Ibar与Nišava河流域为对象，通过2022—2025年标准化电捕调查及2016—2021年鱼类种群监测数据，比较25个Special Fish Habitats（SFHs）与19个非SFH样点的鱼类生产力、生物多样性、生态状况及种群可持续性，并采用ES-HIPPOfishing模型结合多元统计与机器学习方法进行评估。结果显示SFHs总体具有较高生产力和较优水质，但直接比较均未达统计显著水平。这是首个系统评估塞尔维亚SFHs的研究，为淡水保护地网络优化及受胁迫河流系统的生物多样性保护提供了科学依据。

papers.title:
Integrating Environmental
                    <scp>DNA</scp>
                    (
                    <scp>eDNA</scp>
                    ) Approaches to Enhance Fisheries Advisories Through Marine Food Web Reconstruction: Opportunities and Challenges
papers.authors: Vrinda, Punmoth Kalyadan; Lal, Dhanya M.; Jha, Sneha; Dash, Bhagyashree; Joseph, Sudheer; Nair, T. M. Balakrishnan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Environmental DNA (eDNA) transforms marine ecological research through non‐invasive assessment of ecosystem structure with higher taxonomic resolution. This study explores the potential of eDNA metabarcoding to enhance fisheries advisories through food web reconstruction, bridging ecological insights with ecosystem‐based fisheries management. This review elucidates the concepts of eDNA and explores its applications in food web studies and Potential Fishing Zone (PFZ) dynamics. Additionally, the review presents a bibliometric analysis of global publications related to eDNA, food web, and marine fishes, scrutinizing the co‐occurrence of these keywords in publications, highlighting the need to integrate eDNA studies to accurately derive insights into trophic structure and fisheries potential. The review identifies key gaps, challenges, and future opportunities of this technology toward the blue economy. Despite the considerable potential identified, key limitations include DNA degradation and dilution in the marine environment, along with uncertainties in long‐term predictions, posing challenges to its application in fisheries advisories. However, continued advances in sampling techniques and high‐frequency, spatiotemporally resolved observations are expected to help overcome these limitations and facilitate the effective integration of eDNA into fisheries advisory research.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨利用 eDNA metabarcoding 通过海洋食物网重建提升渔业预报的潜力，旨在将生态学洞察与基于生态系统的渔业管理相衔接。综述结合文献计量分析，梳理了 eDNA 在食物网研究和 Potential Fishing Zone（PFZ）动态中的应用及全球研究热点。尽管 eDNA 在 trophic structure 和渔业潜力评估中前景可观，但 DNA 降解稀释及长期预测不确定性仍制约其应用，未来需依赖采样技术进步和高频时空观测加以克服。

papers.title: One Health and Antimicrobial Resistance in Aquaculture: Implications for Interdisciplinary Public Health Education
papers.authors: Hidayatullah, M.Syarif; Muthia Cenderadewi
papers.journal: International Journal of Post Axial: Futuristic Teaching and Learning
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in aquaculture creates public health risks through foodborne exposure, occupational contact, and environmental contamination. This literature review examined peer-reviewed evidence on the implications of aquaculture-related AMR for human and community health and evaluated the application of a One Health approach, while considering how the synthesis may inform interdisciplinary public health education. A systematic search was conducted using PubMed, ScienceDirect, and BMC Public Health for full-text articles published between 2010 and 2025 that linked One Health, AMR, and aquaculture or coastal communities. Five studies met the inclusion criteria and were synthesized thematically, supported by contextual literature. Four interrelated themes emerged: seafood-borne transmission of resistant bacteria; occupational exposure among aquaculture workers; environmental dissemination through aquatic systems and sediments; and gaps in cross-sector governance and surveillance. The findings indicate that aquaculture-related AMR extends beyond animal health and requires coordinated attention to food safety, worker protection, environmental health, antimicrobial stewardship, and integrated surveillance. These interconnected pathways also provide a relevant basis for interdisciplinary public health education, particularly for developing systems thinking and cross-sector collaboration. Integrated One Health responses are needed to reduce risks to coastal communities and public health
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统检索2010—2025年文献，评估水产养殖中antimicrobial resistance (AMR)通过食源性暴露、职业接触和环境传播对公众健康的影响，并探讨One Health框架的应用。纳入的5项研究归纳出四个主题：耐药菌的海产品传播、养殖从业者职业暴露、水生系统与沉积物的环境扩散，以及跨部门治理与监测缺口。作者指出，水产养殖AMR风险已超越动物健康范畴，需在食品安全、职业防护、环境健康、antimicrobial stewardship和integrated surveillance等方面协同应对，并为跨学科公共卫生教育提供系统思维与跨部门协作的教学基础。

papers.title: AI-Enabled Climate–Water Governance Linking Aquaculture and Irrigation in The Mekong Delta, Vietnam
papers.authors: Nguyen, Tuan Anh; Bach, Tan Sinh; Mai, Trong Nhuan
papers.journal: International Journal of Sustainability and Risk Control
papers.abstract: The paper investigates how artificial intelligence (AI) can enhance integrated water governance and climate resilience in water-dependent production systems, specifically focusing on aquaculture and irrigation in the Mekong Delta, Vietnam. It addresses a gap in existing literature by integrating technical applications of AI with institutional analyses of water management and climate adaptation. The study employs an interdisciplinary framework, drawing on Integrated Water Resources Management (IWRM), adaptive governance, and digital development theories, to analyze AI as a governance-enabling technology that facilitates coordination, learning, and decision-making under climate uncertainty. The paper makes three key contributions: it advances IWRM scholarship by demonstrating AI's capacity to operationalize integration amidst climatic uncertainty; it contributes to the digital development discourse by showing that AI's developmental impacts are contingent on institutional embedding and governance capacity; and it provides policy-relevant insights for climateresilient water governance in the Mekong Delta and other similar delta regions. The findings suggest that AI's contribution to development outcomes is primarily through its interactions with governance institutions rather than solely through technical performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以越南湄公河三角洲水产养殖与灌溉为对象，探讨人工智能（AI）如何提升综合水资源治理与气候韧性。作者采用整合水资源管理（IWRM）、适应性治理与数字发展理论构建跨学科框架，将AI视为赋能治理的技术，分析其在气候不确定性下促进协调、学习与决策的作用。研究指出，AI对发展成效的贡献主要取决于其与治理制度的互动及制度嵌入能力，而非单纯的技术性能，并为湄公河三角洲及其他类似三角洲地区的韧性水治理提供政策启示。

papers.title: Climate warming and aquaculture reclamation activate positive feedback mechanisms for greenhouse gases in a temperate mudflat
papers.authors: Wang, Zihao; Cui, Qian; Guo, Peng; Wang, Can; Zhou, Heting; Li, Min; Shen, Qiuyu; Zhang, Zongxiao; Lin, Xianbiao
papers.abstract: Abstract Conversion of natural bare mudflats to aquaculture ponds is a prevalent practice that fundamentally alters sediment biogeochemistry and microbial processes. However, its impact on greenhouse gas (GHG) production dynamics and their temperature sensitivity remains inadequately quantified. This study combined laboratory incubation with metagenomic sequencing to investigate the effects of converting bare mudflats to moderate‐ and high‐intensity aquaculture ponds on sediment GHG production potential and thermal response patterns. Aquaculture reclamation suppressed methane production potential by 89.89% but enhanced nitrous oxide and carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) by 78.08% and 10.40%, respectively, while simultaneously altering their temperature sensitivity. Mechanistically, these shifts were driven by modified redox conditions, carbon/nitrogen substrate availability, and restructuring of microbial metabolic networks, including functional gene abundance and community composition. Counterintuitively, moderate, rather than heavy, aquaculture reclamation provides the strongest stimulus to GHG production potential, a pattern that can be summarized as a transition from the activation of biogeochemical processes at moderate disturbance to the suppression of system functioning at high intensities of stress, in which toxic byproducts of excessive organic loading inhibit the microbial metabolism they are supposed to promote. Model projections under 2°C and 4°C warming scenarios indicated that aquaculture reclamation may elevate sediment CO 2 ‐equivalent production potential by 32.59–67.45% through stimulated heterotrophic respiration, establishing a positive climate feedback loop, which we conceptualize as an “aquaculture reclamation‐induced GHG amplification” mechanism. This study establishes a mechanistic framework for linking reclamation‐climate interactions with microbial carbon/nitrogen cycling, providing insights for predicting and mitigating GHG production from bare mudflats in warming ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 研究通过室内培养与宏基因组测序，探究了将天然光滩改造为中、高强度养殖塘对沉积物温室气体（GHG）产生潜力及其温度敏感性的影响。结果显示，养殖围垦使甲烷产生潜力下降89.89%，但氧化亚氮和CO₂分别增加78.08%和10.40%，且中度围垦的刺激效应强于重度围垦。在2°C和4°C增温情景下，养殖围垦可通过增强异养呼吸使沉积物CO₂当量产生潜力提高32.59–67.45%，形成“养殖围垦诱导的GHG放大”正反馈机制。

papers.title: Validation of an HPLC-FLD method for the determination of aflatoxins (B1, B2, G1, G2) in cereals, coffee and dried seafood and its application to the survey of Aflatoxin contamination in selected foods in Hanoi
papers.authors: Vu Thi Kim, Oanh
papers.journal: Heavy metals and arsenic concentrations in water, agricultural soil, and rice in Ngan Son district, Bac Kan province, Vietnam
papers.abstract: This study aimed to establish the analytical parameters and validate a high-performance liquid chromatography with fluorescence detection (HPLC-FLD) method for the determination of aflatoxins (AFB1, AFB2, AFG1, and AFG2) in food samples. The validated method used to assess aflatoxin contamination in cereals, coffee products, and dried seafood collected in Hanoi. Positive samples were further confirmed by liquid chromatography&ndash;tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), and the quantitative results obtained by the two methods were compared. The validated method demonstrated good specificity, with limits of detection (LOD) and quantification (LOQ) of 0.5 and 1.0 &mu;g/kg, respectively, for each aflatoxin. The intermediate precision (RSD) ranged from 2.55 to 18.4%, while recoveries ranged from 70.1% to 119%. The evaluation results demonstrated that the method was reliable for the determination of aflatoxins at low concentrations in compliance with the requirements of QCVN 8-1:2011/BYT and showed good agreement with LC-MS/MS for quantitative analysis. The validated method was applied to the analysis of 100 food samples, including cereals, coffee, and dried seafood. Five samples (5.0%) were found to be contaminated with total aflatoxins at concentrations ranging from 9.04 to 726 &micro;g/kg. These findings highlight the need to maintain and strengthen routine food safety monitoring programs for the effective control of aflatoxin contamination and the protection of public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究建立并验证了HPLC-FLD法测定谷物、咖啡及干制水产品中黄曲霉毒素（AFB1、AFB2、AFG1、AFG2）的分析方法，LOD和LOQ分别为0.5和1.0 μg/kg，回收率70.1%–119%，与LC-MS/MS定量结果一致。将该方法应用于河内采集的100份食品样品检测，5份（5.0%）总黄曲霉毒素超标，浓度范围为9.04–726 μg/kg。结果表明该方法可靠，并提示需加强干制水产品等食品中黄曲霉毒素的常规安全监测。

papers.title: Onboard respirometry in a marine recreational fishery reveals predictors of post-capture recovery in adult coho salmon
papers.authors: Van Wert, Jacey; Hendriks, Brian J; Johnston, Stephen; Zinn, Kaitlyn R; Johnston, Quin V; Weber, Lance A; Patterson, David A; Hinch, Scott G; Eliason, Erika J.
papers.abstract: Annually, billions of fish are captured and released under the assumption that they will recover and survive, which may not occur. Fishing-induced stressors require subsequent recovery, characterized by increased energy expenditure, greater vulnerability to predation and disease, and lost opportunities for critical activities such as feeding and migration. This study examined the physiological responses of adult coho salmon (Oncorhynchus kisutch) to interactions with fishing gear in coastal British Columbia, Canada. Collaborating with recreational fishers, we used novel onboard respirometers to measure metabolic recovery for 1 h, alongside blood sampling to assess physiological status. We examined how angling-induced injuries (scale loss, line wrap, fin and eye damage) and intrinsic and extrinsic factors (fork length, sex, preexisting wounds, temperature, capture duration) affect post-capture recovery. Fish with greater scale loss or line wrap incurred higher recovery costs and more acidic blood, respectively, while smaller fish and longer fight duration demonstrated greater acidosis and lactate accumulation. Comparisons with lab-based chase protocols on the same individuals revealed that standard lab methods underestimated aerobic capacity and short-term recovery, underscoring the value of the novel methodology for fisheries management and conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过新型船载呼吸仪结合血液采样，评估了加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省沿海休闲渔业中成年银鲑（coho salmon）捕获后1小时内的代谢恢复过程，并分析了钓具致伤（鳞片脱落、线缠绕、鳍和眼损伤）及内在与外在因素对恢复的影响。结果显示，鳞片脱落越多恢复代价越高，线缠绕导致血液更偏酸性，体型较小和搏斗时间较长的个体酸中毒和乳酸积累更严重。与实验室追逐方案的对比表明，传统实验室方法低估了有氧能力和短期恢复水平，凸显了船载呼吸测量法在渔业管理与保护中的应用价值。

papers.title: Sixty years of homogenization of fish assemblages in the Yellow River basin: a legacy of non-native introductions rather than native extirpations
papers.authors: Zheng, Peng; Wang, Jun; Quirino, Bárbara Angélio; Quan, Quan; Zhou, Weidong; Zhang, Fei; Jiang, Xiaoming; Li, Jiake
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 基于标题，该研究分析了黄河流域鱼类群落六十年间的同质化过程，旨在区分非本地物种引入与本地物种灭绝对群落同质化的相对贡献。结果表明，非本地鱼类引入而非本地物种消失是驱动该流域鱼类群落同质化的主要因素。

papers.title: Reduction in IgE reactivity of fish parvalbumin through heat denaturation
papers.authors: Kobayashi, Yukihiro; Kubota, Hiroyuki; Ishikawa, Kenta; Kawashima, Risa; Hamada-Sato, Naoko
papers.abstract: Abstract Parvalbumin is a prominent fish allergen with notable heat stability in structural and allergenic properties. However, high temperatures reduce immunoglobulin E (IgE) reactivity, likely due to the destruction of IgE-binding epitopes via heat-induced protein denaturation. This study investigated how heat treatment affects parvalbumin denaturation and IgE reactivity. IgE reactivity of patient sera was examined using Pacific chub mackerel extracts and purified parvalbumin by western blotting and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Parvalbumin IgE reactivity remained largely unchanged after 10 min at 100 °C, but declined significantly after 60 min. At 120 °C, IgE reactivity decreased rapidly. Denaturation of purified parvalbumin was assessed using phenylalanine-derived intrinsic fluorescence, hydrophobic region exposure with 1-anilinonaphthalene−8-sulfonic acid, and calcium-binding ability using Quin 2. The purified parvalbumin showed partial denaturation at 100 °C and complete denaturation at 120 °C. Western blotting of extracts from 20 fish species using a conformation-sensitive anti-parvalbumin antibody revealed slight reactivity after 60 min at 100 °C but complete loss after 60 min at 120 °C. ELISA showed slight IgE reactivity in many species after 60 min at 100 °C; however, all reactivities disappeared after 60 min at 120 °C. Parvalbumin from diverse fish species shows marked thermal stability, but heating at 120 °C induces denaturation and abolishes detectable IgE reactivity under the conditions tested.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨热处理对鱼类主要过敏原 parvalbumin 变性与 IgE 反应性的影响。采用 ELISA 和 western blotting 检测患者血清 IgE 反应性，并结合内源荧光、疏水区域暴露及钙结合能力评估蛋白变性程度。结果显示 parvalbumin 在 100 °C 下具有显著热稳定性，但 120 °C 加热可致其完全变性并消除可检测的 IgE 反应性，且该规律在 20 种鱼类中一致。

papers.title: Lernaea cyprinacea, a Parasite Widespread Aquaculture Globally: Host-Parasite Interactions, Infestation Patterns, Physiological and Histopathological Alterations, and Control Treatments
papers.authors: Tavares-Dias, Marcos
papers.abstract: Lernaea cyprinacea is the parasitic crustacean causative of lernaeosis in freshwater fish, a disease widespread globally. Management of these infestations is of utmost importance to prevent disease outbreaks and avoid financial losses for aquaculture. Severe infestations may result in disease outbreaks and massive mortality of fish.This study aimed to report and discuss the host-parasites interactions and infestation patterns by L. cyprinacea affecting global fish aquaculture, its physiological and histopathological effects on fish, and the control treatment methods to avoid lernaeosis. While this parasite primarily affects the gills and skin near the fins of fish, it spreads rapidly and easily into body, causing hemorrhages and scale shedding in host fish, leading to loss of marketability, decreased immunity, and increased susceptibility to infectious diseases. Lernaeosis in fry, fingerlings, market-sized fish, and broodstock worldwide, caused by several factors, indicating that it poses a grave threat to fish aquaculture. This parasitosis can disrupt physiological and biochemical processes in host fish, especially in cases of massive infestation, and can also cause severe tissue damage at the parasite’s attachment site, which were discussed. Organophosphate, organochlorine, and pyrethroid products are usually recommended to control and treat L. cyprinacea infestations. Finally, lernaeosis continues to pose a significant challenge to global aquaculture, leading to economic losses by negatively impacting fish production and productivity, and by causing severe mortalities.
papers.summary_cn: 鲤锚头鳋（Lernaea cyprinacea）是全球淡水养殖中广泛流行的寄生甲壳动物，可侵染鱼苗、鱼种、商品鱼及亲鱼，严重感染时导致暴发性疾病与大量死亡。本文综述了该寄生虫与宿主的互作及侵染规律、对鱼体的生理与组织病理影响，以及防控治疗方法。该虫主要寄生于鳃和鳍附近皮肤，并迅速扩散至全身，引起出血和鳞片脱落，降低商品价值与免疫力，增加继发感染风险；有机磷、有机氯和拟除虫菊酯类产品通常被推荐用于其防治。

papers.title: Tenebrio molitor larvae meal as fish meal alternative: impacts in juvenile narrow-clawed crayfish (Pontastacus leptodactylus)
papers.authors: Uzunmehmetoğlu, Oğuz Yaşar; Bahadır Koca, Seval; Özmen, Özlem; Erol, Kamile Gonca; Özdoğan, Hasan Batuhan Emre; Koca, Habil Uğur; Öztuna, İsmail Hakkı; Akın, Mustafa
papers.journal: Journal of Anatolian Environmental and Animal Sciences
papers.abstract: A 60-day trial examined replacing fish meal (FM) protein with defatted Tenebrio molitor (TM) larvae meal in diets for juvenile narrow-clawed crayfish (Pontastacus leptodactylus). Six isonitrogenous, isoenergetic diets with 0–100% FM protein replacement were tested on 600 stage II juveniles (four replicates of 25 per treatment).Growth performance was similar between the control and 40% TM groups (final weight and SGR did not differ significantly, p&gt;0.05), but replacement levels above 40% significantly reduced growth and survival, with the 100% TM group showing the lowest final weight and survival (48%). Molting frequency and cheliped injury did not differ across treatments. Histological analysis showed normal hepatopancreas and intestine in the control and 20% TM groups. At ≥40% TM inclusion, hepatopancreatic damage (pigment deposits, elevated B-cell counts, degeneration, necrosis) and progressive shortening of intestinal villi were observed, along with luminal content stasis. Overall, up to 20% FM replacement with TM larvae meal can be used safely without harming growth or gut/hepatopancreas health, while higher inclusion levels risk long-term digestive tissue damage.
papers.summary_cn: 60 d投喂试验评估脱脂黄粉虫（Tenebrio molitor, TM）幼虫粉替代鱼粉蛋白对窄爪螯虾（Pontastacus leptodactylus）幼虾的影响，设置0–100%六个等氮等能替代水平。40%及以下替代组生长与对照组无显著差异，但超过40%显著降低生长与存活率（100%组存活率仅48%），蜕壳频率与螯肢损伤无组间差异。组织学显示20%替代组肝胰腺与肠道正常，≥40%组出现肝胰腺损伤（色素沉积、B细胞增多、退化、坏死）及肠绒毛缩短。综合表明TM幼虫粉替代鱼粉可达20%而不损害生长与消化道健康，更高比例则存在长期消化组织损伤风险。
