papers.summary_cn: 以鱼废弃物制备的生物炭作为富磷肥料，用于碱性土壤上茴香（Foeniculum vulgare）cv. Baladi的栽培。

papers.title: Rheological, physicochemical, and structural properties of fish gelatin/carboxymethyl cellulose/Persian gum ternary edible films
papers.authors: Hosseini, Seyed Fakhreddin; Allahyari, Maryam; Gómez-Guillén, M. Carmen
papers.abstract: Abstract This study explored the modulation of fish gelatin (FG)/carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) edible films using Persian gum (PG), focusing on structure-rheology-function relationships and physicochemical performance. Ternary FG/CMC/PG films with mass ratios of 60/40/0, 54/36/10, 48/32/20, 42/28/30, and 36/24/40 were prepared by solution casting. Rheological analysis of film-forming solutions revealed shear-thinning behavior across all formulations, with 10% PG increasing viscosity, possibly because of favorable polymer associations and entanglements, whereas higher PG concentrations (20–40%) decreased viscosity, possibly reflecting concentration-dependent network rearrangement and increasing heterogeneity. Dynamic oscillatory measurements showed that incorporation of PG shifted the viscoelastic response toward a more elastic, solid-like network, suggesting enhanced interactions between PG and FG/CMC chains. Mechanical testing indicated that increasing PG content decreased tensile strength and elongation-at-break, while water vapor permeability increased from 0.74 to 0.95 g mm/kPa h m 2 , and solubility decreased by up to 41% relative to the control, reflecting changes in polymer interactions and film structure. Optical analyses demonstrated that PG improved film transparency. Structural characterization through Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy, X-ray diffraction (XRD), and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) analyses provided evidence of intermolecular interactions and compositional effects on molecular organization, while SEM and AFM observations revealed increasing morphological heterogeneity at higher PG concentrations, suggesting possible microphase separation. Overall, the FG/CMC/PG ternary films developed in this study exhibited tunable functional properties and demonstrated the potential of Persian gum as a natural modifier for developing biodegradable films with potential suitability for food-packaging applications.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以波斯胶（PG）调控鱼明胶（FG）/羧甲基纤维素（CMC）可食膜，制备了不同质量比的三元膜并表征其流变、力学、阻隔及结构性能。PG添加使成膜液由剪切变稀并向弹性网络转变，10% PG提高黏度，而20–40% PG降低黏度并增加结构异质性。随PG含量增加，膜抗拉强度与断裂伸长率下降，水蒸气透过率由0.74升至0.95 g mm/kPa h m²，溶解度最大降低41%，同时透明度改善。FT-IR、XRD、DSC及SEM/AFM结果证实分子间相互作用及高PG含量下的微相分离，表明波斯胶可作为天然改性剂用于可调性能的可降解食品包装膜。

papers.title: Environmental DNA for detecting marine fish species: testing the volume of sampled water, markers and primers in a public oceanarium
papers.authors: Ferreira, André O.; Machado, Cláudia; Barroso, Cristina; Baylina, Núria; Egas, Conceição; Fontes, João T.; Fernandes, Margarida; Oliveira, Claudio; Piecho-Santos, A. Miguel; Duarte, Sofia
papers.abstract: To maximize the efficiency of marine fish detection using environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding, methodological factors such as PCR amplification bias and sampled water volume must be carefully considered. In this study, we evaluated the influence of different genetic markers (COI, 12S rRNA, and 16S rRNA) and water sample volumes (0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, and 10 L) on eDNA-based detection of 60 marine fish species maintained at the Oceanário de Lisboa. Five primer sets were used to generate amplicon libraries from triplicate water samples per tested volume. Overall, the combined use of all markers enabled the detection of 81.7% of the fish species present in the tank (n=49), as well as 37 additional exogenous taxa. Detection success varied among primer sets, ranging from 31.7% for COI FishATL_Cocktail1 to 73.3% for Fish16S. When accounting for reference sequence availability, relative detection success reached 82.4% for 12S and 77.2% for 16S. Increasing water volume consistently led to higher species detection across all markers, with detection percentages approaching saturation at the highest volumes tested. When pooling all markers, up to 76.7% of the species present were detected using a water volume of 5 L. These results highlight the limitations of relying on a single genetic marker and demonstrate the strong influence of sampling volume on detection efficiency, a factor likely to be even more critical in open marine environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以里斯本海洋馆饲养的60种海洋鱼类为对象，评估不同遗传标记（COI、12S rRNA、16S rRNA）及采水量（0.5–10 L）对eDNA metabarcoding检测效率的影响。结果显示，单一标记检测率差异明显（31.7%–73.3%），联合使用所有标记可检出81.7%的馆养鱼种；采水量增加可稳定提升检出率，5 L时联合标记检出率达76.7%。研究表明依赖单一标记存在局限，采样体积是影响检测效率的关键因素，在开放海域中其作用可能更为突出。

papers.title: Aquavoltaics: Advancing the Water‐Food‐Energy Nexus Through Photovoltaic Integration for Sustainable Aquaculture Production—A Comprehensive Review
papers.authors: Raza, Bilal; Ramzan, Muhammad Naeem; Bao, Encai; Chen, Shujian; Mu, Changkao; Ye, Yangfang; Li, Ronghua; Wang, Chunlin; Shi, Ce
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Intensive aquaculture practices heavily reliant on conventional energy sources have contributed significantly to environmental degradation, primarily through greenhouse gas emissions. The sector faces ongoing challenges, including high energy consumption, land‐use conflicts, and unreliable electricity supply, all of which impede its sustainable development and pose broader risks to both human survival and long‐term ecological balance. The quest for efficient solar energy utilization has led to the emergence of aquavoltaics, a novel integrated model that combines photovoltaic technology with aquaculture. Aquavoltaics offers a promising solution to mitigate climate change while addressing the growing global demands for food and energy. By installing photovoltaic modules on water surfaces, aquavoltaic systems simultaneously generate renewable energy and support aquaculture operations. This integration enhances land and water resource efficiency, providing stable power for critical aquaculture equipment and improving the overall sustainability of the sector. Moreover, it contributes to mitigating the energy crisis, enhancing water quality, and advancing the synergistic development of energy and aquaculture within the water‐energy‐food nexus. This review paper explores the current state of aquaculture production and energy consumption, detailing the functionality of aquavoltaic systems, their impact on water quality parameters, and their influence on the productivity of cultured organisms. Additionally, the paper discusses how aquavoltaics fulfill the water‐energy‐food nexus, offering insights into improving aquaculture production and clean energy. Finally, it addresses the sustainability aspects, challenges, and future prospects of aquavoltaic systems, highlighting their potential role in advancing sustainable development.
papers.summary_cn: 综述探讨了 aquavoltaics（渔光互补）这一将光伏发电与水产养殖结合的新型集成模式，旨在应对传统集约化养殖高能耗、土地利用冲突及电力供应不稳定等问题。文章系统梳理了养殖生产与能源消耗现状，分析了光伏系统对水质参数及养殖生物生产力的影响，并阐述了其在 water-energy-food nexus 中的作用。综述还讨论了该模式的可持续性、挑战与前景，认为其可为养殖设备提供稳定清洁电力并提升水土资源利用效率。

papers.title: Beyond Probiotics: Postbiotics for Healthy Aquaculture
papers.authors: Chikindas, Michael Leonidas; Xu, Delin; Popov, Igor V.; Carneiro, Kayque Ordonho; Elova, Nilufar Arashovna; Bekmurodova, Gullola Amirovna; Amirsaidova, Dildora Amindjanovna; Pepoyan, Astghik; Miralimova, Shakhlo Mirjamalovna; Mitrokhin, Oleg V.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT With a growing global population and strict restrictions on traditional antibiotics, sustainable fish health management is crucial for aquaculture. While live probiotics are popular alternatives, their real‐world effectiveness remains highly controversial. Variable effectiveness results from complex interactions with different fish species, differences in fish gastrointestinal anatomy, and variations in environmental parameters such as salinity, pH, and temperature. Furthermore, live probiotics pose risks of ecological disturbance and horizontal gene transfer of antimicrobial resistance. This critical review assesses these limitations and proposes postbiotics, preparations of inanimate microorganisms and their metabolites, as a more stable, controlled, and biosafe formulation. Postbiotics offer significant advantages during industrial aquafeed production and storage. However, their practical implementation is currently hindered by vague terminology and legislative gaps. To overcome these obstacles, this review introduces an innovative modular analytical model utilizing specific chemical biomarkers (such as short‐chain fatty acids, bacteriocins, and lipoteichoic acids). Implementing these matrix‐matched, multi‐module quality control panels to verify molecular safety, identity, and efficacy is critical to standardizing next‐generation “precision postbiotics” for sustainable aquaculture development.
papers.summary_cn: 活菌益生菌在水产养殖中的实际效果受鱼种、胃肠道解剖结构及盐度、pH、温度等环境参数影响而高度不稳定，并存在生态扰动和抗性基因水平转移风险。本文综述提出后生元（灭活微生物及其代谢产物制剂）作为更稳定、可控且生物安全的替代方案，其在工业化水产饲料生产与储存中优势显著，但目前受术语模糊和法规空白制约。作者提出基于短链脂肪酸、细菌素、脂磷壁酸等化学标志物的模块化分析模型，通过基质匹配的多模块质控体系验证分子安全性、身份与功效，以推动“精准后生元”标准化。

papers.title: When Fish Attract Pirates: Why High-Intensity Piracy Concentrates in High-Volume Fisheries Contexts
papers.authors: Dixon, Jevon
papers.abstract: The relationship between fisheries conditions and maritime piracy is commonly framed as an inverse association: higher fisheries production is expected to coincide with lower piracy intensity, whereas lower production is expected to coincide with higher piracy. To assess this, the study uses Mahalanobis distance matching to test whether fisheries-related conditions are systematically associated with piracy intensity after accounting for socioeconomic, political, deterrence, and opportunity covariates. Treatment effects are estimated under two piracy-exposure definitions (high and median exposure), each contrasted against a low-exposure control group. Design-based t-tests with Bonferroni adjustments assess differences across multiple fisheries outcomes. Results show meaningful differences primarily under high piracy exposure, while median exposure yields no statistically robust differences relative to low-exposure controls. Overall, fisheries-related conditions appear to matter primarily in high-exposure environments, highlighting the need to distinguish between marginal and extreme piracy contexts.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在检验渔业状况与海盗活动强度之间的关系，挑战了“渔业产量越高、海盗活动越少”的传统反向关联假设。采用 Mahalanobis distance matching，在控制社会经济、政治、威慑与机会协变量后，比较高海盗暴露与低暴露组的渔业相关条件差异。结果显示，渔业相关条件主要在高海盗暴露情境下呈现显著差异，中位暴露组则无稳健差异，表明需区分边缘性与极端性海盗情境。

papers.title: Environmental Communication and Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration for Sustainable Fisheries Livelihoods and Coastal Resource Governance on Labengki Island, Indonesia
papers.authors: Muslan, Muslan; Suyuti, Nasruddin
papers.journal: Journal of Global Innovations in Agricultural Sciences
papers.abstract: The goal of this study was to analyze multi-stakeholder collaboration in environmental communication in developing sustainable marine tourism in Labengki Island, North Konawe Regency, as a means of supporting coastal fisheries livelihoods and improving the social economy of Labengki Island’s small islands. A qualitative exploratory approach was used, with a case study design. Thematic analysis was conducted in NVivo using software, whilst Actor-Network Analysis (ANA) — an approach adapted from Actor-Network Theory (ANT) — was used to map relationships between human and non-human actors. Participative observation, in-depth interviews, Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), and document analysis were conducted to gather data from 20 informants including local government officials, tourism business actors, local communities, and tourists. The results show that collaboration among stakeholders is established but remains sectoral and has not yet integrated into a common governance framework. The main coordination mechanisms are social relations and informal communication structures such as village deliberation forums, tourism awareness group (Pokdarwis) meetings, and basic digital communication platforms. Although environmental communication plays a significant role in building collective awareness, its application remains insufficient, particularly in waste management and environmental conservation. A pattern of fragmented social-relational collaborative governance is evident, characterized by weak institutional integration, inequitable benefit sharing, and limited environmental management capacity. Beyond institutional fragmentation, the quality of environmental communication and social relations is crucial for the sustainable development of marine tourism in small island regions, as these constitute the primary coordination mechanisms. Keywords: Multi-stakeholder collaboration, environmental communication, collaborative governance, sustainable marine tourism, coastal governance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼Labengki岛为案例，采用定性探索与Actor-Network Analysis方法，通过参与式观察、深度访谈、FGD及文档分析，考察多利益相关方在环境传播中的协作机制及其对可持续海洋旅游与沿海渔业生计的支撑作用。结果显示，利益相关方之间已建立协作，但仍呈部门化特征，未纳入统一的治理框架，主要协调机制依赖社会关系与非正式沟通结构。环境传播在构建集体意识方面作用显著，但在废弃物管理与环境保护方面应用不足，整体呈现制度整合薄弱、利益分配不均、环境管理能力有限的碎片化协作治理格局。

papers.title:
Hypoxia Tolerance in Aquatic Animals: Physiological Basis,
                    <scp>HIF</scp>
                    ‐1α Signaling, and Nutritional Strategies for Aquaculture
papers.authors: Huang, Dong; Meng, Yuqiong; Liu, Yue; Sun, Guoliang; Ma, Rui
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hypoxia is a major stressor in aquaculture and is increasingly intensified by warming, eutrophication, ammonia accumulation, acidification, and other co‐stressors. It impairs growth, feed intake, tissue integrity, immune homeostasis, and survival, making hypoxia tolerance a key trait for sustainable production. At the physiological level, tolerance reflects a balance between survival and cost, involving metabolic suppression, altered development, immune dysregulation, and reduced resilience under compound stress. At the molecular level, hypoxia responses are organized around hypoxia‐inducible factor‐1α (HIF‐1α) and related HIF‐α isoforms, whose activity depends on oxygen‐dependent hydroxylation, VHL‐mediated degradation, FIH‐dependent transcriptional restraint, and oxygen‐independent inflammatory/pathogen‐associated inputs, metabolic and epigenetic regulation, RNA‐level control, SET7‐mediated protein methylation, OTUB1‐related ubiquitin‐linkage control, and redox‐mediated crosstalk with the PHD‐HIF axis. This review evaluates nutritional strategies for hypoxia tolerance by distinguishing direct HIF evidence, indirect HIF‐related evidence, and phenotype‐based evidence. A three‐tier evidence framework is used to interpret protein and amino acid, carbohydrate, lipid, vitamin, mineral, plant‐derived additive, probiotic/prebiotic/postbiotic, and carotenoid interventions. We emphasize that improved hypoxia tolerance should not be equated with direct activation of HIF‐1α unless protein stabilization, nuclear localization, HRE activity, target‐gene regulation, or functional perturbation evidence is available. This evidence‐graded approach provides a clearer basis for translating nutritional and genetic strategies into aquaculture practice.
papers.summary_cn: 综述水生动物低氧耐受的生理基础与HIF-1α信号机制，并系统评估水产养殖中的营养调控策略。低氧耐受涉及代谢抑制、发育改变、免疫失调及复合胁迫下抗逆性下降，分子层面以HIF-1α及其相关亚型的氧依赖性羟化、VHL介导降解、FIH转录抑制等调控为核心。作者提出三级证据框架，区分直接HIF证据、间接HIF相关证据和表型证据，用于解读蛋白质与氨基酸、糖类、脂类、维生素、矿物质、植物源添加剂、益生菌/益生元/后生元及类胡萝卜素等干预措施，并强调低氧耐受改善不等同于HIF-1α直接激活，除非具备蛋白稳定化、核定位、HRE活性、靶基因调控或功能扰动证据。

papers.title: Responsiveness to price changes for major aquaculture products in U.S. retail markets
papers.authors: Kumar, Ganesh; Engle, Carole; Sun, Lianqun
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Consumer preferences, purchasing behavior, and demand for seafood evolve over time. Measuring and understanding the effects of price changes on demand responses are critical to the design of effective marketing strategies for aquaculture producers. This study used a non‐linear Almost Ideal Demand System (non‐linear AIDS) model to estimate price, cross‐price, promotion, and expenditure elasticities for five major aquaculture frozen and refrigerated finfish fillet products in U.S. retail markets including salmon, tilapia, pangasius (swai/basa/tra), catfish, and trout. Results of price‐elasticity estimates showed that demand for pangasius, catfish, and trout was elastic, with the strongest elasticity for trout (highly responsive to price changes), while demand for salmon was inelastic; cross‐price elasticities revealed strong substitution for tilapia by pangasius, for pangasius by tilapia, and for trout by salmon. Weak substitution effects were found for tilapia by catfish and for salmon by trout. Expenditure elasticities were statistically significant and positive for all finfish evaluated, with the highest being for catfish followed by salmon. Promotional elasticities were found to significantly improve budget shares of salmon and trout but were not significant for tilapia, pangasius, or catfish. Hicksian price elasticities that compensated for consumer income effects of changing price levels showed strong substitution effects for tilapia by pangasius, for pangasius by tilapia, for catfish by salmon and tilapia, and for trout by salmon. Additional research on consumer price responsiveness is needed to further explore effects in specific U.S. cities and regional markets and to evaluate the effectiveness of specific messaging and non‐price marketing strategies for U.S. retail markets.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用非线性AIDS模型，估计美国零售市场五种主要养殖冷冻及冷藏鱼片产品（salmon、tilapia、pangasius、catfish、trout）的价格、交叉价格、促销和支出弹性，以评估价格变化对需求的影响。结果显示，pangasius、catfish和trout需求富有弹性（trout弹性最强），salmon需求缺乏弹性；tilapia与pangasius、trout与salmon之间存在较强替代关系。所有鱼种支出弹性均显著为正，促销弹性仅对salmon和trout的预算份额有显著提升作用。

papers.title: The Impact of Climate Change on Global Aquaculture: A Focus on Heat Stress
papers.authors: Mylostyvyi, Roman; Marenkov, Oleh; Rudakov, Leonid
papers.journal: Journal of Global Innovations in Agricultural Sciences
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is one of the fastest-growing sectors of global food production, contributing significantly to nutrition, livelihoods, and economic development, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. However, climate change poses a growing threat to the stability and sustainability of aquaculture systems, primarily due to rising water temperatures and the increasing frequency of extreme weather events. This review examines the diverse impacts of heat stress on aquaculture species and operations globally. It synthesises current knowledge of the physiological, immunological, behavioural, ecological, and socio-economic consequences. Particular emphasis is placed on metabolic disruptions, oxidative damage, immune suppression, changes in microbiota, and reduced growth and reproductive capacity under both acute and chronic thermal exposure. The regional vulnerability of aquaculture systems is discussed, highlighting disparities in adaptive capacity and resilience. The review further outlines adaptation and mitigation strategies, including thermal tolerance breeding, recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), precision farming, and climate-smart management practices. It identifies critical research gaps regarding long-term adaptation, early-life exposure effects, and multi-stressor interactions under climate change scenarios. Strengthening science-policy integration and supporting small-scale producers through innovation and investment are key recommendations to enhance climate resilience in aquaculture. Keywords: Climate change, aquaculture, heat stress, thermal tolerance, fish physiology, immune function, adaptation strategies, food security.
papers.summary_cn: 全球水产养殖正面临气候变暖引发的热应激威胁，本文综述了热应激对养殖物种在生理、免疫、行为、生态及社会经济层面的多重影响，重点关注代谢紊乱、氧化损伤、免疫抑制、微生物群变化及生长与繁殖能力下降。研究指出不同区域养殖系统在适应能力与韧性上存在显著差异，并梳理了耐热育种、RAS、精准养殖及气候智慧型管理等适应与缓解策略。文章还识别了长期适应、早期生命阶段暴露效应及多重胁迫因子交互作用等关键研究缺口，强调加强科学-政策整合及支持小规模生产者以提升水产养殖的气候韧性。

papers.title: Oral taste preferences and food‐handling behaviour in the cave morph of Mexican tetra Astyanax mexicanus
papers.authors: Kasumyan, Alexander; Mikhailova, Elena; Vinogradskaya, Maria
papers.abstract: Abstract Since its discovery in 1936, the cave morph of the Mexican tetra, Astyanax mexicanus , has become a promising model for studies of compensatory adaptation. The loss of vision has driven the adaptive evolution of sensory systems in the cave morph. Studies of the gustatory system have mainly focused on the morphology and distribution of taste buds, but the functional aspects of this system remain unknown. In the present study, oral taste preferences of the cave morph of A. mexicanus were identified for the first time. Using a behavioural assay, it was found that more than half of the 21 proteinogenic L‐amino acids and more than one‐third of the 18 organic acids, as well as nearly all of the four basic taste substances, were either indifferent or repulsive. These findings are not consistent with expectations based on the opportunistic feeding mode of the cave morph. In addition, the threshold concentration of the most palatable substance, maleic acid, is within the range commonly found in epigean fish species. In summary, there is no evidence to suggest that compensatory improvement in oral taste perception has occurred in the cave morph. A single grasp is often sufficient for the cave morph to swallow or irreversibly reject an offered pellet. The relatively long retention time, especially for palatable pellets, is another characteristic of food‐handling behaviour. Before swallowing, the cave morph retains pellets for up to eight to nine times longer, regardless of their taste quality.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次通过行为学实验测定了墨西哥丽脂鲤（*Astyanax mexicanus*）洞穴型的口腔味觉偏好，发现超过半数蛋白质源L-氨基酸、逾三分之一有机酸及几乎所有四种基本味觉物质均被 indifferent 或 repulsive，与洞穴型机会主义摄食模式的预期不符。最适口物质马来酸的阈值浓度与地表鱼类相当，表明洞穴型未出现口腔味觉感知的代偿性增强。摄食行为方面，洞穴型通常一次咬取即可吞咽或不可逆地拒食颗粒，且吞咽前保留时间显著延长（可达地表鱼的8–9倍），不受味觉品质影响。

papers.title: New Game-Theoretical Approach to Marketing Cooperatives in Fisheries
papers.authors: López, Inmaculada; Gámez, Manuel; Castaño-Fernández, Ana Belén; Garay, József; Varga, Zoltán
papers.abstract: Abstract While most game-theoretical models in fisheries deal with the conflict of exploitation of the same resource, unlike these models, the present paper is dedicated to marketing conflicts, always accounting for the underlying population dynamics. In the context of marketing cooperatives in fisheries, three models are combined: the classical fishing effort model based on logistic population dynamics, a game-theoretical model of the conflict between a marketing cooperative and its members, and a Cournot-type oligopoly market model. The latter, in particular, means that the market price is determined by the total supply on the market. The fishers selling fish outside the marketing cooperative are punished. In the present paper, within this complex model, based on Pareto optimality, a particular cooperative solution, the so-called nearly ideal solution, is introduced and compared with the previously studied, special non-cooperative solution, also called attractive solution . In fact, for the respective repeated games, counting with the underlying fishing effort dynamics, the two solution types are compared. Results show that the cooperative solution yields higher total payoffs if at least one member fishes, one member is unfaithful, and a specific pricing condition holds. Additionally, increasing the punishment parameter stabilizes the cooperative by ensuring members contribute their catch, while higher fishing efforts increase catches without depleting stocks but require stricter penalties to prevent free-market diversion.
papers.summary_cn: 本文构建了渔业营销合作社的博弈论模型，将基于logistic种群动态的捕捞努力量模型、合作社与成员间的博弈模型及Cournot型寡头市场模型相结合，引入基于Pareto最优的“近乎理想”合作解，并与非合作“吸引解”在重复博弈框架下进行比较。结果表明，在至少一名成员捕捞、一名成员不忠诚且满足特定定价条件时，合作解可实现更高总收益；增大惩罚参数有助于稳定合作社，而捕捞努力量提高虽可增加产量且不耗尽资源，但需更严格的惩罚以防止成员向自由市场分流。

papers.title: Genetic diversity in mitochondrial DNA reveals the effect of a Fisheries Protection Zone on exploited marine species in the Menorca Channel (Western Mediterranean)
papers.authors: Pasini, Noemi; Bassitta, Marta; Ferragut, Joana F.; Farriols, Maria Teresa; Petit-Marty, Natalia; Ordinas, Francesc; Ramírez-Amaro, Sergio; Picornell, Antònia
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于线粒体DNA遗传多样性，评估西地中海Menorca海峡渔业保护区（Fisheries Protection Zone）对开发性海洋物种的遗传效应。通过比较保护区内外种群的遗传结构，揭示该管理措施对目标物种遗传多样性的影响。

papers.title: Community-based coral transplantation and fish apartment deployment in the Sapeken Islands, Indonesia
papers.authors: Naibaho, Kampoi; Oktavia, Siska; Mahsyar, Rizal; Imran, Imran; Ishaq, Maulana
papers.journal: Journal of Community Service and Empowerment
papers.abstract: The small-island communities of Sapeken, Sumenep, depend on coastal ecosystems, yet a community service account must distinguish installation outputs from demonstrated reef recovery. This article documents a coral transplantation and fish apartment programme implemented by the Community Development unit of Kangean Energy Indonesia in Pagerungan Besar, Pagerungan Kecil, and Sadulang. A descriptive, output-oriented case-study approach was applied to the activity recap supplied by the implementing team and 14 field photographs, including a site-specific 2025 image. Three local youth organisations participated: Karang Taruna Laskar Obor, Bina Muda Berkarya, and Persada. The programme reported 500 coral seedlings and 15 fish apartments in Pagerungan Besar; 600 and 12 in Pagerungan Kecil; and 1,000 and 20 in Sadulang. In total, 2,100 coral seedlings and 47 fish apartments were installed across three locations. The photographs document fragment preparation, underwater attachment to structures, boat operations, and community participation, but are not independently geotagged or linked to individual island totals. The partnership demonstrates a practicable entry point for youth involvement in corporate social and environmental responsibility. Ecological effectiveness, however, cannot be inferred from installation counts alone because baseline benthic cover, coral species, transplant survival, fish assemblages, and follow-up observations were unavailable. The proposed follow-up combines site mapping, permanently marked sample units, coral survival and growth, fish counts at intervention and comparison sites, structural stability, and youth participation records.
papers.summary_cn: 印尼Sapeken群岛社区主导的珊瑚移植与鱼礁部署项目，由Kangean Energy Indonesia社区发展部门在Pagerungan Besar、Pagerungan Kecil和Sadulang三地实施，三个当地青年组织参与。项目共安装2,100株珊瑚苗和47座fish apartment，但缺乏基线benthic cover、珊瑚种类、移植存活率及鱼类群落等生态数据，仅凭安装数量无法评估生态有效性。作者建议后续结合样地制图、永久标记样方、珊瑚存活与生长监测、干预与对照点鱼类计数及结构稳定性评估，以验证礁区恢复效果。

papers.title: Antimicrobial susceptibility of common foodborne bacteria isolated from freshwater fish
papers.authors: Robani, N.E.; Ahmad, N.
papers.abstract: Freshwater fish are widely consumed as an important source of protein for humans, especially in Malaysia. However, improper handling and distribution may expose consumers to foodborne pathogens or species that pose public health risks. This study focuses on identifying and profiling the antibiotic resistance of selected foodborne bacteria, Vibrio spp. and Escherichia coli. The bacteria were isolated from freshwater fish purchased at supermarkets and wet markets in Kuala Pilah, Negeri Sembilan. Primary isolation was performed using selective and differential media, including thiosulfate citrate bile salts sucrose (TCBS) agar and MacConkey agar, followed by a series of biochemical tests for species confirmation, and enumeration was conducted using the total viable count (TVC) method, expressed as colony-forming units per gram (CFU/g). Antimicrobial susceptibility was assessed by the Kirby–Bauer disc diffusion method with selected antibiotics, and resistance profiles were further evaluated by calculating the multiple antibiotic resistance (MAR) index. The results revealed differences in bacterial prevalence and resistance patterns between sample sources and market types, with E. coli isolates generally showing higher resistance than Vibrio spp. This indicates that E. coli species poses a higher risk to humans. Both the aquatic and market environments offer conditions that support bacterial survival, colonization, and transmission, especially where hygiene control is lacking. Cross-contamination may also occur in the sales area. MAR index values above 0.2 suggest exposure to antibiotics and possible high-risk contamination sources. In conclusion, this study offers important insights into the microbiological safety of freshwater fish and highlights the necessity of monitoring bacterial contamination and antibiotic resistance in food supply chains to protect public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在调查马来西亚瓜拉庇劳超市与湿售市场淡水鱼中常见食源性细菌（Vibrio spp. 与 Escherichia coli）的污染状况及抗生素耐药特征。采用选择性鉴别培养基分离、生化鉴定及总活菌计数（TVC），并以 Kirby–Bauer 纸片扩散法和 multiple antibiotic resistance (MAR) index 评估耐药性。结果显示，不同样品来源和市场类型间细菌流行率与耐药谱存在差异，E. coli 的耐药性普遍高于 Vibrio spp.，MAR index 超过0.2提示存在抗生素暴露及高风险污染源。研究强调需加强淡水鱼供应链中细菌污染与抗生素耐药性监测以保障公共卫生。

papers.title: Deep learning-based fish behavior recognition for intelligent aquaculture: progress, challenges, and future perspectives
papers.authors: Qi, Dezhong; Xu, Longteng; Sun, Linlin; Fan, Bin; Gao, Ming
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦智能水产养殖中的鱼类行为识别，梳理了基于深度学习的行为识别技术进展。文章分析了当前面临的主要挑战，并展望了未来发展方向。

papers.title: Climate-driven Reproductive Dysfunction in Cultured Fish and Shellfish: Endocrine Mechanisms, Consequences and Adaptive Strategies
papers.authors: Nagampoozhi, Suja
papers.abstract: Climate change is altering the environmental conditions experienced by aquatic organisms through rising temperatures, marine heatwaves, hypoxia, salinity fluctuations, ocean acidification and more frequent extreme events. Although the effects of climate change on growth, survival and disease have received considerable attention, reproductive impairment may occur before substantial mortality and can directly threaten aquaculture seed production. Reproduction depends on the coordinated interaction of environmental cues, neuroendocrine pathways, gonadal function, gametogenesis and energy allocation, making it particularly sensitive to environmental instability. In fish, climate-related changes can affect the brain–pituitary–gonad axis, steroidogenesis, sex differentiation, gametogenesis, gamete quality and spawning. Temperature is especially important because it influences endocrine regulation throughout reproductive development, while hypoxia, salinity changes and ocean acidification can further modify endocrine, metabolic and cellular processes. In shellfish, environmental stress can affect gonadal development, gametogenesis, spawning, fertilisation and larval performance through mechanisms that differ from those operating in vertebrate fishes. Multiple climate-related stressors may also act simultaneously, producing additive, synergistic or antagonistic effects. Parental exposure can further influence offspring through maternal provisioning, paternal effects and epigenetic mechanisms. These processes have direct implications for broodstock conditioning, hatchery seed production and the sustainability of aquaculture. This review examines the links between climate-related environmental change, reproductive endocrine regulation and reproductive performance in cultured fish and shellfish, with emphasis on gamete quality, spawning, early development, multiple-stressor interactions and reproductive resilience. Environmental management, broodstock selection, nutrition, acclimation, selective breeding, biomarker-based monitoring and climate-resilient hatchery technologies are considered potential approaches for sustaining reproductive performance under future environmental conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本综述聚焦气候变化对养殖鱼类和贝类繁殖功能的影响，系统梳理了温度升高、海洋热浪、低氧、盐度波动及海洋酸化等环境胁迫通过干扰脑-垂体-性腺轴、类固醇合成、配子发生和产卵等过程导致繁殖障碍的内分泌机制。研究强调繁殖损伤往往先于大规模死亡出现，直接威胁水产种苗生产，且多重胁迫因子可产生加和、协同或拮抗效应，亲本暴露还可通过母源供给和表观遗传途径影响子代。文章进一步探讨了环境管理、亲本选育、营养调控、驯化、选择性育种及气候韧性孵化技术等适应性策略，以维持未来环境条件下的繁殖性能。

papers.title: Ancestral organisation and asymmetric circuit architecture of the habenula revealed in a basal ray-finned fish
papers.authors: Ahumada-Galleguillos, P.; Concha, M. L.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以 basal ray-finned fish 为模型，探讨 habenula（缰核）的祖先组织方式与不对称神经环路结构。摘要缺失，仅凭标题可知其聚焦于比较神经解剖学层面，揭示缰核在早期辐鳍鱼类中的演化保守性与左右不对称特征。非渔业相关。

papers.title: Post-impoundment changes in fish diversity and community structure of the Dikrong River, Arunachal Pradesh: a comparative assessment between 2000–2001 and 2025–2026
papers.authors: Minam Siram; Tonya Miroh; Rafia Farooquee; Debanghsu Narayan Das
papers.abstract: A study carried out on the dam impacted Dikrong River, which is one of the major tributaries of the Brahmaputra in Arunachal Pradesh, suggests that the river has undergone significant ecological alteration following the commissioning of the Sopo dam in 2018 and increasing anthropogenic pressures. The present study attempted to assess the fish diversity, community structure, trophic composition, and conservation status in the Dikrong River during 2025–2026 and the results were compared with pre-impoundment records made in the year 2000–2001. A total of 27 fish species belonging to 24 genera, eight families, and three orders were recorded, with Cyprinidae dominating the assemblage (51.9%). Opsarius bendelisis was the most abundant species (44.1%). The taxonomic comparison with previous data reveals an apparent reduction in the number of species, mainly bottom feeders, which highlights their sensitivity to flow regulation and habitat modification. There was a change in the food chain from the dominance of bottom feeders to column feeders. Water release from regulation, riverbed quarrying, and runoff reduced the quality of the habitat and fish behavior. The juveniles of Semiplotus semiplotus, Opsarius bendelisis, and Devario aequipinnatus were found to be accumulating in the clean-connected drainage system downstream (polluted zone). The findings suggest a need for environmental flow regulation and habitat restoration to conserve remaining fish diversity. Further, the study recommends promotion of culture-based fisheries selecting some of the indigenous ornamental and food fish as a future conservation and livelihood strategy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦Dikrong河（Brahmaputra支流）在Sopo大坝2018年蓄水前后（2000–2001年与2025–2026年）的鱼类多样性、群落结构、营养组成及保护状况。2025–2026年共记录27种鱼类，隶属24属8科3目，以Cyprinidae为主（51.9%），Opsarius bendelisis为最优势种（44.1%）。与蓄水前数据相比，物种数明显减少，尤以底层摄食者为主，食物链结构由底层摄食者主导转变为中上层摄食者主导，反映出流量调节与栖息地改变对鱼类群落的显著影响。研究建议实施环境流量调控与栖息地修复，并推动基于本土观赏及食用鱼的养殖型渔业作为保护与生计策略。

papers.title: Climate-driven Harmful Algal Blooms and Marine Aquaculture: A Critical Appraisal of Early Warning, Fish Mortality, Exposure Mechanisms and Farm-level Adaptation
papers.authors: Patil, Sakshi; Mohammad, Talib; Pandey, Ashmita; Soni, Shubham; Chopra, Pranjali H.
papers.journal: International Journal of Environment and Climate Change
papers.abstract: Harmful algal blooms represent one of the few climate-sensitive hazards capable of destroying an entire marine farm's standing biomass within days, yet the scientific literature that underpins farm protection remains fragmented across oceanography, fish pathology, sensor engineering and resource economics. This review critically examines the evidence connecting climate variability and change to bloom hazard in aquaculture regions, the quantification of farmed fish mortality, the cellular and physiological mechanisms through which exposure becomes death, and the effectiveness of early warning systems and farm-level adaptation. Peer-reviewed literature was identified through structured searching of open scholarly databases and indexes, supplemented by backward and forward citation searching, and appraised for design adequacy, measurement validity, ecological realism and consistency with independent evidence. Four conclusions emerge with differing degrees of confidence. Attribution of increased bloom frequency to climate forcing remains contested at the global scale because observational effort has expanded alongside aquaculture itself, although regional attribution is considerably stronger where hydroclimatic anomalies have been reconstructed independently of bloom records. Mortality quantification rests largely on cell-abundance thresholds whose transferability between species, sites and years is weak, and which conflate very different killing mechanisms. Mechanistic work has converged on reactive oxygen species, lipophilic and polyketide toxins, and mechanical gill injury as complementary rather than competing pathways, but laboratory potency rankings predict field outcomes poorly because exposure dose, water-column structure and prior gill condition are rarely measured concurrently. Early warning systems have matured technologically while remaining substantially under-evaluated against operational decision criteria, and most farm-level mitigation measures are supported by mechanistic plausibility and small-scale trials rather than by controlled comparison at commercial scale. Priorities include standardised exposure reporting, prospective forecast verification against farm decisions, and evaluation of mitigation under realistic bloom conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 有害藻华（HABs）是少数能在数天内摧毁整个海水养殖场存栏生物量的气候敏感型灾害，但其防护研究分散于海洋学、鱼类病理学、传感器工程与资源经济学等领域。本文通过结构化文献检索与引文追溯，系统评估了气候变化与养殖区藻华风险的关联、养殖鱼类死亡量化方法、暴露致死的细胞与生理机制，以及预警系统和养殖场适应措施的有效性。主要发现：全球尺度上藻华频率增加的气候归因仍存争议（区域性归因较强）；死亡量化多依赖细胞丰度阈值，其跨物种、跨站点可迁移性弱且混淆了不同致死机制；活性氧、亲脂性毒素和机械性鳃损伤为互补而非竞争的致死路径，但实验室毒力排序难以预测野外结果；预警系统技术成熟但缺乏基于操作决策标准的评估，多数减缓措施仅基于机制合理性和小规模试验。

papers.title: Eco-Friendly Inhibition of Spirulina Blooms Through Allelopathic Effects of Marine Macroalgae
papers.authors: Bakhshayeshan-Agdam, Hamideh; Hosein-Nasab, Mehri; Hoseini, Mahdieh; Razeghi, Jafar; Salehi-Lisar, Seyed Yahya
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.summary_cn: 研究探讨利用大型海藻的化感作用（allelopathy）抑制螺旋藻（Spirulina）水华，为有害藻华（HABs）的生态友好型防控提供潜在途径。

papers.authors: Nakamura, Masahiro; Yoneda, Michio; Tanaka, Shota; Takasuka, Akinori; Furuichi, Sho; Nishijima, Shota; Kamimura, Yasuhiro
papers.abstract: Abstract The growth–survival paradigm (GSP) predicts that faster early growth enhances survival to recruitment, yet clear support is found in only about half of published studies. Although the GSP links early growth to recruitment, empirical studies have focused primarily on the larval stage, leaving the persistence of early growth advantages until recruitment poorly understood. Here, we examine the consequences of early growth for later size and growth in chub mackerel (Scomber japonicus) using field-collected and laboratory-reared samples. Daily otolith increment analyses of wild-caught adults revealed consistent negative relationships between larval growth rates and adult body size across year classes and sexes, with adult size most strongly associated with growth up to the 10th daily increment. A rearing experiment under ad libitum feeding and constant conditions showed a significant negative correlation between larval- and late-juvenile growth rates, resulting in a convergence in body size such that early growth was no longer associated with body size at approximately 150 mm standard length. Together, these results suggest that the negative association between early growth and adult size in wild chub mackerel can be explained, at least in part, by intrinsic changes in relative growth rates among individuals during the late juvenile stage. Such changes may alter relative size among individuals before recruitment, thereby offsetting the expected advantages of rapid early growth. This perspective suggests a mechanism by which the relationship between early growth and survival to recruitment may be modified, potentially contributing to cases in which the GSP does not hold.
papers.summary_cn: 以日本鲭（Scomber japonicus）为对象，结合野外采集与实验室养殖样本，检验早期生长优势能否持续至成鱼阶段。耳石日轮分析显示，野生成鱼的仔鱼期生长率与成鱼体型呈稳定负相关，成鱼体型主要与第10日轮前的生长相关；在充足投喂的养殖实验中，仔鱼期与晚期稚鱼期生长率亦呈显著负相关，体长约150 mm SL时体型趋同。结果表明，晚期稚鱼阶段个体间相对生长率的内在变化可抵消快速早期生长的预期优势，为 growth–survival paradigm（GSP）在某些情形下不成立提供了机制解释。

papers.title: Ishkov in the history of the All-Russian Research Institute of Fisheries and Aquaculture and the country’s fisheries
papers.authors: Bagrov, A. M.
papers.abstract: The article analyzes the role of Minister A.A. Ishkov in the formation and development of the Institute and the creation of a major research and educational center, using the example of the history of the country’s leading research institute in the field of fish farming. It complements the book about the Minister (2025). Some historical events from the 1960s to the 2000s are presented for the first time or serve as a reminder.
papers.summary_cn: 该文以全俄渔业与水产养殖研究所（VNIRO）发展史为线索，分析A.A. Ishkov部长在研究机构建设及大型科研教育中心形成中的作用，补充了2025年出版的部长传记，并首次披露或回顾了1960至2000年代若干历史事件。

papers.title: Technologies for the use of aerial drones to support fisheries tasks
papers.authors: Osipov, E. V.; Pavlov, G. S.
papers.abstract: Based on the experience of using aerial drones in the fisheries industry and the current experience of using such drones within the framework of the Civil Defense System (CDS) using civilian drones, this paper defines a concept for using such drones for aquatic life search and detection. Two types of fixed-wing drones (including vertical takeoff and landing) and hexacopters with hydroacoustic echosounders are considered. The tasks of searching for and detecting sardines and Pacific saury are proposed, taking into account various factors.
papers.summary_cn: 该文基于渔业及民防系统（CDS）中 aerial drones 的应用经验，提出将其用于水生生物搜索与探测的概念框架。研究考察了固定翼无人机（含垂直起降型）和搭载 hydroacoustic echosounders 的六旋翼无人机两类平台，并针对 sardine 和 Pacific saury 的搜索探测任务，综合分析了多种影响因素。

papers.title: Critical information on the genus Lethrinus from the Red Sea, applications for fisheries conservation and management
papers.authors: Okba, Zahra; Charles, Santhosh Kumar; Garla, Ricardo Clapis; Gireesh, Sheeja; Palani, Goutham Bharathi Muthu; Kadengal, Sirajudheen Thayyil; Santucci, Ronald Grech; Alfaqih, Nawaf; Adam, Adel; Tirasin, Eyup Mumtaz
papers.abstract: Abstract Emperor fishes of the genus Lethrinus are ecologically and commercially important in the Red Sea, supporting artisanal fisheries across Saudi Arabia. Collectively, the Lethrinus species contribute substantially to local fish landings, with average annual catches exceeding 5000 tonnes and high market value in domestic and regional trade. Given their significance, effective management is crucial to ensure sustainability. This study assessed the population biology and exploitation status of eight Lethrinus species: L. borbonicus , L. lentjan , L. microdon , L. mahsena , L. nebulosus , L. obsoletus , L. olivaceus and L. xanthochilus , using fishery‐dependent samples collected along the Saudi Arabian Red Sea coast from April 2022 to April 2025. Total length ( TL ) ranged from 4.9 to 70.5 cm, and total weight ( W ) from 2.6 to 4067 g. Length–weight relationships varied among species, with growth types spanning positive allometry ( b > 3), isometry ( b ≈ 3) and negative allometry ( b < 3). Von Bertalanffy growth parameters revealed TL ∞ values ranging from 26.5 cm in L. borbonicus to 64.61 cm in L. lentjan, and growth coefficients ( K ) from 0.13 to 0.41 year −1 . Median length at first maturity ranged from 18.83 cm ( L. obsoletus ) to 25.68 cm ( L. nebulosus ). Natural mortality estimates, averaged across methods, ranged from 0.23 to 0.31 year −1 , while total mortality varied from 0.41 to 0.84 year −1 . Corresponding fishing mortality estimates were higher in L. lentjan (0.53 year −1 ) and lower in L. obsoletus and L. mahsena (0.41 and 0.42 year −1 , respectively). Exploitation rates ( E ) exceeded the limit reference point ( E = 0.5) remarkably in all three species, indicating ongoing overfishing. Yield‐per‐recruit and spawning potential ratio analyses (SPR) further confirm reduced reproductive capacity, with SPR values falling below 22% in L. lentjan. Despite mature individuals dominating samples, 47% of legally undersized mature fish in L. lentjan landings were below the current minimum landing size (MLS), signalling poor regulatory compliance. L. mahsena and L. obsoletus are below the SPR threshold (40%) but slightly above safe biological limits. Findings highlight the urgent need for improved management, including species‐specific MLS regulations, selective fishing gear and enhanced enforcement, to support the long‐term sustainability of Lethrinus stocks in the Red Sea.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2022—2025年沙特阿拉伯红海沿岸渔业依赖样本，评估了8种龙占鱼属（Lethrinus）鱼类的种群生物学与开发状况，涵盖体长体重关系、Von Bertalanffy生长参数、初次性成熟体长及死亡参数。结果显示各物种生长类型从正异速到负异速不等，L. lentjan捕捞死亡率最高（0.53 yr⁻¹），三个物种开发率（E）均超过极限参考点（E=0.5），表明过度捕捞正在发生。单位补充量渔获量与产卵潜力比（SPR）分析进一步证实繁殖能力下降，L. lentjan的SPR低于22%，且47%的合法体长成熟个体低于现行最小上岸规格（MLS）。研究呼吁制定物种特异性MLS法规、采用选择性渔具并加强执法，以保障红海Lethrinus种群的长期可持续性。

papers.title: Fish resources of Lake Chany: stock status and fisheries in the first quarter of the 21st century
papers.authors: Suknev, D. L.; Selezneva, M. V.; Interesova, E. A.; Mityaev, E. M.; Shatalin, V. A.; Abramov, A. L.
papers.abstract: This paper presents an analysis of the status of commercial fish stocks and fishery efficiency in Lake Chany (Western Siberia) over the period 2000–2024. Based on data collected during monitoring of aquatic biological resources in Lake Chany by the Novosibirsk Branch of the Federal State Budgetary Scientific Institution “Russian Federal Research Institute of Fisheries and Oceanography” (VNIRO), and used to prepare materials substantiating recommended catch volumes of aquatic biological resources, as well as fishery statistics, the dynamics of catches, species composition of the harvest, and the impact of the hydrological regime on fish stock status were assessed. It was found that against the background of rising water levels, total catches have increased exponentially, averaging 7,0 thousand tons in 2021–2024 (peaking at 8.1 thousand tons in 2023). A statistically significant positive correlation was identified between the catch volumes of all key species and the mean water level during recruitment years (with a lag of 2–4 years). Resource utilization is characterized by high intensity (averaging 82 % of the recommended catch), yet exhibits pronounced selectivity: catches of commercially valuable species (zander, perch, pike) exceed permitted limits, while stocks of crucian carp, ide, and bream remain underutilized. The proportion of introduced species in catches is growing faster than that of native species. It is concluded that fishing pressure must be adjusted hydrological cycles to ensure the sustainable use of the lake’s fish resources.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于2000–2024年俄罗斯VNIRO新西伯利亚分所的渔业资源监测与统计数据，评估了西西伯利亚Chany湖的商业鱼类种群状况及捕捞效率。结果表明，随着水位上升，总捕捞量呈指数增长，2021–2024年均达7.0千吨（2023年峰值8.1千吨），且主要鱼种捕捞量与补充年份平均水位之间存在显著正相关（滞后2–4年）。资源利用率高（平均达建议捕捞量的82%），但选择性明显：梭鲈、河鲈、狗鱼等经济价值高的种类捕捞超过许可限额，而鲫鱼、圆腹雅罗鱼和欧鳊资源利用不足，且引入种在渔获中的占比增长快于本地种。研究认为需根据水文周期调整捕捞压力，以实现湖泊鱼类资源的可持续利用。

papers.title: Analysis of the impact of weather factors  on the behavior of pelagic commercial fish  and the possibility of detecting their schools  and aggregations using unmanned aerial vehicles
papers.authors: Letunova, Elizaveta A.; Skorik, Andrey V.; Filatov, Viktor N.
papers.abstract: The paper examines the influence of weather and hydrometeorological factors on the behavior of pelagic commercial fish and the effectiveness of detecting their schools and aggregations using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The focus is on the Pacific saury, one of the most challenging targets for detection in the North-Western Pacific Ocean. The responses of the fish to artificial light, the impact of storms, cyclones, and wind waves were analyzed, as well as the changes in the thermostructure of the upper ocean layer on the distribution and stability of fish aggregations. It has been shown that weather conditions have a dual effect: they worsen the visual conditions of observation and simultaneously change the spatial distribution of schools, causing them to move into deeper waters and disperse. The operational capabilities of various types of UAVs for monitoring the sea surface were also assessed. It was established that the effectiveness of UAV-based monitoring is determined by a combination of meteorological, oceanographic, and technical factors and requires an integrated approach to observation planning and implementation.
papers.summary_cn: 研究分析了天气与水文气象因素对中上层商业鱼类行为及其 UAV 探测效果的影响，以西北太平洋太平洋秋刀鱼为对象，考察了鱼类对人工光、风暴、气旋和风浪的响应，以及上层海洋热结构变化对鱼群分布与稳定性的作用。结果表明，天气条件具有双重效应：既降低目视观测条件，又改变鱼群空间分布，使其向深水移动并分散。UAV 监测效能取决于气象、海洋与技术因素的综合作用，需采用一体化观测规划与实施策略。

papers.title: Fish production and economic growth in Nigeria: implications for rural poverty alleviation
papers.authors: Kehinde, Ogunbadejo Hussain; Zubair, Aisha A.; O., Jim-Saiki L.
papers.abstract: This research was carried out in order to provide empirical information on the relationship between fish production and the growth of the Nigerian economy with a focus on poverty reduction. This research used time series data from 1970 to 2016 and analyzed the data using unit root tests and the bounds (ARDL) approach to cointegration. The results of the data analysis indicated that fish production was significant in influencing economic growth in the long run in Nigeria. Despite economic growth, poverty continues to rise, calling for a shift from a monolithic oil-based economy to a more plural one, with fish as a subsector of agriculture as the lead sector. It was recommended that pro-poor policies should be designed to alleviate rural poverty through increased investments in aquaculture development by the public and private sectors.
papers.summary_cn: 基于1970—2016年尼日利亚时间序列数据，采用单位根检验与ARDL边界协整方法，分析鱼产量与经济增长及农村减贫的关系。结果表明鱼产量在长期显著影响尼日利亚经济增长，但经济增长未能有效缓解贫困。研究建议公共与私营部门加大水产养殖投资，以推动减贫导向的政策设计。

papers.title: Redesigning boat owner-crew labor relations in Kupang fisheries: a systems and behavioral analysis
papers.authors: Nggajo, Raimundus; Nurani, Tri W.; Darmawan, .; Solihin, Iin; Zulkarnain, .; Khoerunnisa, Nurani
papers.abstract: Informal patron-client arrangements in capture fisheries can combine vessel finance, employment, social assistance, and market control, creating both protection and dependency. This study examined how boat owner-crew labor relations are reproduced and how a feasible transformation could be designed at Tenau Coastal Fishing Port and Oeba Fish Landing Base, Kupang City, Indonesia. A qualitative case study with descriptive economic support used observations, in-depth interviews, structured questionnaires, and document review from April to November 2024. The principal participants comprised 20 matched dyads, each consisting of one boat owner and one crew member; collectors, port managers, and local-government actors were supporting informants. The Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) was used to explain why the existing arrangement persisted, while Soft Systems Methodology (SSM) translated the diagnosis into a purposeful activity system and staged intervention strategy. Owners financed vessels and operations and controlled first-sale decisions and records, whereas crew members supplied labor but did not determine buyers, prices, or post-landing revenue allocation. The arrangement persisted because crew work provided income and social support under limited alternatives, while owners sought to protect capital, manage risk, secure labor, and coordinate marketing. Norms of loyalty, gratitude, kinship, and informality reinforced these constraints. The analysis produced one multi-actor root definition and eight minimum activities for shifting opaque and dependency-based relations toward more transparent, clearly defined, and balanced arrangements. The strategy begins with shared information, followed by minimum work agreements and mediation, crew economic capability, and alternative economic access. Social-norm change, behavioral constraints, and system redesign must therefore be addressed together without disregarding the legitimate financing and risk-bearing role of boat owners. Methodologically, the sequential integration of TPB and SSM links behavioral explanation to conceptual system redesign.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于印尼Kupang市Tenau渔港与Oeba鱼品卸货基地的定性案例，运用Theory of Planned Behavior（TPB）与Soft Systems Methodology（SSM），分析捕捞渔业中非正式patron-client型船东—船员劳资关系的维系机制及可行转型路径。船东掌控船舶融资、运营及首次销售决策，船员仅提供劳动力，无法决定买家、价格与收益分配；该安排因船员缺乏替代生计、船东需保护资本与管理风险而持续，并受忠诚、感恩、亲属关系等社会规范强化。研究提出一个多主体root definition及八项最低活动，主张从信息共享入手，依次推进最低工作协议与调解、船员经济能力建设及替代性经济渠道，以实现更透明、权责清晰且平衡的劳资安排。

papers.title: Turbulent free-surface flow through an idealised nature-like fish pass
papers.authors: Dai, Jie; Luo, Qianyu; Stoesser, Thorsten; Gong, Yiqing; Mao, Jingqiao
papers.journal: Engineering Applications of Computational Fluid Mechanics
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对理想化仿自然鱼道内的湍流自由表面流展开，旨在探究其水力学特性。因摘要缺失，具体方法与发现无法概述。

papers.title: Evaluation of Post-Harvest Loss Reduction Strategies Among Fish                                                 Farmers in Kogi State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Mathew, A. J
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: Fish provides vital protein, income, and jobs in Nigeria; reducing post-harvest losses ensures food security and profitability. The post-harvest loss reduction strategies among fish farmers in Kogi State, Nigeria was examined. Structured questionnaire was administered to 600 respondents in three agricultural zones using multistage random sampling procedure. Data collected were subjected to descriptive and inferential statistics(T-test) for significant difference. Result showed that majority of the fish farmers were female (65%), aged between 35-44, educated (91.67% ) and married (73%) respectively. Post-harvest losses among fish farmers in Kogi State were predominantly driven by technical and handling-related factors, with lack of cold storage facilities (mean = 3.38), poor hygiene at landing and market points (3.24), and physical damage during handling (3.20) emerging as the most critical contributors. Female farmers consistently reported slightly higher mean values than their male counterparts. Smoking fish to extend shelf life (mean = 3.34) is the most widely adopted strategy followed by sun-drying (3.08), sorting and grading (2.86), and coordinating transport schedules (2.84). Strategies assessed were considered effective (mean values ≥ 2.5) with varied relative effectiveness such that smoking fish (mean = 3.27) emerged as the most effective strategy followed by rapid marketing (3.19), hygienic handling (3.16), ice use during transport (3.03) and value addition (3.00). Fish farmers face significant post-harvest losses mainly from lack of cold storage, poor hygiene and handling issues, with women more vulnerable; smoking is the most effective strategy, while modern methods like insulated storage and value addition remain underutilized.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚科吉州渔民收获后损失的主要成因及减损策略，通过对三个农业区600名渔民的多阶段随机问卷调查，采用描述性统计与T检验分析。结果显示，冷库缺乏、卸货及市场环节卫生条件差和处理过程中的物理损伤是损失主因，女性渔民受影响更大；烟熏（mean=3.34）是最广泛采用的策略，其次为晒干、分拣分级和协调运输安排，且烟熏被评为最有效策略（mean=3.27），而隔热储藏和价值增值等现代方法利用率仍然偏低。

papers.title: Effects of Hydraulics on Fish Movement Behavior and Energy Expenditure in a Combined Technical Fishway
papers.authors: Wang, Yuanyang; Tan, Junjun; Chen, Lei; Sun, Junjian; Ke, Senfan; Kattel, Giri; Shi, Xiaotao
papers.abstract: River fragmentation caused by hydropower development disrupts fish migration and threatens freshwater biodiversity worldwide. Fishways are widely used to restore connectivity, yet their effectiveness often varies among species due to differences in swimming ability and behavior responses to hydraulic conditions. This study evaluated a combined vertical slot–submerged notch with bottom orifice (VS–SNBO) fishway using laboratory experiments with two cyprinid species (Ctenopharyngodon idella and Opsariichthys bidens). We quantified hydraulic characteristics (velocity, turbulent kinetic energy, and strain rate), fish movement behavior, route selection, passage success, and energy expenditure. The VS–SNBO fishway achieved a overall passage success rate of 76.3% for both two cyprinid species. Among the successful upstream movement routes, 70.5% followed the vertical slot (VSL–VSL) route, despite higher velocities (0.60–0.83 m/s) and energy expenditure. Fish selectively utilized low-velocity zones near the orifice for recovery, indicating behavioral adaptation to heterogeneous flow conditions. Energetic analysis revealed trade-offs between passage efficiency and energy expenditure, with continuous movement routes reducing transit time but increasing metabolic demand. The combined fishway design provided multiple kinds of movement routes for different species to enable flexible movement strategies. These findings highlight that the VS–SNBO fishway can offer diverse hydraulics for multiple species and provide insights into how fish adjust their movement strategies in response to variable hydraulic conditions, and provide practical guidance for improving multi-species fish passage in regulated river systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过实验室实验评估了组合式垂直缝-潜孔鱼道（VS–SNBO）对两种鲤科鱼类（草鱼和马口鱼）水力特性、运动行为、路径选择、过鱼成功率及能量消耗的影响。鱼道总体过鱼成功率为76.3%，70.5%的成功上溯个体选择垂直缝路线（VSL–VSL），尽管该路线流速较高（0.60–0.83 m/s）且能量消耗更大。鱼类主动利用孔口附近低流速区恢复体力，表现出对异质流场的行为适应，且过鱼效率与能量消耗之间存在权衡。该组合式鱼道设计为不同物种提供了多种运动路径和灵活的运动策略，可为多物种过鱼设施优化提供实践指导。

papers.abstract: Oxbow lakes (baors) are semi-closed freshwater ecosystems that contribute substantially to inland fisheries and livelihoods in southwestern Bangladesh, yet their ecological productivity remains insufficiently explored. This study aimed to assess the physicochemical conditions, plankton diversity and abundance, and fish community structure of three baors—Bukbhora, Jhapa, and Khedapara—from July 2023 to June 2024. Monthly water quality monitoring, plankton sampling, identification, and fish community surveys were conducted to evaluate seasonal ecological patterns and production potential. Water temperature ranged from 21–33 °C, pH from 7.5–8.1, dissolved oxygen from 5.5–6.5 mg L⁻¹, alkalinity from 165–169 mg L⁻¹, and hardness from 169–179 mg L⁻¹, indicating generally favorable conditions for aquatic productivity and fish growth. papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了孟加拉国西南部三个牛轭湖（baors）的水质、浮游生物群落与商业鱼类种群，以揭示其生态生产力。2023年7月至2024年6月的月度监测显示，水温21–33 °C、pH 7.5–8.1、溶解氧5.5–6.5 mg L⁻¹、碱度165–169 mg L⁻¹、硬度169–179 mg L⁻¹，亚硝酸盐氮低于检出限，整体水质条件有利于水生生物生产力与鱼类生长。

papers.title: Rhizospheric fungi for sustainable wilt disease management: from plant-microbe interactions to microbial biotechnology and agro-aquaculture applications
papers.authors: Tripathi, Shakti N.; Tripathi, Arpita; Pandey, Praveen; Yadav, Arati; Petrescu-Mag, I. Valentin; Bănățean-Dunea, Ioan
papers.abstract: Fusarium wilt and other soil-borne vascular diseases remain major constraints to sustainable crop production because their causal agents persist in soil, interact intimately with host roots, and are difficult to eradicate using conventional management practices. Increasing concerns regarding pesticide residues, environmental contamination, pathogen resistance, and deterioration of soil biological health have stimulated interest in rhizosphere-based biological control. Rhizospheric fungi, particularly Trichoderma, Clonostachys, arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi, selected Penicillium spp., and non-pathogenic Fusarium isolates, can suppress soil-borne pathogens through complementary mechanisms including mycoparasitism, competition, antibiosis, hydrolytic enzymes, volatile organic compounds, nutrient mobilization, root colonization, induced systemic resistance, hormonal modulation, and restructuring of the soil microbiome. Recent research indicates that disease suppression should increasingly be viewed as an emergent property of the plant–pathogen–microbiome–environment continuum rather than as the consequence of direct antagonism by a single microorganism. Disease-suppressive soils, microbiome engineering, synthetic microbial communities, multi-omics, precision formulation, and controlled delivery are consequently emerging as important directions for next-generation biocontrol. Recent studies further demonstrate that root exudates and agricultural practices can reshape rhizosphere communities associated with Fusarium suppression, while advances in formulation technology are improving the stability and applicability of fungal inoculants. Beyond terrestrial agriculture, fungal biotechnology offers an emerging connection with agro-aquaculture through nutrient recycling, agricultural-residue valorization, wastewater treatment, fungal–microalgal systems, and circular bioeconomy approaches. However, direct introduction of terrestrial fungal biocontrol agents into aquatic production systems remains premature and requires independent ecological, toxicological, and regulatory assessment. This review critically synthesizes the ecology, mechanisms, biotechnology, formulation, field constraints, climate-resilience potential, and agro-aquaculture prospects of rhizospheric fungi, and proposes a systems-level framework for their integration into sustainable disease management.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了根际真菌（尤其是 *Trichoderma*、*Clonostachys*、丛枝菌根真菌及非致病性 *Fusarium* 等）通过重寄生、竞争、抗生、诱导系统抗性及微生物组重塑等机制抑制土传枯萎病的生态学基础与生物技术进展。作者提出病害抑制应视为植物—病原—微生物组—环境连续体的涌现属性，而非单一拮抗作用的结果，并强调抑病土壤、合成微生物群落、多组学与精准制剂是下一代生物防治的重要方向。文章进一步探讨了真菌生物技术在养分循环、农业废弃物资源化及真菌—微藻系统等方面与水产养殖的潜在衔接，但指出将陆生真菌生防菌直接引入水生生产系统尚不成熟，需独立的生态毒理与监管评估。

papers.title: Women's participation in the aquaculture sector and its socio-economic impacts in Sadar Union of Badalgachi Upazila, Naogaon, Bangladesh
papers.authors: Islam, Md. Khairul; Afrin, Rafia
papers.journal: Archives of Agriculture and Environmental Science
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to explore women's involvement in aquaculture activities and their role in family economy, decision-making, and food security in Sadar Union of Badalgachi Upazila, Naogaon, Bangladesh. Data were collected through face-to-face interviews with 51 women (out of approximately 200 fish-culturist families) using a pretested structured questionnaire through KoBo Toolbox. The data was analyzed descriptively in MS EXCEL. The findings showed that most of the respondents were housewives (62.74%) and had less than secondary education (54.91%). Nearly 68.62% of women were actively engaged in pond monitoring, feeding, and fertilizing, and 31.38% were not, mainly due to lack of knowledge or training (81.25%). Despite their labor, they were not involved in important decision-making, including species selection, stocking, and marketing, which were taken by the male members of the family. While 60-62.5% of women received a small profit, 64.86% were unable to spend the money independently; still, 88.23% were tried to save for their future family needs. Women's involvement also contributed to diversified household nutrition, with average fish consumption of 333.55g/person/week, and partly through integrated farming (fish-vegetable) by 37.25% of the respondents. The findings suggest that women are not just occasional laborers but also an unpaid and unacknowledged second labor force, who play an essential role in the income, food security, and household resilience. The invisible role of women can be converted into economic empowerment by providing targeted training, supportive policies, and improving local infrastructure for the benefit of the households and the aquaculture industry in rural Bangladesh.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查孟加拉国Naogaon地区Badalgachi Upazila的Sadar Union中女性参与水产养殖的现状及其对家庭经济、决策和粮食安全的影响，通过对51名女性进行结构化问卷调查并作描述性分析。结果显示，约68.62%的女性积极参与池塘监测、投喂和施肥，但她们在鱼种选择、放养和销售等关键决策中基本被排除，且多数无法独立支配收益。女性劳动显著促进了家庭营养多样化（人均每周鱼类消费333.55 g），但其作为无报酬、被忽视的“第二劳动力”角色需通过针对性培训、支持性政策和基础设施改善转化为经济赋权。

papers.title: Red Tide Algal Toxin-Induced Intestinal Injury in Marine Fish: Mechanisms, Gut Microecology, and Aquaculture Health Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Hang, Lingxiao; Xu, Haihua; Ding, Yanzhe; Chen, Peipei; Song, Xingang; Shi, Dongsheng; Chen, Zhongwei
papers.abstract: Harmful algal blooms (HABs) can cause rapid, extensive mortality in exposed marine fish, often before fish-level diagnostic sampling can guide an emergency response. This review compares the toxin-specific evidence for intestinal injury caused by paralytic shellfish toxins, okadaic acid and Dinophysistoxins, brevetoxins, and fish-killing blooms, while distinguishing direct evidence in marine fish from evidence in other models. Intestinal barrier disruption, inflammation, and microbiome changes are valuable for explaining sublethal exposure, survivor recovery, and post-event attribution. They are not proposed as operational triggers during an acute fish kill. Practical management instead depends chiefly on site-specific environmental surveillance before exposure, predefined emergency actions when a bloom approaches, and longer-term reduction in avoidable nutrient and waste inputs where these contribute to local bloom risk. A four-stage framework links environmental hazard, fish exposure, biological effects, and production or food-safety outcomes with quantitative indicators and explicit uncertainty at each transition. This revised scope places mechanistic intestinal toxicology within the ecological time scale and operational limits of marine aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 有害藻华（HABs）可在暴露海洋鱼类中引发快速大量死亡，本文综述了麻痹性贝毒、okadaic acid与Dinophysistoxins、brevetoxins及杀鱼藻华所致肠道损伤的毒素特异性证据，并区分海洋鱼类直接证据与其他模型证据。肠道屏障破坏、炎症及microbiome变化有助于解释亚致死暴露、幸存鱼恢复及事件归因，但不作为急性死鱼事件的操作性触发指标。实际管理主要依赖暴露前定点环境监测、藻华逼近时的预设应急措施及长期削减营养盐与废物输入，并提出连接环境危害、鱼类暴露、生物效应与生产/食品安全结局的四阶段框架。

papers.title: Edge AI-Driven Multimodal Sensor Fusion for Environmental Forecasting in Smart Aquaculture Monitoring
papers.authors: Pao, Chia-Yen; Chang, Po-Hao
papers.abstract: As the global aquaculture industry moves towards high density and integrated efficiency, the precision and immediacy of water quality management have become key to increasing productivity and reducing risks. Traditional aquaculture relies on manual experience or simple threshold controls, which often suffer from response delays and energy waste. This study proposes an IoT environmental prediction model based on edge computing designed specifically to address complex and variable outdoor aquaculture environments. The system integrates multimodal sensor data such as water level, temperature, and turbidity, and employs a 1D-CNN-LSTM (One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network–Long Short-Term Memory) model deployed on ESP32 edge computing nodes to achieve low-latency environmental change prediction. Based on five core control rules (turbidity control and bidirectional regulation of water level and temperature), this study simulates 360 days of operational data in a real-world environment, covering seasonal climate changes and extreme weather events (such as typhoons). Experimental results show that, compared with traditional hysteresis control, the predictive control strategy proposed in this study can provide early warnings of environmental anomalies 15 to 60 min in advance, effectively increasing the proportion of time in which water quality parameters are maintained within safe thresholds to 99.8%. This paper details the system architecture, prediction model design, and empirical benefits of long-term simulation data analysis, providing a solution with both academic depth and practical value for smart aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对高密度集约化水产养殖中水质管理响应滞后与能耗浪费问题，提出一种基于边缘计算的IoT环境预测模型。系统融合水位、温度、浊度等多模态传感器数据，在ESP32边缘节点部署1D-CNN-LSTM模型，实现低延迟环境变化预测，并基于五项核心控制规则模拟360天真实运行数据。结果表明，该预测控制策略较传统滞后控制可提前15–60 min预警环境异常，将水质参数维持于安全阈值内的时间比例提升至99.8%，为smart aquaculture提供了兼具学术深度与实用价值的解决方案。

papers.title: Advancing data integration in marine citizen science: insights from a collaborative workshop
papers.authors: Brévière, Emilie; Fockedey, Nancy; Thijsse, Peter; Novellino, Antonio; Gorringe, Patrick; Kluckner, Sigmund; Khatib, Laura; Martinez-Osuna, Juan; Piermattei, Viviana; Campanati, Camilla
papers.abstract: The ocean remains critically under-observed, particularly in coastal zones where traditional monitoring is limited by cost, logistical constraints, and competing regulatory priorities. Marine citizen science offers an emerging and powerful complementary approach to addressing these gaps; however, data management challenges currently limit its full integration into scientific and policy data infrastructures. The inaugural workshop of the Marine Citizen Science Data Network (MCSDN), held in February 2026 in Ostend, Belgium, brought together approximately 200 participants from over 30 countries. Attendees included representatives from marine citizen science initiatives, developers of low-cost monitoring devices, data managers, and researchers and data users. Together they identified challenges, opportunities and co-designed recommendations to improve marine citizen science data flows. Workshop discussions highlighted interconnected barriers and enabling factors affecting FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) marine citizen science data. These included fragmented data flows, weak connections between communities, limited participant engagement and feedback mechanisms, the potential of accessible low-cost technologies, and the need for shared practices and standardized documentation. Building on these themes, the workshop produced four concrete recommendations to enhance the reuse and impact of marine citizen science data: (1) develop discipline-specific FAIR guidance, (2) establish minimum metadata standards, (3) create simplified training materials, and (4) support the development and deployment of low-cost sensors. This perspective article presents the EU-funded CS-MACH1 project’s approach to bridging marine citizen science initiatives with European data infrastructures, and highlights the community’s readiness to deliver FAIR, impactful in situ ocean observations.
papers.summary_cn: 2026年2月，海洋公民科学数据网络（MCSDN）在比利时奥斯坦德举办首届研讨会，约200名来自30多个国家的参与者共同探讨海洋公民科学数据的管理与整合问题。会议识别出数据流碎片化、社区间联系薄弱、参与者反馈机制不足等障碍，并提出四项建议：制定学科专属FAIR指南、建立最低元数据标准、开发简化培训材料、支持低成本传感器部署。该文介绍了欧盟资助的CS-MACH1项目推动海洋公民科学数据融入欧洲数据基础设施的路径。
